papers.abstract: This work shows how a Bose-Einstein condensate of ultracold atoms could be used to address a long-standing question in quantum theory: how much time does it take for a particle to reach a detector? To this end, we propose a realistic experimental setup, whose key idea is not to measure arrival times directly, but the arrival flux on the detector as a function of its position. This novel approach not only solves practical issues with having a detector close to the system, but also results in signals that allow to unambiguously distinguish different theoretical predictions. This proposal raises prospects for resolving the decades-old debate on this fundamental issue.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：proposal、theoretical predictions、resolving debate）；研究对象：量子到达时间测量问题，具体提出利用超冷原子玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体（Bose-Einstein condensate）作为实验体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出通过测量探测器上的到达通量（arrival flux）随位置的变化，而非直接测量到达时间，可以区分不同理论预测，从而解决量子力学中粒子到达探测器所需时间的长期争议。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出通过测量探测器上的到达通量（arrival flux）随位置的变化，而非直接测量到达时间，可以区分不同理论预测，从而解决量子力学中粒子到达探测器所需时间的长期争议。；创新点：提出不直接测量到达时间，而是通过测量到达通量随位置的变化来间接获取信息，从而避免探测器靠近系统带来的实际问题，并能明确区分不同理论预测。
papers.method_zh: 理论提案，设计了一个基于超冷原子玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体的现实实验方案，核心思路是测量到达通量作为探测器位置的函数。

papers.title: Extracting the physical content of Liouvillian eigenmodes: Semiclassical quantization
papers.abstract: Unlike in closed quantum systems where individual energy eigenstates are understood as physical excitations, open quantum systems have distinct right and left eigenstates of the Liouvillian that decay with time and are difficult to interpret. Here we introduce a physically motivated quasiprobability measure combining the two types of eigenstates that interprets a Liouville eigenmode as a set of coherences. This coherence measure is intimately connected to the return probability and allows one to visualize the modes as quasiprobability distributions in a "doubled" phase space. Using this measure we show that, remarkably, an oscillator retains its quantized "orbits" in phase space for a large class of linear and nonlinear damping, thus providing a formulation of semiclassical quantization for open systems. The orbits have measurable dynamical signatures and are broadened in the presence of a thermal bath, similar to energy levels. For quadratic systems, our results yield an extension of the concept of invariant tori, which play a central role in Hamiltonian systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：introduce a physically motivated quasiprobability measure、formulation of semiclassical quantization、extend the concept of invariant tori。；研究对象：开放量子系统（open quantum systems）中Liouvillian超算符的本征模，特别是谐振子（oscillator）在各类线性与非线性阻尼下的相空间行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过引入一种结合左右本征态的准概率相干度量，发现谐振子在多种阻尼下仍保持相空间中的量子化“轨道”，从而为开放系统建立了半经典量子化方案；该轨道在热浴中会像能级一样展宽。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过引入一种结合左右本征态的准概率相干度量，发现谐振子在多种阻尼下仍保持相空间中的量子化“轨道”，从而为开放系统建立了半经典量子化方案；该轨道在热浴中会像能级一样展宽。；创新点：首次将封闭系统中能量本征态的物理图像（如相空间量子化轨道）推广到开放系统，通过新定义的相干度量揭示了Liouvillian本征模的物理内容，并扩展了哈密顿系统中不变环面（invariant tori）的概念至二次型开放系统。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导：定义了一种基于左右本征态的准概率相干度量（coherence measure），该度量与返回概率（return probability）紧密相关，并将Liouvillian本征模可视化为“加倍”相空间中的准概率分布。

papers.title: Vine Codes: Low-Overhead Quantum LDPC Codes on a Planar Square Grid
papers.abstract: The surface code is a promising route towards large-scale quantum computing, requiring only nearest-neighbour gates amenable to superconducting hardware. However, surface codes incur large qubit overheads. Novel quantum low-density parity check (qLDPC) codes promise to reduce overheads but require long-range connections that are difficult to achieve on superconducting platforms. Here, we introduce "Vine Codes" - qLDPC codes that are implementable on a planar square grid through nearest-neighbour, two-qubit gates native to superconducting platforms (iSWAP and CZ). Our approach generalises "Directional Codes" recently introduced by Gehér et. al. (2025) which are constrained to a torus. In contrast, vine codes have open boundary conditions constructed with the aid of routing qubits. We perform extensive numeric searches and find promising candidate vine codes, e.g. [[121,4,6]], [[221,6,7]], and [[234,9,6]] codes. We verify the circuit distances and show that data and measure qubits required can be reduced by up to ~28% relative to the surface code at a circuit distance of 7. Even including routing qubits, vine codes require fewer total qubits than the surface code (e.g. ~18% reduction at circuit distance 10) and benefits are expected to increase at higher distances. We perform circuit-level noise simulations to demonstrate that under a realistic noise model and at a near-term noise rate of $10^{-3}$, vine codes can perform better than the surface code while using fewer qubits. We give an exhaustive list of all unique vine codes up to stabiliser-weight 9. We additionally introduce "Flip-Vine Codes" which possess single-qubit transversal Clifford gates useful for fault-tolerant logic and magic state cultivation. We furthermore construct examples of generalised open boundaries for vine codes that go beyond the familiar X/Z boundaries of the surface and tile codes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：introduce（引入）、perform numeric searches（数值搜索）、verify（验证）、simulations（模拟）。；研究对象：量子纠错码，具体为可在平面方形网格上实现的量子低密度奇偶校验（qLDPC）码，用于容错量子计算。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种名为“Vine Codes”的新型量子LDPC码，可在超导平台所需的平面方形网格和最近邻两量子比特门（iSWAP和CZ）下实现，相比表面码，在相同电路距离下可减少约28%的数据和测量量子比特，并在总量子比特数上实现约18%的减少（电路距离10时），且在近端噪声率（10^{-3}）下性能优于表面码。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种名为“Vine Codes”的新型量子LDPC码，可在超导平台所需的平面方形网格和最近邻两量子比特门（iSWAP和CZ）下实现，相比表面码，在相同电路距离下可减少约28%的数据和测量量子比特，并在总量子比特数上实现约18%的减少（电路距离10时），且在近端噪声率（10^{-3}）下性能优于表面码。；创新点：1. 首次提出了可在平面方形网格上通过最近邻门实现的qLDPC码（Vine Codes），克服了此前qLDPC码需要长程连接的困难。2. 引入了“Flip-Vine Codes”，其具有单量子比特横向Clifford门，有利于容错逻辑和魔态培养。3. 构造了超越表面码和tile码常见X/Z边界的广义开放边界条件。
papers.method_zh: 通过推广“Directional Codes”（受限于环面）并引入路由量子比特（routing qubits）来构造具有开放边界条件的Vine Codes。进行了广泛的数值搜索以寻找候选码，并进行了电路级噪声模拟来评估性能。

papers.title: Thermodynamic Measure of Intelligence
papers.abstract: Can intelligence be measured? We propose that intelligence can be defined as the lawful amplification of rare but valid futures: a system increases the probability of outcomes that would be unlikely under passive dynamics but remain admissible under the constraints of the domain. We start with the premise that an intelligent system must model the world and its own place within it. Because the system is part of the world it models, this leads naturally to recursive self-simulation: the system represents futures in which its own actions are part of the trajectory. Our central results give a necessity statement and a conditional near-sufficiency statement connecting this architecture to a precise thermodynamic measure of lawful amplification of rare-valid futures: high rare-valid lift is impossible unless the internal simulation identifies rare-valid futures with high fidelity; conversely, when rare-valid fidelity is high and the simulation contains an effective policy, the achievable lift approaches the actuation-limited optimum. Thus recursive self-simulation is not merely a plausible feature of intelligence but, under the stated assumptions, is necessary and nearly sufficient for high thermodynamic intelligence. The resulting framework makes intelligence measurable on a universal scale, from passive matter and feedback controllers, large language models, and humans as text generators to Maxwell-demon-like information engines.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提出定义、推导必要性/充分性陈述、构建理论框架，未提及任何实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：智能（Intelligence）本身。论文将智能视为一种物理现象，研究其与热力学（Thermodynamic）和递归自模拟（recursive self-simulation）之间的内在联系，并试图建立一种普适的、可测量的热力学度量。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 论文提出，智能可以定义为对“稀有但有效未来”的合法放大（lawful amplification of rare-valid futures）。其核心结论是：递归自模拟（系统模拟包含自身行动的未来）是实现高“稀有-有效提升”（rare-valid lift）的必要条件，并且在特定条件下接近充分条件。因此，递归自模拟是“高热力学智能”的必要且近乎充分的结构特征。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：论文提出，智能可以定义为对“稀有但有效未来”的合法放大（lawful amplification of rare-valid futures）。其核心结论是：递归自模拟（系统模拟包含自身行动的未来）是实现高“稀有-有效提升”（rare-valid lift）的必要条件，并且在特定条件下接近充分条件。因此，递归自模拟是“高热力学智能”的必要且近乎充分的结构特征。；创新点：提出了一种基于热力学的、普适的智能度量方法（Thermodynamic Measure of Intelligence），将智能与热力学中的概率放大和递归自模拟架构严格联系起来，从而将智能从定性描述提升为可在统一标尺上测量的物理量，覆盖从被动物质到人类及麦克斯韦妖式信息引擎的广泛系统。
papers.method_zh: 采用理论推导和概念分析框架。从“智能系统必须建模世界及其自身”这一前提出发，通过逻辑论证和热力学分析，推导出关于“稀有-有效提升”与“内部模拟保真度”之间的必要性陈述和条件性近充分性陈述。

papers.title: Optimizing resource allocation for accuracy in noisy variational quantum algorithms
papers.abstract: For quantum algorithms to achieve their full potential, we need methodologies to optimize them, such as reaching a given output accuracy with minimal resource costs. Here, we develop such a methodology for a class of Noisy Intermediate-Scale Quantum (NISQ) algorithms. We leverage simulations of a Variational Quantum Eigensolver (VQE) to propose a phenomenological model of such algorithms that captures the complex relationship between algorithmic accuracy, algorithmic resource costs, and the noise that exists in realistic quantum hardware. For this, we take the algorithmic resource cost to be the total number of quantum gate-operations in the algorithm; minimizing this cost typically makes the algorithm faster and more energy-efficient. We consider the subtle trade-off between quantum circuit size (small circuits are too imprecise, but large ones are too noisy), and the number of iterations of that quantum circuit for the full algorithm to sufficiently converge. Using a noise-metric-resource methodology, we identify the sweet spot (of circuit size versus iterations) that minimizes the algorithmic resource costs for a desired algorithm accuracy. It also gives the circuit size that maximizes algorithm accuracy for a fixed resource cost. Our methodology provides a practical guideline for near-term deployment of variational algorithms on realistic noisy hardware, including hardware that uses error mitigation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：phenomenological model（现象学模型）、simulations（模拟）、methodology（方法论）。；研究对象：含噪变分量子算法（Noisy Variational Quantum Algorithms）中的资源分配与精度优化问题，具体以变分量子本征求解器（VQE）为案例。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过建立噪声-度量-资源方法论，找到了在给定算法精度下最小化资源成本（量子门操作总数）的最优电路尺寸与迭代次数组合，并给出了在固定资源成本下最大化算法精度的电路尺寸。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过建立噪声-度量-资源方法论，找到了在给定算法精度下最小化资源成本（量子门操作总数）的最优电路尺寸与迭代次数组合，并给出了在固定资源成本下最大化算法精度的电路尺寸。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于VQE的数值模拟，构建了一个描述算法精度、资源成本与量子硬件噪声之间复杂关系的现象学模型。资源成本定义为算法中量子门操作的总数，并分析了电路尺寸（小电路精度不足，大电路噪声过大）与迭代次数之间的权衡。

papers.title: High-Power Laser Drives Motion in Ultra-thin Photonic Crystal Lightsails via Radiation Pressure
papers.abstract: Laser-driven lightsails have emerged as a promising route for accelerating ultralight spacecraft to high speeds using beamed optical energy. Realizing this concept pushes the limits of light-matter interaction, materials science, structural engineering, and nanomechanical design. A central challenge is to create nanophotonic reflectors that combine ultralow mass, large illuminated area, and survival under high optical power densities. No previous experiment has combined these constraints in a single structure sufficient to produce measurable radiation-pressure displacement. Here, we report the largest subwavelength tethered lightsails to date: nanoscale-thickness, millimeter-wide silicon nitride membranes patterned with billions of holes. Despite their subwavelength thickness, they achieve 99% reflection through resonant photonic modes, combining ultralow areal density with high reflectivity. Their compliance enables radiation-pressure displacements of up to 1.75 micrometer, a 50,000-fold increase over previous lightsail optomechanical responses. These thin mirrors are shown to withstand and maintain high reflectivity under directed laser intensities comparable to optical intensities at the surface of the Sun. Together, these results establish a testbed for high-power nanophotonics, directed-energy systems, and light-driven propulsion, defining the practical limits of ultrathin photonic materials under intense optical loading.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“Here, we report...”“they achieve...”“These thin mirrors are shown to withstand...”等描述实验制备、测量和性能表征的语句。；研究对象：超薄光子晶体光帆（lightsail），具体为纳米厚度、毫米宽度的氮化硅（silicon nitride）薄膜，其上图案化有数十亿个纳米孔洞，构成亚波长光子晶体结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该超薄光子晶体光帆在亚波长厚度下实现了99%的反射率，并在高功率激光照射下产生了高达1.75微米的辐射压力位移，比此前光帆光力学响应提高了约50000倍，且能承受相当于太阳表面光强的激光强度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该超薄光子晶体光帆在亚波长厚度下实现了99%的反射率，并在高功率激光照射下产生了高达1.75微米的辐射压力位移，比此前光帆光力学响应提高了约50000倍，且能承受相当于太阳表面光强的激光强度。；创新点：首次在单一结构中同时实现超低质量、大面积照明、高反射率（99%）以及在高光功率密度下存活，并产生可测量的辐射压力位移；所制备的光帆尺寸为迄今最大的亚波长系留光帆，且其辐射压力位移幅度较此前工作有数量级提升。
papers.method_zh: 实验制备了纳米厚度、毫米尺寸的氮化硅薄膜，通过图案化数十亿个纳米孔洞形成光子晶体结构；利用共振光子模式实现高反射率；采用高功率激光照射并测量辐射压力导致的位移（光力学响应）。

papers.title: Trends, Volatility, Correlations, and Critical Phenomena in Financial Markets
papers.abstract: We forecast future volatilities and correlations of financial markets based on the current trends in these markets. This complements previous work that models future expected returns by a cubic polynomial of the current trend strength. Empirically, we observe that volatilities and correlations tend to increase day after day in times of strong up- or down-trends. This effect is particularly pronounced in down-trends. It can be accurately quantified by quadratic polynomials of today's trend strengths, which refine common mean-reversion models of volatilities and correlations. Our results improve the prediction of market risk by accounting for market trends. They also support a recent proposal to model financial markets by a lattice gas near its critical point.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：model（建模）、forecast（预测）、polynomial（多项式拟合）、proposal（理论提议）。；研究对象：金融市场的波动率、相关性及其与市场趋势的关系，特别是将金融市场类比为近临界点晶格气体的临界现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 市场波动率和相关性在强上升或下降趋势期间会逐日增加，且下降趋势中效应更显著；该效应可用当前趋势强度的二次多项式精确量化，改进了常见的均值回归模型，并支持将金融市场建模为近临界点晶格气体的理论。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：市场波动率和相关性在强上升或下降趋势期间会逐日增加，且下降趋势中效应更显著；该效应可用当前趋势强度的二次多项式精确量化，改进了常见的均值回归模型，并支持将金融市场建模为近临界点晶格气体的理论。；创新点：将趋势强度与波动率、相关性的动态变化建立定量二次多项式关系，从而改进市场风险预测，并为金融市场临界点类比模型提供实证支持。摘要未突出说明与已有均值回归模型的具体对比细节。
papers.method_zh: 基于当前市场趋势强度，使用二次多项式对波动率和相关性进行预测建模；与先前使用三次多项式建模预期收益的工作互补；通过实证数据观察并量化趋势强度与波动率/相关性的关系。

papers.title: Random Local Stabilizer Codes in Three Dimensions without String or Self-Similar Fractal Logical Operators
papers.abstract: Quantum error-correcting codes (QECs) are essential components quantum computation and have deep connections to quantum phases of matter. A key obstruction to passive self-correcting QECs is the presence of string logical operators, which can generate logical errors through constant-energy-barrier processes. Haah's Codes (fracton codes) showed that three-dimensional stabilizer codes can forbid such string logical operators, but their translation-invariant structure supports self-similar fractal logical operators with a logarithmic energy barrier. We introduce the qutrit random cubic codes, a family of local qutrit Calderbank-Shor-Steane stabilizer Hamiltonians with similar cube-check structure as Haah's Code 1 but built from spatially varying stabilizers. We prove that these models retain the no-string property and numerically observe that they have properties distinct from translation-invariant fracton codes: the smallest ground-state degeneracy exponent is $k=2$ for odd $L$ and $k=4$ for even $L$; noncontractible plane-logical operators span the entire logical space; and charge-push diagnostics show that the self-similar fractal operators are absent. These results demonstrate that constrained randomness can fundamentally change the nature of stabilizer codes and improve their self-correction properties. They further point to broader families of quantum error-correcting codes and quantum phases beyond canonical topological and fracton orders.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：stabilizer Hamiltonians、numerically observe、proof。；研究对象：三维随机局域稳定子码（qutrit random cubic codes），一种基于三能级量子比特（qutrit）的Calderbank-Shor-Steane（CSS）稳定子哈密顿量，其结构类似于Haah码1但具有空间变化的稳定子。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该随机码家族保留了无弦逻辑算子的性质，且数值上未观察到自相似分形逻辑算子，其基态简并度指数和电荷推动诊断均表明其自修正性质优于平移不变的fracton码。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该随机码家族保留了无弦逻辑算子的性质，且数值上未观察到自相似分形逻辑算子，其基态简并度指数和电荷推动诊断均表明其自修正性质优于平移不变的fracton码。；创新点：通过引入空间变化的随机稳定子，打破了平移不变性，从而消除了传统fracton码中存在的自相似分形逻辑算子，从根本上改变了稳定子码的性质并改善了自修正能力。
papers.method_zh: 理论证明（证明无弦性质）与数值计算（基态简并度指数、非收缩平面逻辑算子空间、电荷推动诊断）相结合。

papers.title: The Heat Kernel Expansion: Curvature for Shock Detection in Higher-Order Financial Networks
papers.abstract: This work follows the evolution of financial networks in Norway over a period of nine years at a monthly rate. The data consist of board directors and their affiliations to companies, which we model as simplicial complexes. In this framework, directors are represented as nodes and companies as faces of the complex. To characterize the latter, we focus on three topological measures: the Euler characteristic, computed through the Betti numbers, torsion computed through the reduced determinant of the higher-order Laplacians, and higher-order clustering coefficients. The first two fail to capture the effect of imposed law on representation, unlike our notion of curvature which is a geometrical measure computed from the coefficients of the series expansion of the heat kernel in powers of time, which is our major contribution in this work. In particular, the Euler characteristic integrates curvature, and thus local information is lost. Subsequently, not every topological measure can reliably capture shocks in networks. Further, the number of spanning trees may undergo significant changes at the lowest order, yet these changes need not be reflected in the torsion. Conversely, the change in the curvature revealed variation in the board interlock due to legislation, and serves as a sensitive measure for detecting shocks in networks. Inflection points in curvature are associated with external forcing, and minima with shock arrival times. Sharp transitions are also observed in the components of torsion, while smooth changes are observed in higher-order clustering.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：拓扑测量、热核展开、曲率计算、网络分析。；研究对象：挪威金融网络，具体为九年间（月度数据）的董事会成员及其所属公司构成的单纯复形（simplicial complexes），其中董事为节点，公司为面。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 传统拓扑量（欧拉示性数、挠率）无法可靠捕捉金融网络中的冲击（如立法变化），而基于热核展开系数定义的曲率（curvature）能灵敏检测网络冲击，其拐点对应外部强制力，极小值对应冲击到达时间。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：传统拓扑量（欧拉示性数、挠率）无法可靠捕捉金融网络中的冲击（如立法变化），而基于热核展开系数定义的曲率（curvature）能灵敏检测网络冲击，其拐点对应外部强制力，极小值对应冲击到达时间。；创新点：首次将热核展开的曲率概念引入金融网络分析，并证明其比欧拉示性数（积分曲率丢失局部信息）和挠率（生成树数量变化未必反映在挠率中）更敏感地检测网络中的立法冲击。
papers.method_zh: 采用单纯复形建模金融网络，计算三种拓扑量：通过贝蒂数得到欧拉示性数、通过高阶拉普拉斯矩阵的约化行列式得到挠率、高阶聚类系数，以及本文主要贡献——从热核在时间幂次上的级数展开系数中提取几何曲率。

papers.title: Variational Polaron Theory for Ground States of Strongly Coupled Light-Matter and Electron-Phonon Systems
papers.abstract: Strong light-matter and electron-phonon coupling generate ground states dressed by virtual bosonic excitations, making bare-state truncations and perturbative treatments unreliable in the ultrastrong-coupling regime. We introduce a nonperturbative variational ground-state framework based on a state-dependent polaron transformation, combined with a product-state ansatz and a second-order perturbative correction for residual matter-boson entanglement. We show that the optimized transformed frame becomes asymptotically decoupled at infinite coupling, because the leading linear coupling is canceled while off-diagonal matter transitions are suppressed by displaced-oscillator overlaps. The approach is asymptotically correct in both weak- and strong-coupling limits and remains accurate in the intermediate regime, where fixed polaron transformations are least reliable. Dicke-model benchmarks reproduce ground-state energies, fidelities, and the superradiant transition, with second-order energy errors below 0.2%. Holstein-model benchmarks yield errors below 0.5% and clarify how translational symmetry affects wave-function quality. This dressed-basis framework enables nonperturbative modeling of strongly coupled light-matter and electron-phonon systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：variational ground-state framework（变分基态框架）、nonperturbative（非微扰）、product-state ansatz（乘积态假设）。；研究对象：强耦合光-物质系统（如Dicke模型）和电子-声子耦合系统（如Holstein模型）的基态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一种基于态依赖极化子变换的非微扰变分基态框架，在弱耦合和强耦合极限下均渐近正确，在中间耦合区域（固定极化子变换最不可靠的区域）仍保持高精度；在Dicke模型和Holstein模型基准测试中，二阶能量误差分别低于0.2%和0.5%。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一种基于态依赖极化子变换的非微扰变分基态框架，在弱耦合和强耦合极限下均渐近正确，在中间耦合区域（固定极化子变换最不可靠的区域）仍保持高精度；在Dicke模型和Holstein模型基准测试中，二阶能量误差分别低于0.2%和0.5%。；创新点：提出了一种在任意耦合强度下均有效的非微扰变分框架，克服了固定极化子变换在中间耦合区域可靠性差的局限，并明确揭示了平移对称性对波函数质量的影响（摘要未突出说明其他创新点）。
papers.method_zh: 采用态依赖的极化子变换（state-dependent polaron transformation），结合乘积态假设（product-state ansatz）和针对残余物质-玻色子纠缠的二阶微扰修正；通过优化变换后的参考系，使无限耦合极限下线性耦合项被抵消，非对角物质跃迁被位移振子重叠抑制。

papers.title: Quantum models with the Yang-Lee phase transition
papers.abstract: In this article, we present four different $1+1$D quantum models that realize the Yang-Lee (YL) phase transition under a deformation that preserves $PT$ symmetry. These are the antiferromagnetic Ising spin chain in transverse and longitudinal magnetic fields, the massive Schwinger model, the Blume-Capel model, and the three-state quantum clock model. Using the state-operator correspondence, we identify the YL critical point, compute the scaling dimensions of the lowest operators in each model, and find perfect agreement with the exact results for the YL criticality in two dimensions. Using bosonization for the Schwinger model and the Polyakov-Hubbard transformation for the other models, we show that in all of these quantum models the YL critical point is described, as expected, by a massless bosonic field with an $i φ^3$ interaction. In the quantum clock model, this critical field interacts with a massive bosonic field, and we identify the massless and massive states in the Hamiltonian spectrum. In addition, we numerically compute the two-point function of $φ$ at the Yang-Lee critical point and show that it grows with distance, in agreement with theoretical expectations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“使用态-算符对应”“玻色化”“Polyakov-Hubbard变换”“数值计算两点关联函数”等理论方法，未涉及实验或第一性原理计算。；研究对象：四种实现杨-李（Yang-Lee）相变的1+1维量子模型：反铁磁伊辛自旋链（横场与纵场）、大质量施温格模型、Blume-Capel模型、三态量子钟模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在PT对称性保持的形变下，上述四种量子模型均实现杨-李临界点；该临界点由具有iφ³相互作用的质量less玻色场描述，且临界点处φ的两点关联函数随距离增长，与理论预期一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在PT对称性保持的形变下，上述四种量子模型均实现杨-李临界点；该临界点由具有iφ³相互作用的质量less玻色场描述，且临界点处φ的两点关联函数随距离增长，与理论预期一致。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 态-算符对应（识别临界点与标度维度）、玻色化（施温格模型）、Polyakov-Hubbard变换（其他模型）、数值计算（两点关联函数）。

papers.title: Operational Tube-Sector Theory of Quantum State Distinguishability Under Generalized Symmetries
papers.abstract: A variational principle for quantum-state distinguishability is established in many-body systems with generalized symmetries, including noninvertible cases described by fusion categories. Standard fidelity and symmetry-resolved diagnostics emerge as coarse-grained limits of a more refined operational structure. When symmetry actions terminate at entanglement cuts, distinguishability is governed by boundary tube algebras within a symmetry-constrained measurement resource theory. The physically admissible instruments are characterized by complete positivity, entanglement-cut locality, boundary-module covariance, and sequential stability. The resulting optimal measurement structure is uniquely fixed by the center of the boundary tube algebra, $\mathcal{A}_{\mathrm{phys}} = Z\!\left(\mathrm{Tube}_{\mathcal{C}}(\mathcal{M}_A)\right)$, whose primitive idempotents define tube-sector probabilities that refine fidelity-based and symmetry-resolved descriptions. The associated tube positive-operator-valued measures (POVM) are extremal and yield optimal one-shot hypothesis-testing distinguishability under symmetry constraints. The construction is universal across fusion categories and independent of microscopic realization.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：variational principle（变分原理）、operational structure（操作结构）、measurement resource theory（测量资源理论）。；研究对象：具有广义对称性（包括由融合范畴描述的非可逆对称性）的多体量子系统中，量子态的可区分性问题。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 建立了量子态可区分性的变分原理，发现最优测量结构由边界管代数的中心唯一确定，其本原幂等元定义了管区概率，可细化基于保真度和对称性分辨的描述。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：建立了量子态可区分性的变分原理，发现最优测量结构由边界管代数的中心唯一确定，其本原幂等元定义了管区概率，可细化基于保真度和对称性分辨的描述。；创新点：将量子态可区分性理论推广到包含非可逆对称性的广义对称性情形，揭示了边界管代数中心作为最优测量结构的唯一决定因素，且该构造在融合范畴上具有普适性，不依赖于微观实现。
papers.method_zh: 采用操作性的管区理论框架，结合对称性约束下的测量资源理论，通过完全正定性、纠缠切割局域性、边界模协变性和序列稳定性来刻画物理上允许的测量仪器，并构造了极值管区正算子值测度（POVM）。

papers.title: String dynamics of a (2+1)D U(1) quantum link model on a digital quantum computer
papers.abstract: The (2+1)D U(1) pure gauge theory always exists in the confining phase, with strings of non-zero string tension giving a characteristic linear potential between static charges. This makes it a useful testing ground for quantum computing methods designed to study string dynamics of confining gauge theories. Here we implement a minimal U(1) quantum link model on a quantum computer with qubit degrees of freedom representing the dual height variables of the model. This facilitates an efficient realization of plaquette interactions and enables effective calculations of real-time dynamics that are inaccessible to traditional quantum Monte Carlo. A specifically tailored lattice geometry is chosen to match the heavy-hexagonal geometry of the IBM quantum hardware used here, minimizing non-adjacent qubit interactions. By performing quantum quenches from a simple initial string state, we probe the transverse quantum fluctuations of the string before it thermalizes. Our experimental results from digital quantum simulations, with up to 112 qubits, show good agreement with reference tensor-network calculations at short times and with thermal averages at long times. Near the phase transition, the quench dynamics exhibit large fluctuations of the initial string that extend across both spatial dimensions of the lattice. Nonetheless, our error-mitigated estimators from the quantum hardware also give accurate predictions in that regime, with noise-induced violations of local gauge symmetries comparable to finite-bond-dimension tensor-network results.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算）。关键词：digital quantum computer, quantum quenches, experimental results from digital quantum simulations, reference tensor-network calculations。；研究对象：(2+1)维U(1)量子链接模型中的弦动力学，具体为纯规范理论中静态电荷之间的弦张力及弦的量子涨落。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在数字量子计算机上实现了最多112个量子比特的U(1)量子链接模型模拟，实验观测到弦在热化前的横向量子涨落，并在相变附近观察到弦的大幅二维空间涨落；误差缓解后的量子硬件结果与短时张量网络计算及长时热平均结果吻合良好。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在数字量子计算机上实现了最多112个量子比特的U(1)量子链接模型模拟，实验观测到弦在热化前的横向量子涨落，并在相变附近观察到弦的大幅二维空间涨落；误差缓解后的量子硬件结果与短时张量网络计算及长时热平均结果吻合良好。；创新点：针对IBM量子硬件的重六边形几何定制晶格结构，最小化非相邻量子比特相互作用，从而在数字量子计算机上高效实现(2+1)D U(1)纯规范理论的实时弦动力学模拟，并成功在相变附近获得与张量网络一致的误差缓解结果。
papers.method_zh: 使用IBM量子硬件（重六边形几何）实现数字量子模拟；采用量子链接模型（qubit自由度表示对偶高度变量）高效实现plaquette相互作用；通过量子淬火从简单初始弦态出发探测弦动力学；使用误差缓解技术处理局域规范对称性的噪声诱导破坏；参考张量网络计算进行对比验证。

papers.title: sft-wick: A formalism and package for Feynman-diagram expansion and evaluation in stochastic field theories
papers.abstract: When stochastic field dynamics are cast into a path-integral formulation, perturbation theory becomes systematic but the resulting expansion quickly grows combinatorially large. The setting targeted here includes multi-component, multi-dimensional fields with matrix propagators, tensor-valued couplings, and non-Gaussian driving noise specified by arbitrary $n$-point cumulants. Wick pairings grow factorially, and component indices must be routed through the tensor-valued vertices. The useful output is not a raw contraction list, but a diagram table: one entry per topology, with multiplicities, coupling sums, signs, and causal constraints resolved. We present sft-wick, an open-source Python package that constructs these diagram tables and computes their integrals numerically. Given an action and an observable, it enumerates topologically distinct Feynman diagrams, derives their algebraic coefficients, and evaluates the resulting diagram integrals from user-supplied response and cumulant functions. The core algorithm enumerates spatial topologies before routing component indices, avoiding contraction-by-contraction Wick expansion. Response-field constraints, including vanishing response-response contractions, the ito prescription, and the absence of causal response loops, are enforced during enumeration. Predictions are validated against direct Langevin simulation, agreeing to within the simulation's statistical noise.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：提出了新的形式化方法（formalism）并开发了开源软件包（open-source Python package），用于计算（computes their integrals numerically）。；研究对象：随机场理论（stochastic field theories）中的费曼图展开与计算。具体针对多分量、多维场，包含矩阵传播子、张量值耦合以及由任意n点累积量描述的非高斯驱动噪声的系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 开发了名为 sft-wick 的开源 Python 包，能够自动构建随机场理论中拓扑不同的费曼图表格，计算其代数系数和数值积分，其预测结果与直接朗之万模拟在统计噪声范围内一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：开发了名为 sft-wick 的开源 Python 包，能够自动构建随机场理论中拓扑不同的费曼图表格，计算其代数系数和数值积分，其预测结果与直接朗之万模拟在统计噪声范围内一致。；创新点：提出了一种新的枚举算法，该算法在路由分量指标之前先枚举空间拓扑，避免了组合爆炸式的Wick收缩。同时，在枚举过程中自动强制执行响应场约束（如响应-响应收缩为零、伊藤规则、无因果响应环），从而直接生成包含拓扑、多重性、耦合求和、符号和因果约束的完整图表格，而非原始的收缩列表。
papers.method_zh: 基于路径积分形式（path-integral formulation）的微扰理论。核心算法是先枚举空间拓扑结构，再路由分量指标，从而避免逐个收缩的Wick展开。通过用户提供的响应函数和累积量函数，计算费曼图积分。软件包为 sft-wick。

papers.title: Moreau-Yosida-based Kohn-Sham Inversion for Periodic Systems
papers.abstract: Density-potential inversion for periodic systems within Moreau-Yosida-regularised density-functional theory is investigated, both theoretically and numerically. We develop the framework in a periodic homogeneous Sobolev space and use it to recover the exchange-correlation potential of Kohn-Sham theory through a limiting procedure. A key analytical ingredient is the proof of lower semicontinuity of the non-interacting kinetic-energy functional in the chosen topology. The proximal mapping, together with its algorithmic evaluation, plays a central role in the resulting inversion scheme. Numerical experiments illustrate the performance and properties of the method for both the Kohn-Sham and Gross-Pitaevskii equations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有数值计算）。判断依据：关键词“theoretically and numerically”、“framework”、“proof”、“algorithmic evaluation”、“Numerical experiments”。；研究对象：周期性体系中的密度-势反演问题，具体针对Kohn-Sham理论和Gross-Pitaevskii方程中的交换关联势恢复。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过Moreau-Yosida正则化密度泛函理论，在周期均匀Sobolev空间中建立了密度-势反演框架，并证明了非相互作用动能泛函在所选拓扑下的下半连续性，从而通过极限过程恢复Kohn-Sham交换关联势。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过Moreau-Yosida正则化密度泛函理论，在周期均匀Sobolev空间中建立了密度-势反演框架，并证明了非相互作用动能泛函在所选拓扑下的下半连续性，从而通过极限过程恢复Kohn-Sham交换关联势。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: Moreau-Yosida正则化密度泛函理论框架、周期均匀Sobolev空间分析、近端映射（proximal mapping）及其算法实现、数值实验验证。

papers.title: Solving Nonequilibrium Dynamics via Influence Matrix Bootstrap: Floquet-PXP Model
papers.abstract: Studies of integrable systems have profoundly deepened the fundamental understanding of quantum many-body physics. While equilibrium properties such as ground states and thermodynamics can often be characterized efficiently, accurately characterizing nonequilibrium integrable dynamics remains a significant challenge. Here, we address this problem in the "Rule 201" quantum cellular automaton, an integrable Trotterization of the PXP Hamiltonian. Using the tensor-network approach of the influence matrix, we develop local conditions called generalized zipper conditions that allow exact solutions of local dynamics. We also introduce a numerical bootstrap method for solving influence matrices with finite but relatively large bond dimensions. This uncovers a rich landscape of nonequilibrium behavior exhibiting initial-state dependence. As an example, we investigate the fate of persistent oscillating dynamics under local non-integrable perturbations, and present analytical results for non-thermal relaxation constrained by conservation laws. We also obtain numerically exact results for entanglement growth across a broad class of initial states. Furthermore, from an information-theoretic perspective, we identify a refined structure of multitime correlations termed the hidden Markov order: the memory encoded in the dynamics separates into finite-length and long-range distributed components, which becomes transparent in an exact split-index matrix-product-state representation of the influence matrix. Our approach enables unified investigations of nonthermalizing and thermalizing regimes of nonequilibrium dynamics within a single analytically tractable model, and can be tested experimentally in state-of-the-art quantum simulators such as Rydberg atom arrays.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：tensor-network approach、numerical bootstrap method、analytical results）；研究对象：非平衡可积量子动力学，具体为“Rule 201”量子元胞自动机（PXP哈密顿量的可积Trotter化）及其在Floquet-PXP模型中的动力学行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过影响矩阵的张量网络方法，发展出广义拉链条件，实现了局域动力学的精确求解；揭示了非平衡动力学中依赖于初始态的丰富行为，包括守恒律约束下的非热弛豫和纠缠增长。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过影响矩阵的张量网络方法，发展出广义拉链条件，实现了局域动力学的精确求解；揭示了非平衡动力学中依赖于初始态的丰富行为，包括守恒律约束下的非热弛豫和纠缠增长。；创新点：首次将影响矩阵自举法应用于可积量子元胞自动机，建立了非热化与热化动力学在单一可解模型中的统一研究框架；识别出动力学中多时间关联的隐马尔可夫序结构（记忆分为有限长和长程分布两部分）。
papers.method_zh: 影响矩阵的张量网络方法、广义拉链条件（local generalized zipper conditions）、数值自举法（numerical bootstrap method）求解有限但较大键维的影响矩阵；精确分裂指标矩阵乘积态表示。

papers.title: A Hybrid GNN-FEM Framework for Phase-Field Fracture Simulation. Physics-Preserving Hybridization for Generalizable Surrogate Modeling
papers.abstract: Scientific machine learning (SciML) has emerged as a promising approach for accelerating simulations of complex physical systems, yet achieving physically consistent and generalizable predictions for nonlinear, history-dependent problems remains a central challenge. In this study, we propose a hybrid GNN--FEM framework for efficient and generalizable phase-field fracture modeling. While phase-field approaches provide a robust variational framework for simulating complex crack evolution, their high computational cost limits practical applications because they require solving coupled, nonlinear, and history-dependent systems within an incremental finite element procedure. To address this challenge, a graph neural network surrogate is integrated into the conventional staggered scheme, replacing the phase-field update at each load increment while retaining the FEM-based displacement solver to enforce mechanical equilibrium and boundary conditions. By preserving the incremental solution structure, the framework remains consistent with history-dependent fracture evolution without requiring the surrogate to approximate the full solution trajectory. This selective surrogate strategy emphasizes the identification of a physically meaningful and incrementally structured learning target, rather than relying on brute-force data generation to learn the full fracture process. The proposed framework achieves strong generalization across varying geometries, loading conditions, material properties, and discretizations through dimensionless feature design, a graph-based formulation on mesh-based domains, and a physics-informed loss derived from the governing phase-field equation. Numerical experiments demonstrate that the hybrid approach reduces computational cost while maintaining accuracy compared with conventional FEM, and exhibits robust predictive performance across diverse problem settings.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：scientific machine learning, surrogate modeling, graph neural network, finite element method, numerical experiments。；研究对象：相场断裂模拟（phase-field fracture modeling），即模拟固体材料中裂纹萌生与扩展的物理过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一种混合图神经网络-有限元（GNN-FEM）框架，通过用GNN替代相场更新步骤、保留FEM位移求解器，在保持物理一致性的前提下显著降低计算成本，并在不同几何、载荷、材料属性和离散化条件下展现出良好的泛化能力。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一种混合图神经网络-有限元（GNN-FEM）框架，通过用GNN替代相场更新步骤、保留FEM位移求解器，在保持物理一致性的前提下显著降低计算成本，并在不同几何、载荷、材料属性和离散化条件下展现出良好的泛化能力。；创新点：提出一种“选择性代理策略”，即不要求代理模型学习整个断裂过程的完整轨迹，而是仅替代增量求解结构中的相场更新部分，从而保持与历史依赖断裂演化的物理一致性，并利用增量结构化的学习目标实现高效泛化。
papers.method_zh: 混合计算方法：将图神经网络（GNN）作为代理模型（surrogate），嵌入到传统的交错求解方案（staggered scheme）中，替代每个载荷增量步的相场更新；同时保留基于有限元法（FEM）的位移求解器以强制执行力学平衡和边界条件。采用无量纲特征设计、基于网格域的图表示，以及源自控制相场方程的物理信息损失函数（physics-informed loss）进行训练。

papers.title: Physics-Informed Discovery of Yield Functions in Plasticity via Convex Neural Representations
papers.abstract: Identifying anisotropic yield functions remains challenging since yielding is not directly observed in full-field mechanical measurements, directional calibration can require many loading directions, and selecting an appropriate analytical form is nontrivial. This study proposes a physics-informed framework for discovering yield functions from full-field displacement data and reaction force data, without stress observations, plastic strain measurements, direct yield surface data, or a prescribed parametric yield function. The framework identifies the yield function as a mechanically constrained constitutive component inside elastoplastic stress integration, rather than through direct stress-space supervision. The yield function is represented by a convex neural network that enforces convexity and positive homogeneity of degree one while imposing the assumed tension-compression symmetry, and this neural yield function is trained with a differentiable stress update and a physics-informed force equilibrium loss across multiple loading cases. The proposed framework is validated using finite element (FE) benchmark studies with von Mises, Hill 1948, and Yld2000-2d yield functions, assessing yield contour agreement, displacement-noise sensitivity, identifiability through plastically active stress states, epistemic uncertainty, and polynomial-surrogate deployment. This study provides a mechanics-constrained pathway for discovering anisotropic yield functions from displacement and force data while keeping the identified component within the structure of elastoplastic stress integration.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：提出了一个基于物理信息的计算框架，并通过有限元基准研究进行验证，未涉及实验测量。；研究对象：各向异性屈服函数（von Mises, Hill 1948, Yld2000-2d）的识别与发现。具体物理现象为金属塑性中的屈服行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种无需应力观测、塑性应变测量或预设参数化形式的物理信息框架，能够仅从全场位移数据和反力数据中，通过凸神经网络表示并成功识别出各向异性屈服函数。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种无需应力观测、塑性应变测量或预设参数化形式的物理信息框架，能够仅从全场位移数据和反力数据中，通过凸神经网络表示并成功识别出各向异性屈服函数。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但根据内容，主要创新在于：1）将屈服函数的识别问题转化为一个受力学约束的、嵌入弹塑性应力积分框架内的神经网络学习问题，而非传统的应力空间监督学习；2）仅依赖全场位移和反力数据，无需直接观测屈服面数据或应力/塑性应变测量。
papers.method_zh: 采用凸神经网络表示屈服函数，并强制其满足凸性和一阶正齐次性以及拉压对称性。该网络作为力学约束的本构组件嵌入到可微分的弹塑性应力积分过程中，通过多加载工况下的物理信息力平衡损失函数进行训练。通过有限元基准研究（使用von Mises, Hill 1948, Yld2000-2d屈服函数）进行验证。

papers.title: Nonequilibrium steady states induced by stochastic mid-circuit measurements and resets on a quantum computer
papers.abstract: Stochastic resetting has emerged as a versatile protocol to drive quantum many-body systems to non-equilibrium steady states by interspersing unitary dynamics with measurements and resets at random times. In spite of this, a quantum hardware validation of such non-equilibrium steady states is still missing. Here, we achieve this goal by first formulating a noisy discrete-time theory where unitary gates alternate with noisy mid-circuit projective measurements and conditional resets. This noisy conditional resetting theory is then demonstrated on a superconducting quantum processor for up to $N=7$ qubits. We consider, as a paradigmatic case, the unitary dynamics of the interacting Floquet transverse-field Ising model. The stationary state of the noisy conditional resetting agrees quantitatively with the experiments, and it shows crossover behavior related to the equilibrium quantum phase transition of the model. Our results might thus pave the way for the preparation of collective stationary states on noisy quantum devices and for further developments of quantum algorithms involving mid-circuit measurements.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（理论+实验）。判断依据：摘要中明确提出了“noisy discrete-time theory”（含噪声的离散时间理论），并随后在“superconducting quantum processor”（超导量子处理器）上进行了实验验证。；研究对象：由随机量子测量和重置（stochastic mid-circuit measurements and resets）驱动的量子多体系统的非平衡稳态（nonequilibrium steady states）。具体模型为相互作用的Floquet横场伊辛模型（interacting Floquet transverse-field Ising model）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在含噪声的量子设备上，通过随机测量和重置协议可以制备并验证非平衡稳态。实验观测到的稳态与理论预测定量吻合，并展现出与模型平衡态量子相变相关的交叉行为（crossover behavior）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在含噪声的量子设备上，通过随机测量和重置协议可以制备并验证非平衡稳态。实验观测到的稳态与理论预测定量吻合，并展现出与模型平衡态量子相变相关的交叉行为（crossover behavior）。；创新点：首次在量子硬件上实验验证了由随机重置驱动的非平衡稳态。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 理论方面：构建了一个含噪声的离散时间理论框架，其中酉门操作与含噪声的中间电路投影测量及条件重置交替进行。实验方面：在超导量子处理器上，对最多N=7个量子比特的系统实现了该协议。

papers.title: Quantum circuit decomposition of the tangent-fermion Dirac operator
papers.abstract: The Dirac operator on a lattice cannot be both local and free of fermion doubling, at least not without breaking fundamental symmetries. Non-local, symmetry-preserving discretizations that avoid doubling have a quantum circuit representation as a linear-combination-of-unitaries (LCU) in which both the number of terms and their norm (the subnormalization factor) grow with the lattice size, compromising the efficiency of a quantum algorithm. We show that the tangent-fermion discretization escapes this obstruction when the Dirac equation is written as a generalized eigenvalue problem with a local operator pencil: Each member of the pencil has an exact LCU, with term count that is independent of lattice size and with subnormalization factor of order unity, on a par with elliptic operators. This provides an efficient block-encoding primitive for Dirac spectra and Green functions without fermion doubling.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要讨论量子电路分解、线性组合酉算子（LCU）、块编码等理论方法，未涉及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：格点狄拉克算子的离散化方案，具体为切向费米子（tangent-fermion）离散化在量子计算中的实现。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 切向费米子离散化避免了格点狄拉克算子中局域性与费米子倍增之间的折衷，其广义本征值问题中的每个算子铅笔成员都具有精确的LCU表示，且项数与格点尺寸无关、次归一化因子为量级1，从而实现了无费米子倍增的狄拉克谱和格林函数的高效块编码。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：切向费米子离散化避免了格点狄拉克算子中局域性与费米子倍增之间的折衷，其广义本征值问题中的每个算子铅笔成员都具有精确的LCU表示，且项数与格点尺寸无关、次归一化因子为量级1，从而实现了无费米子倍增的狄拉克谱和格林函数的高效块编码。；创新点：摘要未突出说明，但可推断：首次证明切向费米子离散化在量子电路分解中克服了非局域性和大次归一化因子的效率障碍，使得狄拉克算子的块编码效率可与椭圆算子相当。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：将狄拉克方程表述为局域算子铅笔的广义本征值问题，并构造其线性组合酉算子（LCU）分解，分析项数和次归一化因子随格点尺寸的标度行为。

papers.title: Topological spectral form factor reveals emergent non-Hermitian single-particle $\mathcal{PT}$ transitions from many-body quantum chaos
papers.abstract: In equilibrium physics, topological defect insertions in quantum and classical partition functions provide non-perturbative probes of phase transitions beyond local observables. In non-equilibrium physics, the spectral form factor provides a minimal probe of universal quantum dynamics, and admits a representation as a product of two partition functions at imaginary inverse temperature. We define the topological spectral form factor (TopSFF) by inserting topological defects acting non-trivially on the doubled partition functions, producing mismatched spacetime world-sheet topologies. For the minimal $\mathbb{Z}_2$ spatially extended defect, implemented by the global swap operator, we derive an exact mapping of the TopSFF of a generic 1D many-body chaotic system to an emergent $(3+1)$D non-Hermitian single-particle problem describing a temporal domain wall (tDW). We show analytically that the effective tDW dynamics undergoes a $\mathcal{PT}$ symmetry breaking transition at a finite interaction strength $ε_{\mathrm{EP}}$: below $ε_{\mathrm{EP}}$, the leading modes are polarized into Gaussian or non-Gaussian tDW sectors and the TopSFF varies monotonically and exponentially with system size; above $ε_{\mathrm{EP}}$, the tDW sectors hybridize and the TopSFF oscillates with system size; at the exceptional point $ε_{\mathrm{EP}}$, Jordan non-diagonality produces a linear-in-system-size enhancement. For temporally extended topological defects, we derive exact universal scaling forms for the TopSFF free energy in systems with time reversal or time translation symmetry, and verify them numerically in independent models.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：exact mapping、analytically show、derive exact universal scaling forms。；研究对象：一维多体混沌系统中的拓扑谱形因子（TopSFF），以及由其映射出的非厄米单粒子 $\mathcal{PT}$ 对称性破缺相变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在一维多体混沌系统中，拓扑谱形因子（TopSFF）可精确映射到一个（3+1）维非厄米单粒子问题，该问题描述一个时间畴壁（tDW），其动力学在有限相互作用强度 $\varepsilon_{\mathrm{EP}}$ 处经历 $\mathcal{PT}$ 对称性破缺相变，导致 TopSFF 随系统大小的行为从指数单调变化转变为振荡，并在异常点处出现线性增强。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在一维多体混沌系统中，拓扑谱形因子（TopSFF）可精确映射到一个（3+1）维非厄米单粒子问题，该问题描述一个时间畴壁（tDW），其动力学在有限相互作用强度 $\varepsilon_{\mathrm{EP}}$ 处经历 $\mathcal{PT}$ 对称性破缺相变，导致 TopSFF 随系统大小的行为从指数单调变化转变为振荡，并在异常点处出现线性增强。；创新点：首次将拓扑缺陷插入与谱形因子结合，定义了拓扑谱形因子（TopSFF），并揭示了多体量子混沌与单粒子非厄米 $\mathcal{PT}$ 相变之间的精确映射关系。
papers.method_zh: 通过插入全局交换算符等拓扑缺陷，将拓扑谱形因子（TopSFF）定义为双份配分函数的非平凡乘积，并利用精确映射将其转化为（3+1）维非厄米单粒子时间畴壁（tDW）问题，进行解析分析；对于时间扩展的拓扑缺陷，推导了具有时间反演或时间平移对称性系统中 TopSFF 自由能的普适标度形式，并在独立模型中进行数值验证。

papers.title: Exclusion Statistics as a Thermodynamic Resource in Quantum Heat Engines
papers.abstract: The maximum power extractable from a quantum thermoelectric heat engine operating with free fermion carriers is bounded by the universal Whitney limit, $P_{\text{fermion}}^{\max} \simeq 0.0321π^2 k_B^2(T_L-T_R)^2/h$. We demonstrate that this bound is not fundamental to quantum heat engines but is instead an artifact of fermionic statistics. Within the nonlinear Landauer-Büttiker framework, a bosonic working medium yields a strictly enhanced universal maximum power, $P_{\text{boson}}^{\max} = (\ln 2)^2\, k_B^2(T_L-T_R)^2/h$, exceeding the fermionic limit by a factor of $(\ln 2)^2/(0.0321π^2) \approx 1.52$. We propose magnon transport through a ferromagnetic spin chain as an experimentally viable bosonic realization. Incorporating Haldane fractional exclusion statistics with parameter $g$ provides a continuous interpolation between the bosonic ($g = 0$) and fermionic ($g = 1$) limits, revealing a monotonic enhancement of maximum power for $g < 1$ at reduced bias cost. These results establish quantum statistical exclusion as a previously unrecognized and independently tunable thermodynamic resource, opening performance regimes inaccessible to conventional carrier-engineering approaches.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“demonstrate”“propose”“provides”等理论推导和模型构建关键词，未涉及具体实验数据或计算模拟。；研究对象：量子热机中的载流子统计（费米子、玻色子及分数排斥统计）对最大输出功率的影响，具体体系包括自由费米子、玻色子工作介质以及通过铁磁自旋链实现的磁振子输运。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 费米子量子热机的最大功率上限（Whitney极限）并非普适，而是源于费米统计；采用玻色子工作介质可获得严格增强的最大功率，其值约为费米子极限的1.52倍。引入Haldane分数排斥统计参数g可实现从玻色子（g=0）到费米子（g=1）的连续调控，且g<1时最大功率单调增强。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：费米子量子热机的最大功率上限（Whitney极限）并非普适，而是源于费米统计；采用玻色子工作介质可获得严格增强的最大功率，其值约为费米子极限的1.52倍。引入Haldane分数排斥统计参数g可实现从玻色子（g=0）到费米子（g=1）的连续调控，且g<1时最大功率单调增强。；创新点：首次将量子统计排斥（费米子/玻色子/分数统计）识别为一种独立可调的“热力学资源”，突破了传统载流子工程（如能带调控）对热机性能的限制。
papers.method_zh: 基于非线性Landauer-Büttiker输运框架进行理论分析，提出通过铁磁自旋链中的磁振子输运作为玻色子体系的实验实现方案，并利用Haldane分数排斥统计进行参数化插值。

papers.title: On operator product expansion in the spin-orbit coupled bosonic system
papers.abstract: Ultra-cold bosonic systems can be tuned to exhibit quantum phase transitions. For example, the Rabi-coupled bosonic system exhibits ferromagnetic and paramagnetic phases, whereas the spin-orbit-coupled system exhibits exciting phases such as supersolidity. The physics of these phases and phase transitions is very rich. It is an important topic of research to probe these phases and phase transitions using various tools in many-body physics. The operator product expansion (OPE) provides one such tool. It expresses the product of two separated operators as a series expansion of local operators. In this article, we will derive the OPE of two operators $ψ^\dagger_σ(\vec r)$ and $ψ_{σ'}(\vec r')$. More specifically, we look for the contact density term, which controls many of the universal physics of the underlying bosonic system.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“derive the OPE”（推导算子乘积展开）、“operator product expansion”（算子乘积展开）、“many-body physics”（多体物理），属于理论推导。；研究对象：自旋-轨道耦合玻色子系统中的量子相变与算子乘积展开（OPE），具体关注超冷玻色子体系中的铁磁相、顺磁相以及超固态等新奇相。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 推导了自旋-轨道耦合玻色子系统中两个场算符ψ†_σ(r)和ψ_σ'(r')的算子乘积展开（OPE），并重点提取了控制该玻色子系统普适物理的接触密度项。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：推导了自旋-轨道耦合玻色子系统中两个场算符ψ†_σ(r)和ψ_σ'(r')的算子乘积展开（OPE），并重点提取了控制该玻色子系统普适物理的接触密度项。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用多体物理中的算子乘积展开（OPE）理论框架，对超冷玻色子系统的场算符乘积进行解析展开，寻找局域算符的级数表达形式。

papers.title: Theory of nonlinear spin transport in chiral conductors
papers.abstract: The chirality-induced spin selectivity (CISS) effect, discovered by Naaman and collaborators in 1999, describes the emergence of a finite spin polarization in response to current flow through a chiral electronic system. While extensive experimental studies have verified the presence of CISS in molecular systems and, more recently, in chiral materials, a complete microscopic understanding of this effect remains elusive. In this work, we propose a theoretical framework linking the CISS effect to the orbital Edelstein effect. In the latter, a drive current induces a finite orbital magnetization, even in the absence of spin-orbit coupling. Our non-equilibrium theory naturally explains key features of the CISS effect: its persistence in systems with weak or vanishingly small spin-orbit coupling and its connection to natural optical activity, a distinctive signature of chiral systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“propose a theoretical framework”、“non-equilibrium theory”。；研究对象：手性导体中的非线性自旋输运现象，具体为手性诱导自旋选择性（CISS）效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出CISS效应与轨道Edelstein效应之间存在理论联系，即驱动电流可在无自旋-轨道耦合的情况下诱导出有限轨道磁化，从而自然解释CISS效应在弱自旋-轨道耦合体系中的持续存在及其与自然光学活性的关联。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出CISS效应与轨道Edelstein效应之间存在理论联系，即驱动电流可在无自旋-轨道耦合的情况下诱导出有限轨道磁化，从而自然解释CISS效应在弱自旋-轨道耦合体系中的持续存在及其与自然光学活性的关联。；创新点：将CISS效应的微观起源从自旋-轨道耦合机制转向轨道Edelstein效应，为理解手性体系中无自旋-轨道耦合时的自旋极化输运提供了新理论视角。
papers.method_zh: 非平衡理论框架（non-equilibrium theory），将CISS效应与轨道Edelstein效应进行类比和推导。

papers.title: Spin point group symmetry and classification of non-relativistic spin splitting in non-collinear magnetic structures: Identification of high-order spin splitting types (l=5,7, and 9)
papers.abstract: A comprehensive study of the possible types of non-relativistic spin splitting of electronic bands in coplanar and non-coplanar magnetic structures is presented on the basis of spin-group theory. First, we tabulate all non-equivalent spin point groups (SpPGs) which can be expressed as a direct product of a nontrivial part and a spin-only group limited to be the intrinsic (trivial) one, or augmented by the time-reversal (TR) operation. This tabulation, which includes the listing of symmetry operations for 1249 nonequivalent SpPGs, is now available as an online database SPGENPOS in the Bilbao Crystallographic Server (BCS). This extends previous enumerations, in which the possible presence of TR in the magnetic point group was not taken into account, thus overlooking the full SpPG symmetry associated with the numerous magnetic structures which have a magnetic space group of type IV. For each of the listed coplanar and non-coplanar SpPGs, the spin-splitting that is symmetry allowed is analyzed in detail using the program STENSOR also in the BCS. Except for the SpPGs that include the operation 1', i.e., the combined operation of TR and space inversion, all other coplanar and non-coplanar SpPGs allow spin splitting at some order in a power expansion of the electron wave vector components. We find that, depending on the SpPG, spin-splitting terms can appear with the lowest-order monomials ranging from l=0 to 9, with the exception of l=8. This contrasts with the collinear case, where the lowest order is not higher than l=6, and where TR forbids any spin splitting. For the newly identified spin textures with powers l=5, 7, and 9, which are possible in some noncentrosymmetric SpPGs, the functional form of the spin splitting in terms of the components of the crystal momentum is given. One example of a real material, LaMnAu5, showing l=5 spin splitting is identified.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（基于自旋群理论进行对称性分析和分类，辅以数据库和计算程序，未涉及实验数据或第一性原理计算）。判断依据关键词：spin-group theory、tabulation、symmetry analysis、program STENSOR。；研究对象：共面和非共面非共线磁结构中电子能带的非相对论性自旋劈裂类型，特别是高阶自旋劈裂（l=5, 7, 9）的识别。具体材料实例为LaMnAu5。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在共面和非共面非共线磁结构中，自旋劈裂的最低阶次可从l=0到9（除l=8外）变化，远高于共线情况（最高l=6）。首次识别出l=5、7、9的自旋劈裂类型，并在非中心对称自旋点群中给出了其函数形式。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在共面和非共面非共线磁结构中，自旋劈裂的最低阶次可从l=0到9（除l=8外）变化，远高于共线情况（最高l=6）。首次识别出l=5、7、9的自旋劈裂类型，并在非中心对称自旋点群中给出了其函数形式。；创新点：首次将时间反演操作纳入自旋点群枚举，完整覆盖了IV型磁空间群对应的自旋点群对称性；发现了共面和非共面非共线磁结构中存在l=5、7、9的高阶自旋劈裂类型，并给出了具体函数形式，突破了共线情况下l≤6的限制。
papers.method_zh: 基于自旋点群（SpPG）理论，系统枚举了1249个非等价自旋点群，并利用Bilbao晶体学服务器（BCS）上的在线数据库SPGENPOS和程序STENSOR，分析了每个自旋点群所允许的自旋劈裂对称性。特别考虑了时间反演（TR）操作在磁点群中的存在性，弥补了此前对IV型磁空间群对应自旋点群分析的缺失。

papers.title: Mapping the non-equilibrium interacting Anderson Impurity Model to an effective Gaussian theory
papers.abstract: Quantum impurity models with strong electron correlations, such as the paradigmatic Anderson Impurity Model (AIM), are central to our understanding of a range of physical phenomena including local moment formation, Coulomb blockade and Kondo screening. They describe magnetic atoms and molecules on surfaces, quantum dot circuits, and correlated materials through dynamical mean field theory. The physics of such systems in strongly non-equilibrium conditions is particularly complex and challenging to capture, whereas Gaussian models of free fermions can be easily solved. Here we show that the time-evolving dynamics of the AIM after a quench can be described by a completely non-interacting version of the model, at the expense of coupling to additional static auxiliary degrees of freedom. Starting from the full solution of the quenched AIM using ED and DMRG, we study the properties of this mapping using numerical optimization, and uncover intriguing structure in the auxiliary system. The method allows us to understand interacting non-equilibrium dynamics through the simpler lens of an effective non-interacting system of larger dimension.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：mapping, effective Gaussian theory, numerical optimization）；研究对象：非平衡条件下的安德森杂质模型（Anderson Impurity Model, AIM），包括局域磁矩形成、库仑阻塞、近藤屏蔽等物理现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过引入额外的静态辅助自由度，可以将淬火后安德森杂质模型的非平衡时间演化动力学映射为一个完全无相互作用的有效高斯模型，从而用更大维度的无相互作用系统理解非平衡动力学。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过引入额外的静态辅助自由度，可以将淬火后安德森杂质模型的非平衡时间演化动力学映射为一个完全无相互作用的有效高斯模型，从而用更大维度的无相互作用系统理解非平衡动力学。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 使用精确对角化（ED）和密度矩阵重整化群（DMRG）求解淬火后的安德森杂质模型，并通过数值优化研究映射的性质。

papers.title: Direct large-area observation of subsurface plastic activity in conditioned copper electrodes
papers.abstract: High-field conditioning is the process by which radio-frequency structures in particle accelerators and other high-gradient devices reach their operating fields, yet the underlying physical mechanism remains an open question. Models and indirect measurements point to subsurface dislocation dynamics, but large-area structural measurements have been missing. We present electron backscatter diffraction measurements spanning millimeter-scale regions on a copper cathode conditioned at pulsed direct-current fields up to $\sim$80~MV/m in a sloped-anode geometry, which imposes a known gradient of field exposure across a single electrode. Across nine regions of interest spanning this exposure range, the mean intragrain misorientation of field-exposed regions exceeds that of unexposed references by $\sim$75\%; the difference is reproduced by three independent misorientation metrics and confirmed by Kolmogorov--Smirnov tests. To our knowledge, this is the first large-area observation of structural differences between conditioned and unconditioned regions of a high-field electrode. The misorientation separates into three tiers (high-field center and edge, low-field periphery, and unexposed reference) that match the spatial profile of the conditioning-state variable $E_S$ predicted by Monte Carlo simulations. These observations point to the evolving subsurface dislocation population as a candidate physical basis of conditioning.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：electron backscatter diffraction measurements、large-area observation、structural measurements。；研究对象：高场 conditioning 处理后的铜电极（copper cathode）中的亚表面位错活动（subsurface plastic activity）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在脉冲直流电场（~80 MV/m）conditioning 后的铜电极上，首次通过大面积结构测量观察到，场暴露区域的晶粒内平均取向差（intragrain misorientation）比未暴露参考区域高出约75%，且该差异与蒙特卡洛模拟预测的 conditioning 状态变量 E_S 的空间分布相匹配，表明亚表面位错群体演化是 conditioning 的物理基础。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在脉冲直流电场（~80 MV/m）conditioning 后的铜电极上，首次通过大面积结构测量观察到，场暴露区域的晶粒内平均取向差（intragrain misorientation）比未暴露参考区域高出约75%，且该差异与蒙特卡洛模拟预测的 conditioning 状态变量 E_S 的空间分布相匹配，表明亚表面位错群体演化是 conditioning 的物理基础。；创新点：首次在毫米级大面积上直接观测到 conditioned 与 unconditioned 高场电极区域之间的结构差异，为 conditioning 的位错机制提供了直接实验证据。
papers.method_zh: 电子背散射衍射（EBSD）测量，覆盖毫米级区域；采用斜阳极几何（sloped-anode geometry）在单个电极上施加已知的场暴露梯度；使用三种独立的取向差度量指标进行验证，并辅以 Kolmogorov–Smirnov 统计检验。

papers.title: Constriction-induced modulation of charging energy in a quantum Hall cavity
papers.abstract: Electronic Fabry-Pérot interferometers (FPIs) operating in the fractional quantum Hall regime are a key platform for probing anyonic braiding statistics, yet interpreting their interference signals is complicated by Coulomb charging effects, which are commonly treated as parasitic, static properties governed by the cavity's geometry and electrostatics. Here, using a gate-defined quantum Hall cavity tuned to the Coulomb-dominated regime, we demonstrate that the charging energy is in fact strongly and non-monotonically modulated by the magnetic field, varying by up to 60% over a range of only 100 mT. The effect appears exclusively when the quantum point contacts (QPCs) forming the cavity are weakly pinched off, i.e., in the strong cavity-to-lead coupling regime. By correlating the charging energy modulation with the QPC magneto-conductance, we attribute this behavior to field-dependent changes in local compressibility and electrostatic screening between the cavity and the leads, driven by the formation of incompressible fractional quantum Hall states within the constrictions. This result establishes QPC constrictions of quantum Hall cavities as active electrostatic elements rather than passive boundaries, revealing a dynamic screening mechanism, with direct consequences for the interpretation of interference measurements and the extraction of anyonic statistics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“using a gate-defined quantum Hall cavity”以及实验测量结果（如“correlating the charging energy modulation with the QPC magneto-conductance”）。；研究对象：门电压定义的量子霍尔腔（quantum Hall cavity）中的充电能量（charging energy）调制现象，具体涉及分数量子霍尔效应下的电子法布里-珀罗干涉仪（Fabry-Pérot interferometer）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在量子霍尔腔中，充电能量会随磁场发生强烈且非单调的调制，变化幅度可达60%（在仅100 mT的磁场范围内）。该效应仅在量子点接触（QPC）处于弱夹断（强腔-引线耦合）时出现，并归因于QPC收缩区内不可压缩分数量子霍尔态形成导致的局域可压缩性和静电屏蔽的场依赖变化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在量子霍尔腔中，充电能量会随磁场发生强烈且非单调的调制，变化幅度可达60%（在仅100 mT的磁场范围内）。该效应仅在量子点接触（QPC）处于弱夹断（强腔-引线耦合）时出现，并归因于QPC收缩区内不可压缩分数量子霍尔态形成导致的局域可压缩性和静电屏蔽的场依赖变化。；创新点：揭示了量子霍尔腔的QPC收缩区并非被动的边界，而是活跃的静电元件，其局域可压缩性和静电屏蔽会随磁场动态变化，从而主动调制腔的充电能量。这一发现挑战了以往将充电能量视为由腔几何和静电决定的静态、寄生性质的常规观点，对解释干涉测量和提取任意子统计具有直接影响。
papers.method_zh: 实验上使用门电压定义的量子霍尔腔，将其调至库仑主导（Coulomb-dominated） regime，通过测量充电能量随磁场的变化，并与QPC的磁导（magneto-conductance）进行关联分析。

papers.title: Cavity Enhanced Superconductivity
papers.abstract: Vacuum electromagnetic fluctuations have recently emerged as a promising means of controlling collective quantum phases. Although cavity-induced modifications of superconductivity have been widely predicted, experimental studies have so far reported only suppression of superconducting properties. Here, by carefully tuning a terahertz cavity to resonate with key phononic modes in few-layer niobium diselenide (NbSe2), we demonstrate cavity-enhanced superconductivity in few-layer NbSe2 coupled to a complementary split-ring resonator. In trilayer NbSe2, the superconducting transition temperature increases by ~10%, from 3.02 K to 3.41 K, when coupled to a cavity resonant at 2.04 THz. The enhancement exhibits a clear spatial dependence following the cavity field profile and a non-monotonic frequency dependence, with maximal enhancement near 2 THz. These results provide experimental evidence that vacuum electromagnetic fields can enhance superconductivity and establish cavity engineering as a powerful platform for tailoring quantum materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：“experimental studies”、“demonstrate”、“experimental evidence”。；研究对象：少层二硒化铌（NbSe₂）耦合到互补开口谐振环（complementary split-ring resonator）的体系，具体研究太赫兹腔对超导电性的调控。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过将太赫兹腔精确调谐至与少层NbSe₂的关键声子模式共振，首次实验证明真空电磁场可以增强超导电性，使三层NbSe₂的超导转变温度从3.02 K提升至3.41 K（提升约10%）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过将太赫兹腔精确调谐至与少层NbSe₂的关键声子模式共振，首次实验证明真空电磁场可以增强超导电性，使三层NbSe₂的超导转变温度从3.02 K提升至3.41 K（提升约10%）。；创新点：此前理论预测腔可调控超导，但实验仅观察到超导性质被抑制；本工作首次实验实现腔增强超导电性，并揭示了增强效应与腔场空间分布及频率的关联，确立了腔工程作为调控量子材料的新平台。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用太赫兹腔（互补开口谐振环）与少层NbSe₂耦合，通过调谐腔共振频率（2.04 THz）与材料声子模式匹配，测量超导转变温度的变化，并分析增强效应的空间分布（与腔场分布一致）和频率依赖性（非单调，在2 THz附近最大）。

papers.title: AdsMind: A Physics-Grounded Multi-Agent System for Self-Correcting Discovery of Adsorption Configurations on Heterogeneous Catalyst Surfaces
papers.abstract: Identifying the lowest-energy surface-adsorbate configuration is critical for modeling heterogeneous catalysis, yet exhaustive exploration with ab initio calculations is computationally prohibitive. Machine-learning force fields (MLFFs) accelerate structural relaxation but leave the search over the vast configurational space a major bottleneck, and open-loop large language model (LLM) agents lack a physics-grounded feedback mechanism to correct erroneous initial guesses. We propose AdsMind (Adsorption configuration discovery with Machine intelligence and relaxation feedback), a closed-loop multi-agent framework that enables autonomous error correction through MLFF relaxation feedback. Across four LLM backends, AdsMind achieves consistently high search reliability, with success rates of 100% and 98.8% on the benchmarks AA20 and OCD-GMAE62. Relative to its single-pass (1-Shot) ablation it reduces cross-backend energy dispersion, and it uses only 4.11 and 4.67 MLFF relaxations per case, respectively -- an approximately 14-fold reduction over heuristic enumeration baselines. Density functional theory (DFT) validation using VASP/PBE on six representative AA20 systems shows that the reported open-loop Adsorb-Agent outputs exhibit qualitative adsorption-energy sign errors for molecular adsorbates, whereas AdsMind preserves the correct sign in all tested cases with closer quantitative agreement. AdsMind thus delivers reliability, self-reflection, and interpretability simultaneously, supporting more DFT-informed autonomous chemistry workflows.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据关键词：machine-learning force fields (MLFF)、density functional theory (DFT)、ab initio calculations、structural relaxation。；研究对象：多相催化剂表面上的吸附构型（adsorption configurations on heterogeneous catalyst surfaces），具体寻找最低能量的表面-吸附物构型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种名为AdsMind的闭环多智能体框架，通过机器学习力场（MLFF）弛豫反馈实现自主纠错，在AA20和OCD-GMAE62基准测试上分别达到100%和98.8%的成功率，且仅需少量MLFF弛豫次数（每案例约4-5次），相比启发式枚举基线减少约14倍。DFT验证表明，该框架能纠正开放循环方法中出现的吸附能符号错误。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种名为AdsMind的闭环多智能体框架，通过机器学习力场（MLFF）弛豫反馈实现自主纠错，在AA20和OCD-GMAE62基准测试上分别达到100%和98.8%的成功率，且仅需少量MLFF弛豫次数（每案例约4-5次），相比启发式枚举基线减少约14倍。DFT验证表明，该框架能纠正开放循环方法中出现的吸附能符号错误。；创新点：提出了一种基于物理反馈（MLFF弛豫反馈）的闭环多智能体框架，克服了开放循环大语言模型智能体缺乏物理纠错机制的局限，实现了自主纠错、高可靠性、自反思和可解释性，并显著降低了计算成本。
papers.method_zh: 采用闭环多智能体系统（multi-agent system），结合机器学习力场（MLFF）进行结构弛豫，并以弛豫反馈作为物理基础的纠错机制。使用VASP/PBE进行密度泛函理论（DFT）验证。对比了四种大语言模型（LLM）后端，并与单次（1-Shot）消融实验及启发式枚举基线进行了比较。

papers.title: Controllable Growth and Characterization of α- and β-phase MnSe by Chemical Vapor Deposition
papers.abstract: Manganese selenide (MnSe) is a promising air-stable two-dimensional magnetic semiconductor for which theory predicts robust ferromagnetism in monolayers with Curie temperatures approaching 250 K. However, the crystallographic phases and magnetic properties of thin-film MnSe grown by scalable methods remain poorly understood. Here, we demonstrate the controllable growth of $α$- and $β$-phase MnSe on C-face sapphire using a three-zone chemical vapor deposition process with elemental Se and ${MnCl_{2}}$ precursors in an $Ar/{H_{2}}$ atmosphere. Using Raman spectroscopy, atomic force microscopy, scanning electron microscopy, and X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy, we show that our process yields phase-pure $α$-MnSe nanorods and $β$-MnSe triangular flakes with lateral sizes up to 20 $μm$ and thicknesses of 15-30 nm. Low-temperature photoluminescence of the $β$-phase films reveals a bandgap of approximately 2.0 eV. Systematic variation of growth parameters shows that precursor vapor pressure, rather than ${H_{2}}$ partial pressure, is the dominant factor controlling lateral flake size. Vibrating-sample magnetometry measurements reveal a $N{é}el$ temperature of 53 K in the $β$-phase films, providing clear evidence of antiferromagnetism in the multilayer regime and establishing MnSe as a tunable platform for 2D spintronic and optoelectronic devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了化学气相沉积生长、多种表征手段（Raman、AFM、SEM、XPS、PL、VSM）等实验方法。；研究对象：α相和β相硒化锰（MnSe）薄膜的可控生长及其晶体结构与磁学性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过化学气相沉积成功实现了α-MnSe纳米棒和β-MnSe三角薄片的可控生长，并首次在多层β-MnSe中观测到奈尔温度为53 K的反铁磁性，证实其为可调控的二维自旋电子学与光电子学平台。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过化学气相沉积成功实现了α-MnSe纳米棒和β-MnSe三角薄片的可控生长，并首次在多层β-MnSe中观测到奈尔温度为53 K的反铁磁性，证实其为可调控的二维自旋电子学与光电子学平台。；创新点：首次通过可扩展的化学气相沉积方法实现α相和β相MnSe的相选择性生长，并系统揭示了前驱体蒸气压（而非H₂分压）是控制β相薄片横向尺寸的关键因素；同时提供了多层β-MnSe反铁磁性的明确实验证据。
papers.method_zh: 三温区化学气相沉积（使用Se和MnCl₂前驱体，Ar/H₂气氛）；拉曼光谱、原子力显微镜、扫描电子显微镜、X射线光电子能谱进行结构与形貌表征；低温光致发光谱测量带隙；振动样品磁强计测量磁性质。

papers.title: Generalized deformation potential and machine-learning approaches for electron-phonon coupling and thermoelectric transport in semiconductors
papers.abstract: The ability to compute electron-phonon coupling from first principles, using density functional perturbation theory and interpolation techniques, has enabled predictive calculations of electronic transport coefficients in crystalline materials. However, these methods are still computationally expensive. Here we present two inexpensive methods to obtain thermoelectric transport properties of semiconductors using a small number of electron-phonon matrix elements calculated from first principles. The first method combines models for coupling of electrons with different phonon modes whose parameters are obtained from $\sim 10$ matrix elements per electronic band and phonon mode calculated from first principles. Within this method, we formulate the acoustic deformation potential model for arbitrary crystal symmetries and band extrema locations. The second method uses machine learning to interpolate $\sim 100$ electron-phonon matrix elements per electronic band and phonon mode on dense reciprocal space grids in the parts of the Brillouin zone relevant for transport. We apply both methods to two-dimensional MoS$_2$ and show very good agreement with the state-of-the-art method. The calculated thermoelectric properties also agree well with experiments. We find that the machine-learning method is more accurate and straightforward to implement compared to the model approach.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：first principles（第一性原理）、density functional perturbation theory（密度泛函微扰理论）、machine learning（机器学习）。；研究对象：半导体材料中的电子-声子耦合及热电输运性质，具体以二维MoS₂为例。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了两种低成本方法（广义形变势模型和机器学习插值法），仅需少量第一性原理计算的电子-声子矩阵元即可准确获得半导体的热电输运性质，其中机器学习方法比模型方法更精确且更易实现。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了两种低成本方法（广义形变势模型和机器学习插值法），仅需少量第一性原理计算的电子-声子矩阵元即可准确获得半导体的热电输运性质，其中机器学习方法比模型方法更精确且更易实现。；创新点：提出了适用于任意晶体对称性和能带极值位置的广义形变势模型，并首次将机器学习用于少量电子-声子矩阵元的插值以高效计算热电输运性质，显著降低了计算成本。
papers.method_zh: 1. 广义形变势模型：针对任意晶体对称性和能带极值位置，通过每个电子带和声子模约10个第一性原理矩阵元拟合耦合参数。2. 机器学习方法：利用机器学习对布里渊区输运相关区域中每个电子带和声子模约100个矩阵元进行稠密网格插值。两种方法均基于第一性原理密度泛函微扰理论计算少量初始矩阵元。

papers.title: Evidence for Multiband Superconductivity in 2H-NbSeS
papers.abstract: The nature of superconductivity in 2H-NbSe2 has generated sustained debate in the recent past. While angle resolved photoemission spectroscopy data have been interpreted as evidence for multiband superconductivity, the data from scanning tunneling microscope experiments relate to strongly anisotropic single-band superconductivity. In the later case, the charge density wave (CDW) order mimics the multigap character. Because the CDW reconstructs the Fermi surface and modifies the superconducting gap distribution, disentangling intrinsic multiband pairing from CDW-related effects is challenging. To address this issue, we investigate single-crystalline 2H-NbSeS, a mixed-chalcogen analogue of 2H-NbSe2 in which random Se/S substitution suppresses long-range CDW order while preserving the layered crystal structure P63/mmc. The material becomes superconducting below 6.0 K with moderate magnetic anisotropy. The upper critical field exhibits a pronounced upward curvature that cannot be described within a single-band framework but is well captured by a dirty-limit two-band model with a large diffusivity ratio. This indicates strong band-dependent scattering. The in-plane upper critical field exceeds the weak-coupling Pauli limit. Measurements of the lower critical field, superfluid density, and electronic specific heat are consistent with an interpretation of a fully gapped superconducting state with two nodeless gaps of different magnitudes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：关键词包括“investigate single-crystalline”、“measurements of the upper critical field”、“lower critical field, superfluid density, and electronic specific heat”。；研究对象：2H-NbSeS，一种混合硫族元素的层状单晶，是2H-NbSe2的类似物，其中随机Se/S替代抑制了长程电荷密度波（CDW）序。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 2H-NbSeS表现出多带超导电性，其上临界场呈现明显的向上弯曲，无法用单带模型描述，但能被脏极限双带模型很好地拟合，表明存在强带依赖散射；同时超导态为全能隙、两个无节点超导能隙。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：2H-NbSeS表现出多带超导电性，其上临界场呈现明显的向上弯曲，无法用单带模型描述，但能被脏极限双带模型很好地拟合，表明存在强带依赖散射；同时超导态为全能隙、两个无节点超导能隙。；创新点：通过引入随机Se/S替代抑制CDW序，从而区分了本征多带配对与CDW相关效应，首次在2H-NbSeS中明确提供了多带超导电性的实验证据。
papers.method_zh: 单晶生长、磁化率与电阻率测量（确定超导转变温度6.0 K及磁各向异性）、上临界场与下临界场测量、超流密度测量、电子比热测量，并用脏极限双带模型拟合上临界场数据。

papers.title: Pore-shape and its spatial organization control intrinsic permeability of porous media
papers.abstract: The structure of a porous material, and in particular its spatial variability, is known to control the intrinsic permeability of the system. We investigate how dead-end pores influence the intrinsic permeability of a porous medium beyond their contribution to total pore volume. Dead-end pores are ubiquitous in porous media, yet they are often treated as hydraulically inactive regions whose influence is assumed to be negligible or absorbed into effective-porosity descriptions. We perform pore-scale flow simulations across different dead-end pore structures, including heterogeneous arrangements, controlled granular assemblies, and a minimal single-channel model to study their impact on the system macroscopic permeability. This strategy allows us to isolate the effects of dead-end pore density, depth, and orientation while preserving the transmitting network. We find that dead-end pores can influence intrinsic permeability: increasing the density of dead-end pores along percolating flow paths enhances permeability, whereas pore depth and junction orientation have negligible effects. The observed permeability enhancement originates from localized hydrodynamic interactions at junctions between transmitting and dead-end pores. Based on these results, we propose an effective formulation that relates the density and spatial organization of dead-end pores relative to the transmitting network to macroscopic permeability. Our findings show that dead-end pore architecture provides an additional geometric control on intrinsic permeability beyond porosity and pore-size statistics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：pore-scale flow simulations、数值模拟）；研究对象：多孔介质中死端孔隙（dead-end pores）对系统本征渗透率（intrinsic permeability）的影响，具体包括死端孔隙的密度、深度、取向及其空间分布。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 死端孔隙并非传统认为的水力惰性区域，其沿渗流路径的密度增加会显著提升本征渗透率，而孔隙深度和连接取向的影响可忽略；该增强效应源于传输孔与死端孔连接处的局部流体动力学相互作用。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：死端孔隙并非传统认为的水力惰性区域，其沿渗流路径的密度增加会显著提升本征渗透率，而孔隙深度和连接取向的影响可忽略；该增强效应源于传输孔与死端孔连接处的局部流体动力学相互作用。；创新点：揭示了死端孔隙的几何结构（而非仅孔隙率或孔径统计）是控制本征渗透率的额外因素，并提出了将死端孔隙相对于传输网络的密度与空间组织关联到宏观渗透率的有效公式。
papers.method_zh: 采用孔隙尺度流动模拟（pore-scale flow simulations），构建了异质排列、受控颗粒堆积以及最小单通道模型等多种死端孔隙结构，通过控制变量法隔离死端孔隙密度、深度和取向的影响，同时保持传输网络不变。

papers.title: Chiral Packings in Cylinders are Ultrasensitive to Confinement Deformation
papers.abstract: Sphere packings in circular cylinders have attracted substantial research interest, among which the discovery of chiral helical structures is the most iconic. However, recent experimental results on zebrafish do not match the known packing structures in circular cylinders. To account for the inherent imperfections of biological tubes, we take elliptic cylinders as the canonical deformation of circular cylinders and investigate the densest packings of hard spheres in them using simulation, theory, and experiments. Starting from the chiral structures in circular cylinders, we demonstrate that even a weak cross-sectional deformation can trigger entirely new phases, including ones that either eliminate global chirality or significantly complicate the chiral structures. This reveals the significant effect of cylindrical anisotropy. The new helical phases under anisotropic confinement remain chiral and develop hierarchical periodic structures, which are difficult to obtain by simulations but are predicted by our newly developed theory for helical phases in elliptic cylinders. The theory also predicts double oscillated-chain phases without chirality, which perfectly match the simulations. Our work offers fresh insights into understanding packings in anisotropic cylinders, which will help researchers to design new materials and to understand many living systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（模拟、理论、实验）。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“using simulation, theory, and experiments”。；研究对象：椭圆截面圆柱体内硬球的最密堆积结构，特别是手性螺旋堆积及其对截面变形的响应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 即使微弱的截面变形（从圆形变为椭圆形）也能触发全新的堆积相，包括消除全局手性或显著复杂化手性结构的相，揭示了圆柱各向异性的显著影响。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：即使微弱的截面变形（从圆形变为椭圆形）也能触发全新的堆积相，包括消除全局手性或显著复杂化手性结构的相，揭示了圆柱各向异性的显著影响。；创新点：首次系统研究了椭圆截面圆柱体（作为圆形柱的规范变形）对硬球手性堆积结构的影响，发现了截面变形可诱导全新手性相及非手性双振荡链相，并发展了相应的理论预测方法。
papers.method_zh: 采用计算机模拟（具体方法未明确说明）、理论分析（新发展的椭圆柱内螺旋相理论）以及实验验证（具体实验手段未明确说明）。

papers.title: Controlling magnetic domain walls with supercurrents
papers.abstract: Establishing a versatile, fast and reliable magnetic memory technology is a giant bottleneck for cryogenic computing since present-day room-temperature solutions either cease to work or consume too much power. The long-term goal of superconducting spintronics has been to overcome this bottleneck by generating magnetic memories with equal-spin triplet supercurrent driven through them to control their magnetization direction. This path has been hampered by the short spin relaxation length and strong anisotropy in ferromagnets. Here we show how the supercurrent driven generation of spin accumulation in a superconductor/magnetic insulator bilayer, together with Gilbert damping of magnetization lead to a motion of magnetic domain walls. This manifests as a local voltage across the wall, which allows its position to be identified. Associated with this voltage and the current, there is Joule power which is dissipated via the Gilbert damping. The power required to maintain domain wall motion is orders of magnitude smaller than in the normal state, where most of the power is wasted in producing the current.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：show how、manifest as、dissipated via（理论推导与机制分析）。；研究对象：超导/磁性绝缘体双层膜中的磁畴壁运动，以及超电流对其控制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过超电流在超导/磁性绝缘体界面产生自旋积累，结合吉尔伯特阻尼，可驱动磁畴壁运动，且维持该运动所需的焦耳功率比正常态低数个数量级。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过超电流在超导/磁性绝缘体界面产生自旋积累，结合吉尔伯特阻尼，可驱动磁畴壁运动，且维持该运动所需的焦耳功率比正常态低数个数量级。；创新点：提出利用超电流在超导/磁性绝缘体界面产生自旋积累（而非传统铁磁体中的等自旋三重态超电流）来驱动磁畴壁运动，并揭示其极低功耗特性。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：基于超电流驱动的自旋积累与吉尔伯特阻尼的耦合机制，推导磁畴壁运动导致的局域电压及功率耗散。

papers.title: Enucleated incompressible red blood cells in shear flow: theoretical analysis of shape instabilities
papers.abstract: Red blood cells (RBCs) are essential for oxygen transport, and their remarkable ability to undergo significant deformations during flow is a crucial feature for their physiological function. At intermediate shear rates typical of the microcirculation, RBCs can adopt complex, multi-lobed shapes, signifying a dynamic instability. Here we adopt a perturbative theoretical framework of a quasi-spherical RBC under external shear flow to study such shape instabilities. To better capture RBC maturation and enucleation, we first extend the framework to explicitly account for different excess areas between the stress-free and current membrane shapes. We revisit the reduced equations of motion obtained for an ellipsoidally-shaped RBC, and demonstrate the effect of different excess areas and initial orientation on the dynamical trajectories. Then, we introduce additional spatial modes and show that an emerging instability critically depends on the RBC's shear and bending moduli, the internal to external viscosity ratio, and the excess area, mainly through the RBC's membrane tension. We also study the instability-induced saturation of the membrane tension, and the resulting excess area redistribution at long times. The theoretical framework and the emerging picture of the different instabilities provide insights into the emergence of stomatocyte and trilobe shapes exhibited by RBCs under external flow.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词为“perturbative theoretical framework”、“theoretical analysis”、“reduced equations of motion”。；研究对象：在剪切流中准球形红细胞的形状不稳定性，特别是多叶形状（如 stomatocyte 和 trilobe 形状）的动态涌现机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 红细胞在中等剪切率下出现的形状不稳定性关键取决于其剪切模量、弯曲模量、内外粘度比以及过剩面积（主要通过膜张力调控）；理论框架揭示了膜张力饱和及过剩面积再分布如何导致 stomatocyte 和 trilobe 等复杂形状的出现。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：红细胞在中等剪切率下出现的形状不稳定性关键取决于其剪切模量、弯曲模量、内外粘度比以及过剩面积（主要通过膜张力调控）；理论框架揭示了膜张力饱和及过剩面积再分布如何导致 stomatocyte 和 trilobe 等复杂形状的出现。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用准球形红细胞在外部剪切流下的微扰理论框架，首先扩展该框架以显式考虑应力自由膜形状与当前膜形状之间的不同过剩面积，然后引入额外空间模式分析不稳定性，并研究膜张力的不稳定性诱导饱和及长时间尺度下的过剩面积再分布。

papers.title: Large-deviation tails of critical order-parameter distributions
papers.abstract: Large-deviation tails of critical probability distributions provide a sensitive probe of universality beyond standard finite-size scaling. We study these tails for critical percolation and Fortuin--Kasteleyn Ising models on two-dimensional lattices, three-dimensional lattices, and complete graphs. We consider two rescaled order parameters: the magnetization-like variable $x_m=|M|/\langle |M|\rangle$, including a signed cluster-mass analogue for percolation, and the largest-cluster variable $x_C=C_1/\langle C_1\rangle$. For $x_m$, we test the expected stretched-exponential large-deviation tail and show that the same form applies to the percolation analogue. For $x_C$, guided by the exact complete-graph result and scaling arguments, we propose universal scaling forms for both tails of the cumulative distribution and test them by extensive Monte Carlo simulations. In the complete-graph FK-Ising model, the left tail is governed by rare configurations with percolation-like scaling rather than by the typical Ising scaling. Our results show that the tails of order-parameter distributions reveal universal features of critical fluctuations that are not captured by averaged observables alone.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：关键词包括“Monte Carlo simulations”、“scaling arguments”、“exact complete-graph result”。；研究对象：临界渗流模型和Fortuin–Kasteleyn（FK）伊辛模型在二维晶格、三维晶格以及完全图上的临界序参量概率分布的大偏差尾部行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 临界序参量分布的大偏差尾部揭示了超越标准有限尺寸标度的普适性特征，且对于完全图上的FK-伊辛模型，其左尾由类似渗流的稀有构型主导，而非典型的伊辛标度行为。
