papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：临界序参量分布的大偏差尾部揭示了超越标准有限尺寸标度的普适性特征，且对于完全图上的FK-伊辛模型，其左尾由类似渗流的稀有构型主导，而非典型的伊辛标度行为。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用蒙特卡洛模拟（Monte Carlo simulations）进行数值计算，并结合精确的完全图解析结果和标度论证（scaling arguments）提出累积分布尾部的普适标度形式。

papers.title: Room-Temperature Calcium Intercalation into Graphite Catalyzed by Sodium
papers.abstract: Calcium (Ca) insertion into graphite (C) has been considered to require elevated temperatures, and its occurrence at room temperature (RT) has been regarded as highly unlikely. Here, we demonstrate that sodium (Na) catalysis enables the formation of superconducting CaC$_6$ even at RT. In mixtures of Ca, Na, and graphite, the gradual development of superconducting diamagnetism and the emergence of X-ray diffraction peaks confirm the formation of CaC$_6$ during storage at RT. The superconducting transition temperature increases with storage time, and the amount of CaC$_6$ scales proportionally to the square root of storage time. These findings provide new insights into the mechanism of superconductivity and Na-catalyzed formation of CaC$_6$, and highlight the potential of this RT intercalation process for practical applications such as electrode materials in Ca-ion batteries.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“X-ray diffraction peaks”“superconducting diamagnetism”等实验表征手段，以及“storage at RT”“storage time”等实验过程描述。；研究对象：钠催化下钙在石墨中的室温插层反应，具体形成超导相CaC₆。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 钠催化使得原本需要高温的钙插层石墨反应能在室温下发生，形成超导CaC₆，且其超导转变温度随储存时间升高，CaC₆生成量与储存时间的平方根成正比。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：钠催化使得原本需要高温的钙插层石墨反应能在室温下发生，形成超导CaC₆，且其超导转变温度随储存时间升高，CaC₆生成量与储存时间的平方根成正比。；创新点：首次在室温下实现钙插层石墨形成CaC₆，并揭示钠的催化作用，颠覆了以往认为该反应必须高温进行的认知。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: X射线衍射（XRD）确认物相形成，超导抗磁性测量（如磁化率）监测超导转变，通过储存时间变化追踪反应动力学。

papers.title: From Localized Packets to Plane Waves: A Time-Domain Approach to Transport in Mesoscopic Systems
papers.abstract: Quantum transport in mesoscopic systems is conventionally formulated within the Landauer--Büttiker scattering framework, where steady-state currents emerge from the transmission of plane waves representing propagating carriers. While highly successful, this description obscures the explicit time-domain dynamics of individual fermionic excitations and their role in establishing macroscopic transport. Here, we present an exact and self-contained time-domain construction of Landauer transport based on a discrete basis of orthogonal fermionic wave packets. Starting from a second-quantized formulation, we define packet creation operators via a continuous Fourier transform over a finite transport energy window. By encoding the Pauli exclusion principle, which enforces a fundamental temporal spacing $Δt = h/eV$, the current is reproduced in terms of orthogonal wave packets that are used for the rigorous construction of the many-body fermionic state. In this representation, a noiseless current emerges as a deterministic sequence of charge-carrying events, yielding the Landauer conductance $G_0 = e^2/h$ without invoking momentum-space kinematics. We further demonstrate that this construction remains exact for arbitrary energy dispersion. Additionally, the underlying Fock space decomposition into finite disjoint energy sub-bands renders the numerical approach highly scalable for high performance computing platforms. Our results establish a direct and rigorous bridge between the continuous scattering description of quantum transport and a discrete, time-resolved picture based on fermionic wave packets.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：time-domain construction、second-quantized formulation、Fock space decomposition。；研究对象：介观系统中的量子输运现象，具体为Landauer输运的时域描述。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 基于正交费米子波包的离散基矢，可以严格且自洽地构建Landauer输运的时域图像，无需引入动量空间运动学，即可导出Landauer电导G₀ = e²/h。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：基于正交费米子波包的离散基矢，可以严格且自洽地构建Landauer输运的时域图像，无需引入动量空间运动学，即可导出Landauer电导G₀ = e²/h。；创新点：建立了连续散射描述与离散、时间分辨的费米子波包图像之间的直接严格桥梁，且该构造对任意能量色散关系均保持精确，并具有高度可扩展的数值计算潜力。
papers.method_zh: 采用第二量子化形式，通过有限输运能量窗口上的连续傅里叶变换定义波包产生算符，利用泡利不相容原理强制的时间间隔Δt = h/eV，构建多体费米子态，并分解Fock空间为有限不相交能量子带。

papers.title: Observation of anyonic thermodynamics and generalized Pauli principle
papers.abstract: Anyons are quasiparticles with quantum statistics interpolating between those of bosons and fermions. Two distinct manifestations of anyonic behaviour have been theoretically established: fractional exchange statistics where particle exchange can produce any phase, and generalized exclusion statistics which extends the Pauli exclusion principle. While anyons exhibiting fractional exchange statistics have been observed in diverse platforms, experimental realizations of generalized exclusion statistics and direct measurements of its thermodynamic signatures have remained elusive. Here, we realize an anyonic thermodynamic ensemble obeying generalized exclusion statistics and detect its anyonic thermodynamics in a one-dimensional strongly interacting quantum gas. To achieve this, we exploit the bijective mapping between dynamical and statistical interactions in one dimension. By tuning interaction strength and temperature over a wide range, we measure the equation of state and identify clear departures from Bose-Einstein and Fermi-Dirac statistics. These deviations are quantitatively captured by generalized exclusion statistics, providing direct evidence for the generalized Pauli principle. Independent probes of other thermodynamic quantities including pressure and the Tan contact further validate this framework. Our results establish a versatile platform for engineering anyonic exclusion statistics and open the door to thermodynamic applications of anyons in quantum technologies.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“we realize”“we measure”“we exploit”等实验操作和测量行为，并描述了在一维强相互作用量子气体中实现任意子热力学系综的实验过程。；研究对象：一维强相互作用量子气体中的任意子热力学系综，具体研究任意子的广义排斥统计及其热力学表现。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过测量一维强相互作用量子气体的状态方程，观察到与玻色-爱因斯坦统计和费米-狄拉克统计的明显偏离，这些偏离被广义排斥统计定量描述，从而直接证实了广义泡利原理的存在。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过测量一维强相互作用量子气体的状态方程，观察到与玻色-爱因斯坦统计和费米-狄拉克统计的明显偏离，这些偏离被广义排斥统计定量描述，从而直接证实了广义泡利原理的存在。；创新点：首次在实验中实现了广义排斥统计的任意子热力学系综，并直接测量了其热力学特征，填补了此前仅观察到分数交换统计而缺乏广义排斥统计实验实现的空白。
papers.method_zh: 利用一维体系中动力学相互作用与统计相互作用之间的双射映射，通过调节相互作用强度和温度，测量状态方程、压强以及Tan接触等热力学量。

papers.title: Emergence of Resonating Valence-Bond Correlations in Stretched Graphene
papers.abstract: Electronic correlations in graphene are generally considered weak due to the large bandwidth of its $π$ electrons. Here we show that tensile expansion of the honeycomb lattice provides a direct route to enhancing correlation effects. Using variational and diffusion quantum Monte Carlo, we compare a conventional Jastrow-Slater determinant wave function with a resonating-valence-bond (RVB) Jastrow-antisymmetrized geminal product ansatz for a series of stretched graphene lattices. We find that the energy gain of the RVB state relative to the single-determinant description increases with bond expansion up to a critical strain $δ_{\mathrm{cr}}$, and decreases beyond it, revealing a nonmonotonic evolution of electronic correlations. The crossover is found to occur in the range $15\% < δ_{\mathrm{cr}} < 20\%$, in agreement with mechanical stability limits. This behavior indicates a transition from a weakly correlated Dirac semimetal to a regime with enhanced non-dynamic correlation and short-range singlet pairing. Our results provide direct many-body evidence that lattice expansion drives graphene into a regime where RVB-like correlations become energetically favorable, offering a simple route to tuning correlation effects in Dirac materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：使用variational and diffusion quantum Monte Carlo（变分和扩散量子蒙特卡洛）方法进行计算研究。；研究对象：拉伸石墨烯（stretched graphene）中的电子关联效应，特别是共振价键（RVB）关联的涌现。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在拉伸石墨烯中，随着晶格膨胀，共振价键（RVB）态相对于单行列式描述的能量增益先增加后减少，在临界应变δ_cr（15%–20%范围内）出现非单调演化，表明体系从弱关联狄拉克半金属转变为具有增强非动态关联和短程单态配对的区域。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在拉伸石墨烯中，随着晶格膨胀，共振价键（RVB）态相对于单行列式描述的能量增益先增加后减少，在临界应变δ_cr（15%–20%范围内）出现非单调演化，表明体系从弱关联狄拉克半金属转变为具有增强非动态关联和短程单态配对的区域。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 变分量子蒙特卡洛（variational QMC）和扩散量子蒙特卡洛（diffusion QMC），对比了常规Jastrow-Slater行列式波函数与共振价键（RVB）Jastrow-反对称化双粒子乘积（Jastrow-antisymmetrized geminal product）波函数。

papers.title: Projected altermagnetism by symmetry reduction at surfaces and in thin films
papers.abstract: Altermagnets are a newly identified class of magnetic materials that combine vanishing net magnetization within the unit cell with spin-split electronic states. Their theoretical description relies on symmetry properties of the bulk band structure. Surfaces and thin films, however, inherently break these symmetries. Here, we investigate the consequences of such symmetry reduction for the electronic structure of bulk altermagnets near the surface and of thin films. When the surface coincides with a symmetry plane of the bulk altermagnetic order, the resulting two-dimensional Brillouin zone exhibits spin-degenerate bands, corresponding to conventional antiferromagnetic behavior. In all other cases, the symmetry of the altermagnetic order is reduced, leading to modified spin splitting. Remarkably, we discover a thin-film geometry of a $g$-wave altermagnet with a particular surface orientation that enables a $d$-wave spin splitting, which is commonly accompanied by the spin-splitter effect, suggesting the functionalization of non-$d$-wave altermagnets by surfaces. Our findings demonstrate that symmetry breaking at surfaces and in thin films fundamentally reshapes altermagnetic spin textures, providing a tunable platform for controlling spin-dependent electronic phenomena.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“theoretical description”“symmetry properties”“discover a thin-film geometry”等，未涉及实验手段或计算模拟。；研究对象：交变磁体（altermagnets）的表面与薄膜体系，具体研究对称性降低对电子结构的影响，包括g波交变磁体的薄膜几何构型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 当表面与体交变磁序的对称面重合时，二维布里渊区出现自旋简并能带（类似传统反铁磁）；否则对称性降低导致自旋劈裂改变。特别地，特定取向的g波交变磁体薄膜可实现d波自旋劈裂，伴随自旋劈裂效应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：当表面与体交变磁序的对称面重合时，二维布里渊区出现自旋简并能带（类似传统反铁磁）；否则对称性降低导致自旋劈裂改变。特别地，特定取向的g波交变磁体薄膜可实现d波自旋劈裂，伴随自旋劈裂效应。；创新点：首次揭示表面和薄膜中的对称性破缺如何根本性地重塑交变磁体的自旋纹理，并提出通过表面工程将非d波交变磁体功能化（如实现d波自旋劈裂）的可行途径。
papers.method_zh: 基于对称性分析的理论推导，利用体相能带对称性性质，结合表面/薄膜几何构型对布里渊区对称性的影响进行讨论。

papers.title: Suppression of Extrinsic Anomalous Hall Conductivity in Disordered Parity Anomalous Semimetal
papers.abstract: We present an analytical investigation of the extrinsic contributions to the anomalous Hall conductivity in the context of the half-quantized Hall effect observed in disordered parity anomalous semimetal emerged from semi-magnetic topological insulator thin films. The gapless Dirac cone surface state, which embodies the quintessence of the half-quantized Hall effect, exhibits remarkable robustness against disorder scattering. Two primary extrinsic mechanisms, the side-jump and skew-scattering, are deemed irrelevant and make no contributions. These results establish the parity anomalous semimetal as a disorder-resilient quantum phase, thereby providing insights into Dirac fermion physics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“analytical investigation”（分析研究）、“extrinsic mechanisms”（外在机制）、“deemed irrelevant”（被认为无关），表明该工作为理论推导与分析。；研究对象：无序奇反常半金属（disordered parity anomalous semimetal），具体源于半磁性拓扑绝缘体薄膜中出现的半整数量子霍尔效应，以及其表面态中的反常霍尔电导率。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在无序奇反常半金属中，外在机制（侧跳和斜散射）对反常霍尔电导率无贡献，因此该体系对无序散射具有鲁棒性，是一种抗无序的量子相。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在无序奇反常半金属中，外在机制（侧跳和斜散射）对反常霍尔电导率无贡献，因此该体系对无序散射具有鲁棒性，是一种抗无序的量子相。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 解析理论分析（analytical investigation），具体针对半整数量子霍尔效应中的外在反常霍尔电导率贡献（侧跳与斜散射）进行推导与评估。

papers.title: The electric-field-driven intermediate state of three-dimensional superconductors
papers.abstract: The coexistence of superconductivity and finite electric fields may enable access to intriguing forms of electronic states. We demonstrate the emergence of an intermediate state in which electric fields penetrate the system while superconductivity still persists. Our measurements reveal a nonclassical regime characterized by the simultaneous presence of supercurrent and dissipative charge transport. This state, realized in a pristine unpatterned three-dimensional system, arises from electric-field-driven order parameter fluctuations. It provides a platform to explore dissipative states of charged quantum fluids far from equilibrium.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：关键词“measurements”（测量）、“realized in a pristine unpatterned three-dimensional system”（在无图案三维系统中实现）。；研究对象：三维超导体在电场驱动下的中间态，具体为超导与有限电场共存时出现的非经典耗散输运状态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在三维超导体中，电场可以穿透系统而超导性仍然保持，形成一种同时存在超流和耗散电荷输运的中间态，该态由电场驱动的序参量涨落引起。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在三维超导体中，电场可以穿透系统而超导性仍然保持，形成一种同时存在超流和耗散电荷输运的中间态，该态由电场驱动的序参量涨落引起。；创新点：在无图案的三维超导体系中首次实现了电场驱动的中间态，该态不同于经典超导态，表现为超流与耗散共存，为研究远离平衡态的带电量子流体的耗散行为提供了新平台。
papers.method_zh: 实验测量（摘要未明确说明具体实验手段，如输运测量、扫描探针等，仅提及“measurements”）。

papers.title: Spin-orbit coupling renormalization of the natural optical activity of Pb5Ge3O11 from first-principles
papers.abstract: We present a first-principles study of the natural optical activity of the gyroelectric Pb$_5$Ge$_3$O$_{11}$ crystal, explicitly accounting for spin-orbit coupling (SOC) effects. We derive a new analytical expression for the gyration coefficients within the recent framework of long-wavelength density-functional perturbation theory [Phys. Rev. Lett. \textbf{131}, 086902 (2023)], which significantly improves computational efficiency by reducing the number of required response functions and includes spin-orbit coupling effects. We use this implementation to investigate the evolution of Pb$_5$Ge$_3$O$_{11}$'s optical rotation across the ferroelectric double-well, from the paraelectric $P\bar{6}$ phase to the ferroelectric $P3$ phase. Our results demonstrate that, in addition to the substantial renormalization of the double-well energy, spin-orbit coupling contributions play an equally crucial role in the natural optical activity, largely through purely electronic contributions, while SOC-induced structural relaxation effects are minor.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：first-principles study、density-functional perturbation theory、spin-orbit coupling effects）；研究对象：Pb₅Ge₃O₁₁晶体的自然旋光性（natural optical activity），具体关注其从顺电相（P\bar{6}）到铁电相（P3）的相变过程中的光学旋转行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 自旋-轨道耦合（SOC）不仅显著重整了铁电双势阱的能量，还对自然旋光性起关键作用，且该贡献主要来自纯电子效应，而SOC诱导的结构弛豫效应较小。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：自旋-轨道耦合（SOC）不仅显著重整了铁电双势阱的能量，还对自然旋光性起关键作用，且该贡献主要来自纯电子效应，而SOC诱导的结构弛豫效应较小。；创新点：推导了包含SOC的旋光系数新解析表达式，显著减少了所需响应函数的数量，提升了计算效率；首次从第一性原理揭示了SOC对Pb₅Ge₃O₁₁自然旋光性的主导性电子贡献。
papers.method_zh: 基于长波密度泛函微扰理论（long-wavelength density-functional perturbation theory）框架，推导了新的旋光系数解析表达式，并显式包含自旋-轨道耦合效应。

papers.title: Nonequilibrium nucleation theory for nonconserved fields: from active matter to population dynamics
papers.abstract: Classical nucleation theory (CNT) describes the formation of a stable phase from a metastable one. In equilibrium systems, it quantifies the free-energy competition between a favorable bulk gain and an unfavorable interfacial cost. For systems without detailed balance, the corresponding nonequilibrium nucleation theory (NNT) was so far developed only for cases with a conserved order parameter, such as active fluid-fluid phase separation. Here we construct the NNT for systems with a (single, scalar) nonconserved order parameter. Unlike in the conserved case, the nucleation barrier controlling (noise-driven) droplet growth is profoundly altered by deviations in the interfacial density profile from the one arising during (deterministic) droplet relaxation. The barrier can nonetheless be analysed by carefully defining the reaction coordinate (droplet radius) to project out those deviations. We give explicit NNT predictions for models drawn from population dynamics and active matter, finding excellent agreement with numerical studies.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“construct the NNT”（构建理论）、“give explicit NNT predictions”（给出理论预测），并对比数值研究，属于理论建模与数值验证结合。；研究对象：非守恒序参量场驱动的非平衡成核过程，具体应用于活性物质（active matter）和种群动力学（population dynamics）中的相变现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在非守恒序参量体系中，成核势垒受到界面密度分布偏离确定性弛豫路径的显著影响，但通过合理定义反应坐标（液滴半径）可有效投影出这些偏差，从而准确分析势垒。该理论在活性物质和种群动力学模型中与数值结果高度吻合。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在非守恒序参量体系中，成核势垒受到界面密度分布偏离确定性弛豫路径的显著影响，但通过合理定义反应坐标（液滴半径）可有效投影出这些偏差，从而准确分析势垒。该理论在活性物质和种群动力学模型中与数值结果高度吻合。；创新点：此前非平衡成核理论仅适用于守恒序参量体系（如活性流体-流体相分离），本文首次将其推广到非守恒序参量体系，并揭示了界面密度分布偏差对成核势垒的独特影响机制。
papers.method_zh: 基于经典成核理论（CNT）框架，针对非守恒序参量体系构建非平衡成核理论（NNT），通过重新定义反应坐标（液滴半径）来分离界面密度分布的偏差，并对活性物质和种群动力学模型给出显式理论预测，与数值模拟结果进行对比验证。

papers.title: Self-Aligned Metallic-Semiconducting Phosphorus Nanoarrays Driven by Facet Engineering
papers.abstract: Two-dimensional (2D) materials often require specific substrate terminations for epitaxial stabilization, yet the search for suitable templates has largely focused on low-index metal surfaces, which may not provide the optimal conditions for the growth of new phases. Here, we show that crystal-facet engineering on curved Cu surfaces enables the stabilization, within a single preparation step, of two distinct 2D phosphorus phases with different electronic properties. Hexagonal blue phosphorene forms on Cu(111) terraces, whereas a previously unreported skewed-square phosphorus phase is stabilized on Cu(513) facets. By combining complementary microscopy and spectroscopy techniques with theoretical calculations, we determine the structural and electronic properties of this new phase, which displays semiconducting character, in contrast to the metallic behavior of blue phosphorene. The coexistence of these two competing phases gives rise to a metal-to-semiconducting transition of the 2D phosphorus layer over the substrate. Locally, the competition between the two phases gives rise to self-aligned nanoarrays of alternating metallic and semiconducting phosphorus terraces. These results establish crystal-facet engineering as a practical route for discovering and stabilizing emergent 2D material phases on high-index substrates, while also enabling the engineering of nanostructures with tailored electronic properties through a simple and scalable growth process.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：curved Cu surfaces, microscopy and spectroscopy techniques, theoretical calculations）；研究对象：二维磷的同素异形体（六方蓝磷烯与新型斜方磷相）在铜单晶曲面上的生长与电子性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过铜单晶的晶面工程，在同一制备步骤中稳定了两种不同电子性质的二维磷相：Cu(111)台阶面上的金属性蓝磷烯与Cu(513)面上的半导体性斜方磷相，并形成自对准的金属-半导体交替纳米阵列。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过铜单晶的晶面工程，在同一制备步骤中稳定了两种不同电子性质的二维磷相：Cu(111)台阶面上的金属性蓝磷烯与Cu(513)面上的半导体性斜方磷相，并形成自对准的金属-半导体交替纳米阵列。；创新点：首次在铜的高指数晶面（Cu(513)）上稳定了一种此前未报道的斜方磷相，并利用晶面工程实现了两种竞争相的自组装纳米阵列，为在高指数衬底上发现和稳定新型二维材料相提供了可扩展的途径。
papers.method_zh: 利用弯曲铜单晶表面进行分子束外延生长，结合互补的显微与光谱技术（如扫描隧道显微镜、光电子能谱等）以及理论计算（摘要未明确具体方法，如DFT类型），确定新相的结构与电子性质。

papers.title: First-Principles Study of Novel Lead-Free Double Perovskite \b{eta}2SnGeX6 (\b{eta} = K, Rb; X = Cl, Br, I) for thermomechanical, optoelectronic and outstanding thermoelectric applications
papers.abstract: In this study, the structural, mechanical, electronic, optical, and thermoelectric properties of the novel lead-free halide double perovskite series beta2SnGeX6 (beta = K, Rb; X = Cl, Br, I) are systematically investigated using density functional theory (DFT). Calculated formation energies, Tolerance factors, and octahedral factors confirm that all six compounds exhibit robust thermodynamic stability within a highly symmetric cubic geometry. Mechanical analysis derived from elastic parameters characterizes the entire series as fundamentally ductile, ensuring high processing elasticity and resistance to micro-cracking during device manufacturing. Electronic band structures reveal direct bandgaps showing exceptional composition-dependent tunability from 1.44 eV down to 0.64 eV via progressive halogen substitution. The wide gap chloride variations are optimized for single-junction photovoltaic absorbers, while the narrower-gap bromide and iodide analogs show immense promise for tandem solar architectures and near-infrared photodetectors. Thermoelectrically, heavy constituent atoms introduce strong lattice anharmonicity and intense high-temperature Umklapp phonon scattering, significantly suppressing lattice thermal conductivity. Combined with low carrier effective masses that optimize electrical transport, the iodide compounds achieve higher power factors and outstanding dimensionless figures of merit (ZT = 2.4 for K2SnGeI6 at 1000 K). Ultimately, these lead-free double perovskite family emerges as an environmentally benign and versatile platform for next-generation green optoelectronics and solid-state waste-heat recovery.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：density functional theory (DFT)、first-principles study。；研究对象：新型无铅卤化物双钙钛矿系列 β₂SnGeX₆（β = K, Rb; X = Cl, Br, I）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该系列化合物具有直接带隙，带隙可通过卤素取代在1.44 eV至0.64 eV范围内连续调控；其中碘化物K₂SnGeI₆在1000 K时热电优值ZT高达2.4，展现出优异的热电性能。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该系列化合物具有直接带隙，带隙可通过卤素取代在1.44 eV至0.64 eV范围内连续调控；其中碘化物K₂SnGeI₆在1000 K时热电优值ZT高达2.4，展现出优异的热电性能。；创新点：首次系统研究β₂SnGeX₆（β = K, Rb; X = Cl, Br, I）这一新型无铅双钙钛矿系列，并发现其在光伏、近红外探测和热电能量回收方面的多功能应用潜力。
papers.method_zh: 基于密度泛函理论（DFT）的第一性原理计算，系统研究了结构、力学、电子、光学和热电性质。具体包括：形成能、容忍因子和八面体因子计算（稳定性分析）；弹性常数计算（力学性质）；电子能带结构计算（电子性质）；以及结合重原子引起的强晶格非谐性和Umklapp声子散射分析（热电性质）。

papers.title: Thermodynamics of photonic nonlinear Aharonov-Bohm cages
papers.abstract: We investigate equilibrium and non-equilibrium thermodynamics of one-dimensional photonic diamond lattices with Kerr nonlinearity. The equilibrium phase diagram is obtained as a function of the synthetic magnetic flux acting on each plaquette. In the linear regime, the magnetic flux can induce Aharonov-Bohm caging, flattening all Bloch bands and suppressing particle and energy currents. In this caging regime, non-vanishing currents are enabled by nonlinearity. By imposing stationary temperature- and chemical potential- imbalances at the system boundaries, we show that at weak nonlinearity fine tuning the flux at the Aharonov-Bohm caging transforms the system from a conductor to an insulator. For intermediate nonlinear strength, the system remains conducting for all magnetic fluxes; however, the caging condition significantly enhances the Seebeck coefficient and thermoelectric figure of merit, improving the thermoelectric features of the system. Our results give evidence of a novel route towards optimization of coupled transport devices, based on the control of linear versus nonlinear conduction channels via a synthetic magnetic flux.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：investigate、obtained、imposing、show、give evidence of（理论分析与数值计算结合，无实验数据）。；研究对象：一维光子钻石晶格（photonic diamond lattices）中的非线性Aharonov-Bohm笼（nonlinear Aharonov-Bohm cages），具体涉及Kerr非线性效应和合成磁通（synthetic magnetic flux）调控下的平衡与非平衡热力学性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在Aharonov-Bohm笼（能带平坦化）条件下，非线性效应可开启原本被抑制的粒子流和能量流；通过精细调节磁通，弱非线性使系统从导体转变为绝缘体，而中等非线性下系统保持导电性，但笼条件显著增强塞贝克系数和热电优值。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在Aharonov-Bohm笼（能带平坦化）条件下，非线性效应可开启原本被抑制的粒子流和能量流；通过精细调节磁通，弱非线性使系统从导体转变为绝缘体，而中等非线性下系统保持导电性，但笼条件显著增强塞贝克系数和热电优值。；创新点：提出通过合成磁通调控线性与非线性导电通道，实现耦合输运器件优化的新途径，特别是利用Aharonov-Bohm笼条件增强热电性能。
papers.method_zh: 采用平衡态相图分析（作为合成磁通的函数）以及非平衡稳态输运理论（在系统边界施加固定的温度和化学势差），研究线性与非线性（Kerr非线性）条件下的电流响应和热电性能。

papers.title: Theory of In-Plane Orbital Magnetization with Layer Hybridization
papers.abstract: The modern theory of orbital magnetization successfully describes the response of Bloch electrons to magnetic fields in fully periodic crystals, but it does not directly address the distinct regime of an in-plane field in multilayer systems with layer hybridization. Coherent interlayer tunneling allows electrons to form circulating current loops, producing an in-plane orbital response that is absent in a strictly two-dimensional limit and qualitatively different from the conventional three-dimensional one. Here we develop a theory of in-plane orbital magnetization for this {\it transdimensional} regime, where the layer thickness is comparable to the vertical mean free path. Starting from the current-loop picture, we construct the in-plane orbital angular momentum operator and derive exact expressions for the orbital magnetic moment and the in-plane orbital magnetic susceptibility. As an application, we predict a gate-tunable in-plane orbital magnetoelectric effect in layered materials. Our framework establishes a general foundation for in-plane orbital responses and suggests new opportunities for orbitronics in layer-hybridized quantum materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“develop a theory”“derive exact expressions”“construct the in-plane orbital angular momentum operator”等理论推导关键词。；研究对象：层状材料中面内轨道磁化现象，特别是层间杂化（layer hybridization）导致的跨维度（transdimensional）轨道响应，以及可调控的面内轨道磁电效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在层厚与垂直平均自由程相当的跨维度体系中，层间相干隧穿使电子形成环形电流回路，产生严格二维极限下不存在的面内轨道磁化，并推导出轨道磁矩和面内轨道磁化率的精确表达式，预言了层状材料中栅极可调的面内轨道磁电效应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在层厚与垂直平均自由程相当的跨维度体系中，层间相干隧穿使电子形成环形电流回路，产生严格二维极限下不存在的面内轨道磁化，并推导出轨道磁矩和面内轨道磁化率的精确表达式，预言了层状材料中栅极可调的面内轨道磁电效应。；创新点：建立了适用于层间杂化体系的跨维度面内轨道响应理论框架，填补了传统轨道磁化理论（仅适用于完全周期性晶体或严格二维极限）在层间杂化体系中的空白，为层杂化量子材料中的轨道电子学（orbitronics）提供了新方向。
papers.method_zh: 基于电流回路图像构建面内轨道角动量算符，通过理论推导得到轨道磁矩和面内轨道磁化率的精确解析表达式，并应用于预测栅极可调的面内轨道磁电效应。

papers.title: On the emergence of molecular tilt in a ferroelectric smectic liquid crystal with broken director-inversion symmetry
papers.abstract: The origin of some mesophases of the ferroelectric nematic realm is not yet well understood. In this work we study the highly polar liquid crystal MIO, a close structural analogue of the prototypical ferroelectric nematogen DIO, which exhibits a ferroelectric smectic A to ferroelectric smectic C (SmAF-SmCF) phase transition. Calorimetric, dielectric and light-scattering experiments reveal that it is a second-order phase transition with mean-field behavior, and is driven by the softening of the tilt elastic constant accompanied by the divergence of the amplitude of the associated dielectric mode.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“Calorimetric, dielectric and light-scattering experiments”（量热、介电和光散射实验）。；研究对象：高度极性液晶材料MIO（铁电近晶相液晶），及其从铁电近晶A相到铁电近晶C相（SmAF-SmCF）的相变过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该SmAF-SmCF相变为二级相变，具有平均场行为，其驱动力来自倾斜弹性常数的软化，同时伴随相关介电模式振幅的发散。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该SmAF-SmCF相变为二级相变，具有平均场行为，其驱动力来自倾斜弹性常数的软化，同时伴随相关介电模式振幅的发散。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 量热实验、介电谱实验、光散射实验。

papers.title: Electron state tomography from quasiparticle interference maps
papers.abstract: Characterizing electronic band structures requires precise knowledge of wave functions and their quantum geometry. Here, we introduce a tomography method to reconstruct the density matrix of electron states from quasiparticle interference maps around single impurities. We consider two-orbital models on a honeycomb lattice, relevant to graphene heterostructures and direct-gap semiconductors. For on-site impurities, backscattering between time-reversed states directly maps the density matrix populations and coherences into distinct orbital contributions in the interference map. While local probes usually lack orbital resolution, these orbital contributions transform under distinct symmetry group representations and can thus be disentangled to reveal the density matrix and quantum geometric tensor of the scattering states. This establishes impurities as tomographic probes for band structures in scanning tunneling microscopy using conventional, unpolarized tips.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“introduce a tomography method”“consider two-orbital models”，属于理论建模与分析方法，未涉及实验数据或计算模拟。；研究对象：石墨烯异质结和直接带隙半导体中的电子态密度矩阵与量子几何张量。具体体系为蜂窝晶格上的双轨道模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过单杂质周围的准粒子干涉图，可以直接提取电子态密度矩阵的布居数和相干性，并进一步揭示散射态的量子几何张量。杂质可作为扫描隧道显微镜中传统非极化针尖的层析探针。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过单杂质周围的准粒子干涉图，可以直接提取电子态密度矩阵的布居数和相干性，并进一步揭示散射态的量子几何张量。杂质可作为扫描隧道显微镜中传统非极化针尖的层析探针。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论层析方法：基于蜂窝晶格双轨道模型，分析在位杂质引起的背散射过程，利用时间反演态之间的干涉图样中不同轨道贡献的对称性群表示，反演电子态密度矩阵。

papers.title: Extracting effective scaling exponents in finite-size hyperuniform systems
papers.abstract: Hyperuniform systems strongly suppress long-wavelength density fluctuations, which is quantitatively characterized by the small-wavenumber scaling. In finite samples, however, accurately estimating the hyperuniformity exponent α can be challenging. The inferred value depends strongly on the range of length scales accessible in the measurement, finite-size effects, and the specific characterization method employed, whether based on Fourier-space structure factors, real-space density fluctuations, or dynamical probes such as diffusion spreadability. In particular, the structure-factor method provides the most direct estimate of α, but is sensitive to empirical low-k fitting cutoffs. The number-variance method offers a real-space Class-like diagnosis, but contributes a numerical exponent only when the finite-size data retain Class III-like scaling information. The spreadability method provides a smoother dynamic estimate and reduces configuration-level fluctuations, but requires a physically admissible long-time fitting window. Here, we develop a practical method-aware protocol for robust estimation of the effective scaling exponent α in finite-size hyperuniform point configurations, combining three complementary methods with distinct roles. Our protocol summarizes the method-specific estimates through a joint empirical estimator and reports the internal dispersion among the participating methods to determine the optimal estimate.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“结构因子方法”、“数方差方法”、“扩散可扩展性方法”等理论分析工具，以及“联合经验估计器”等数据处理协议，未涉及实验手段。；研究对象：有限尺寸超均匀点构型中的有效标度指数提取问题。具体物理现象为超均匀系统中长波密度涨落的抑制特性及其标度指数α的准确估计。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在有限尺寸超均匀系统中，通过结构因子、数方差和扩散可扩展性三种互补方法联合分析，可更稳健地提取有效标度指数α，并利用方法间内部离散度确定最优估计值。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在有限尺寸超均匀系统中，通过结构因子、数方差和扩散可扩展性三种互补方法联合分析，可更稳健地提取有效标度指数α，并利用方法间内部离散度确定最优估计值。；创新点：提出了一种“方法感知”的实用协议，系统整合三种不同角色的互补方法，通过联合估计与内部离散度分析，解决了单一方法在有限尺寸超均匀系统中标度指数估计不准确的问题。摘要未突出说明与已有协议的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 采用三种互补方法：1）傅里叶空间结构因子法（直接估计α但对低k拟合截断敏感）；2）实空间数方差法（提供类Class诊断但需有限尺寸数据保留Class III标度信息）；3）动力学扩散可扩展性法（提供平滑动态估计但需长时拟合窗口）。通过联合经验估计器综合各方法结果，并计算内部离散度以确定最优估计。

papers.title: Classical dissipative search of unstructured database
papers.abstract: We propose a physical realization of the unstructured database search that works via classical, dissipative model of spherical spins. The database is implemented via spin-spin couplings, where the selected coupling refers to a larger ferromagnetic interaction between two selected spins. The low-temperature equilibrium of this model leads to magnetization strongly concentrated on the selected spins, which means that the search is complete. The search time refers to the relaxation time to equilibrium from a homogeneous initial state, and is described via Langevin equations. This time scales as ${\cal O}(M^a)$ with $a<1/2$, where $M$ is the database volume. This is faster than Grover's search, showing how a dissipative, classical analog computer can overcome the quantum unitary computer.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：propose a physical realization、classical, dissipative model、Langevin equations。；研究对象：非结构化数据库搜索的经典耗散物理实现，具体为基于球面自旋（spherical spins）的模型系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过经典耗散自旋模型实现的非结构化数据库搜索，其搜索时间标度为 \( \mathcal{O}(M^a) \) 且 \( a < 1/2 \)，快于量子Grover搜索算法，表明经典耗散模拟计算机可超越量子幺正计算机。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过经典耗散自旋模型实现的非结构化数据库搜索，其搜索时间标度为 \( \mathcal{O}(M^a) \) 且 \( a < 1/2 \)，快于量子Grover搜索算法，表明经典耗散模拟计算机可超越量子幺正计算机。；创新点：提出一种无需量子相干性、仅依赖经典耗散动力学即可实现非结构化数据库搜索的物理方案，并证明其搜索速度可超越已知的量子搜索算法（Grover算法）。
papers.method_zh: 理论建模与解析分析。采用球面自旋的经典耗散模型，通过自旋-自旋耦合实现数据库，利用朗之万方程（Langevin equations）描述从均匀初始态到平衡态的弛豫时间（即搜索时间）。

papers.title: Solution gate control of shallow silicon vacancy charge states in diamond
papers.abstract: Silicon-vacancy (SiV) centers in diamond combine near-infrared emission with solid-state robustness, but their performance hinges on isolating favorable defect charge states. We demonstrate static and dynamic control of ultra-shallow (<15 nm) SiV ensembles in type IIa diamond. By combining low-energy ion implantation with tailored oxygen and hydrogen terminations, we map regimes that maximise the fluorescent SiV- population over dark charge states. We then realize reversible SiV- to SiV0 conversion using aqueous electrolytic gating with sub-200 mV biases and low optical powers. Our results enable low-power electrical control of SiV ensembles for integrated quantum photonics and biologically compatible voltage imaging in the near-infrared.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确描述了实验操作（低能离子注入、表面终端修饰、电解液门控）和实验观测（荧光SiV-群体最大化、可逆电荷态转换）。；研究对象：金刚石中浅层硅空位（SiV）色心及其电荷态（SiV-和SiV0）的调控。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过结合低能离子注入与氧/氢表面终端，可最大化荧光SiV-群体；利用水溶液电解门控，在低于200 mV偏压和低光功率下实现了SiV-与SiV0之间的可逆转换。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过结合低能离子注入与氧/氢表面终端，可最大化荧光SiV-群体；利用水溶液电解门控，在低于200 mV偏压和低光功率下实现了SiV-与SiV0之间的可逆转换。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 低能离子注入制备超浅（<15 nm）SiV色心；氧和氢终端修饰表面；水溶液电解门控施加亚200 mV偏压；光学荧光测量表征电荷态。

papers.title: Mimicry of chaos and $k$-design in higher order OTOCs of Luttinger liquids
papers.abstract: Out-of-time-order correlators (OTOCs) provide a fundamental metric for quantum chaos, but capturing the fine structure of information scrambling requires exploring their higher-order generalizations. Here, we systematically investigate the sequence of higher-order OTOCs in a Luttinger liquid and its lattice realization, the XXZ Heisenberg chain. Using bosonization and numerics, we extract the full temporal dynamics of the first three OTOCs, revealing that they rapidly erase memory of the initial state, and quickly saturate to their steady state values. Strikingly, we show that calculating the late time saturation values for the entire sequence of higher-order OTOCs maps exactly onto determining the partition function of a non-Hermitian Harper model. Through this mapping, we demonstrate that for moderately strong interactions, the steady-state OTOCs become parametrically small up to the seventh order, mimicking higher $k$-design. Our results reveal that Luttinger liquids exhibit an unexpectedly profound degree of apparent scrambling when viewed through the lens of higher-order OTOCs.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有数值计算）。判断依据：关键词“bosonization and numerics”、“mapping”、“demonstrate”。；研究对象：Luttinger液体及其晶格实现——XXZ海森堡链中的高阶时序关联函数（higher-order OTOCs）所揭示的量子混沌与信息 scrambling 行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Luttinger液体在中等强度相互作用下，其高阶OTOC的稳态值可被参数化地压制到很小，直至第七阶，从而模拟出更高阶的k-design行为，表明该系统通过高阶OTOC视角展现出远超预期的明显信息 scrambling 程度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Luttinger液体在中等强度相互作用下，其高阶OTOC的稳态值可被参数化地压制到很小，直至第七阶，从而模拟出更高阶的k-design行为，表明该系统通过高阶OTOC视角展现出远超预期的明显信息 scrambling 程度。；创新点：首次系统研究Luttinger液体中高阶OTOC的完整时间演化，并建立其稳态值与非厄米Harper模型配分函数之间的精确映射，从而揭示出中等相互作用下系统可模拟高阶k-design这一意外现象。
papers.method_zh: 采用玻色化（bosonization）理论分析，并结合数值计算，提取前三个OTOC的完整时间动力学；通过将高阶OTOC的晚期饱和值计算映射到非厄米Harper模型的配分函数，进行解析推导。

papers.title: Polarized neutron scattering as a probe for vortex-type spin correlations in iron oxide multicore assemblies
papers.abstract: We report an experimental investigation of the magnetic microstructure of iron oxide multicore assemblies by means of polarized small-angle neutron scattering (SANS). Guided by a recently developed analytical theory for vortex-state magnetic nanoparticles, we provide a quantitative comparison between the measured and calculated cross sections, revealing signatures that are consistent with vortex-type magnetization configurations at low applied magnetic fields. In particular, the field evolution and the characteristic isotropic ring-type feature of the spin-flip scattering intensity at intermediate momentum transfers are in line with the formation of flux-closure states. The latter are stabilized by the interplay of exchange, Zeeman, and magnetostatic energies. The methodology allows for a statistically significant characterization of vortex states in densely packed nanoparticle systems, thereby complementing surface-sensitive techniques that are commonly limited to the observation of spin structures in individual particles.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：关键词“experimental investigation”、“polarized small-angle neutron scattering (SANS)”、“measured and calculated cross sections”。；研究对象：铁氧化物多核组装体（iron oxide multicore assemblies）中的磁微观结构，特别是涡旋型自旋关联（vortex-type spin correlations）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在低外加磁场下，铁氧化物多核组装体中存在与涡旋型磁化构型一致的散射信号，尤其是自旋翻转散射强度在中等动量转移区域呈现各向同性环状特征，表明形成了通量闭合态（flux-closure states）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在低外加磁场下，铁氧化物多核组装体中存在与涡旋型磁化构型一致的散射信号，尤其是自旋翻转散射强度在中等动量转移区域呈现各向同性环状特征，表明形成了通量闭合态（flux-closure states）。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 极化小角中子散射（polarized SANS），并结合最近发展的涡旋态磁性纳米颗粒分析理论进行定量比较。

papers.title: Role of Local Structural Variation in X-ray Photoelectron Spectrum of Silicon Oxide Interfaces
papers.abstract: We show that the broad X-ray photoelectron lines of silicon oxide on silicon arise from a continuous statistical distribution of core-level binding energies. Statistical simulations spanning compositions from Si to SiO$_2$ reproduce the full extent of this broadening, reaching 5 eV for SiO$_{1.0}$ , in quantitative agreement with 0.23 nm layer-resolved spectra reconstructed from Ar$^+$ sputtering data. This continuous distribution blurs distinct spectral fingerprints of local structural motifs, thereby challenging conventional chemical state assignment in oxide X-ray photoelectron spectra.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验与计算结合）。判断依据：实验上使用X射线光电子能谱（XPS）和Ar⁺溅射获得层分辨谱，同时结合统计模拟进行理论分析。；研究对象：硅氧化物（SiO₂/Si）界面中X射线光电子谱的线形展宽机制，具体关注从Si到SiO₂连续组分范围内的芯能级结合能分布。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 硅氧化物界面的宽X射线光电子谱线源于芯能级结合能的连续统计分布，该分布可导致局域结构特征的光谱指纹模糊化，从而挑战传统的化学态指认方法。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：硅氧化物界面的宽X射线光电子谱线源于芯能级结合能的连续统计分布，该分布可导致局域结构特征的光谱指纹模糊化，从而挑战传统的化学态指认方法。；创新点：揭示了宽XPS谱线并非由离散的化学态叠加引起，而是由连续的统计分布主导，并定量再现了SiO₁.₀处高达5 eV的展宽。
papers.method_zh: 采用统计模拟方法，覆盖从Si到SiO₂的连续组分范围，并与通过Ar⁺溅射数据重建的0.23 nm层分辨谱进行定量对比。

papers.title: Ewald summing irreducible components of flow around active particles
papers.abstract: We present a method to compute Ewald summation for the irreducible components of flow around active particles to study hydrodynamic interactions in active colloidal suspensions. An active particle is modeled as a colloidal sphere with a surface slip velocity. Using this model, we obtain an irreducible representation of the fluid flow produced by an active particle in periodic geometry of Stokes flow for an arbitrary surface slip. The solution of the active flow is obtained in terms of lattice sum of the Oseen tensor and their derivatives. The lattice sum is accelerated using the Ewald summation technique. We apply the method to compute explicit expression for rigid body motion of hydrodynamically interacting active particles. Our method presents a way for dynamic simulation of active particles due to arbitrary mode of active slip in periodic geometry of Stokes flow.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：Ewald summation、irreducible representation、lattice sum、dynamic simulation。；研究对象：活性胶体悬浮液中活性粒子周围的流体动力学相互作用。具体体系为具有表面滑移速度的胶体球（活性粒子）在斯托克斯流周期性几何中的流动。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种通过Ewald求和加速计算活性粒子周围流动的不可约分量的方法，并给出了流体动力学相互作用下活性粒子刚体运动的显式表达式，为任意活性滑移模式下的周期性几何动态模拟提供了途径。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种通过Ewald求和加速计算活性粒子周围流动的不可约分量的方法，并给出了流体动力学相互作用下活性粒子刚体运动的显式表达式，为任意活性滑移模式下的周期性几何动态模拟提供了途径。；创新点：将Ewald求和技术应用于活性粒子流动的不可约分量计算，实现了对任意表面滑移模式下周期性几何中活性粒子流体动力学相互作用的有效处理，为动态模拟提供了通用方法。
papers.method_zh: 采用Ewald求和技术加速Oseen张量及其导数的晶格求和，基于活性粒子表面滑移速度模型获得流动的不可约表示，并推导出周期性边界条件下斯托克斯流的解析解。

papers.title: $d$-wave altermagnetism revealed by resonant inelastic X-ray scattering
papers.abstract: Altermagnetism defines a third fundamental class of collinear magnetic order, featuring compensated magnetic moments with antiparallel spin alignment, yet lifted Kramers degeneracy without the need for relativistic spin-orbit coupling. Its ability to host spin-polarized electronic bands and unconventional chiral magnons makes it a promising platform for functional materials. However, experimental verification has proven challenging; while circular dichroism in resonant inelastic X-ray scattering (RIXS) has been suggested as a signature of chiral magnons, it remains controversial whether this effect is an intrinsic property of altermagnetism or an artifact of experimental geometry. In this work, we resolve this debate and provide unambiguous experimental evidence of $d$-wave altermagnetism in the strongly correlated Lieb-lattice magnet La$_2$O$_3$Mn$_2$Se$_2$. The RIXS spectra exhibit a $d$-wave-symmetry circular dichroism in the magnetic excitations that vanishes in the paramagnetic phase. Through RIXS-operator symmetry analysis and exact-diagonalization calculations, we prove that the observed dichroism is a direct consequence of altermagnetic symmetry constraints, independent of magnon branch splitting. Our results provide definitive evidence for the experimental realization of $d$-wave altermagnetism in La$_2$O$_3$Mn$_2$Se$_2$ and establish circularly polarized RIXS as a highly symmetry-sensitive spectroscopic framework for detecting magnetic phases that evade conventional probes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（辅以理论计算）。关键词：resonant inelastic X-ray scattering (RIXS)、exact-diagonalization calculations、RIXS-operator symmetry analysis。；研究对象：强关联Lieb晶格磁体La₂O₃Mn₂Se₂中的d波交变磁性（d-wave altermagnetism）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在La₂O₃Mn₂Se₂中观测到磁激发具有d波对称性的圆二色性，该二色性在顺磁相消失，证明这是交变磁性对称约束的直接结果，而非实验几何假象，从而提供了d波交变磁性的明确实验证据。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在La₂O₃Mn₂Se₂中观测到磁激发具有d波对称性的圆二色性，该二色性在顺磁相消失，证明这是交变磁性对称约束的直接结果，而非实验几何假象，从而提供了d波交变磁性的明确实验证据。；创新点：解决了关于RIXS圆二色性究竟是交变磁性的本征性质还是实验几何假象的争议，首次明确证明了d波交变磁性的实验实现，并建立了圆偏振RIXS作为探测传统手段难以检测的磁相的高对称性敏感光谱框架。
papers.method_zh: 共振非弹性X射线散射（RIXS）实验测量磁激发的圆二色性；结合RIXS算符对称性分析和精确对角化（exact-diagonalization）计算进行理论验证。

papers.title: Josephson spectroscopy in a circular atomic tunnel junction with acceleration-induced symmetry breaking
papers.abstract: We study Josephson dynamics in a long atomic Bose-Josephson junction formed by two tunnel-coupled coplanar Bose-Einstein-condensate rings. An in-plane linear acceleration breaks the axial symmetry of the trap and transforms a single Josephson plasma oscillation into a multimode population-imbalance response. Gross-Pitaevskii simulations and Bogoliubov-de Gennes analysis show that the additional spectral components arise from collective modes that acquire finite overlap with the population-imbalance operator under symmetry breaking, with their activation governed by reflection symmetry about the acceleration direction. We also propose a mode-resolved Josephson-spectroscopy protocol based on a weak localized periodic perturbation. Frequency scans reveal resonant amplitude peaks and phase shifts at the eigenfrequencies of active Bogoliubov modes, while angular scans of the drive position provide access to the angular structure of the corresponding mode density perturbations. A dissipative time-dependent Bogoliubov theory yields analytical response functions in quantitative agreement with full Gross-Pitaevskii simulations in the linear regime. Our results demonstrate that accelerated dual-ring condensates provide a controllable platform for symmetry-selected Josephson dynamics and spectroscopic probing of collective modes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：Gross-Pitaevskii simulations、Bogoliubov-de Gennes analysis、dissipative time-dependent Bogoliubov theory。；研究对象：由两个隧道耦合的共面玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚环（BEC环）构成的长原子玻色-约瑟夫森结，以及其中由面内线性加速度诱导的对称性破缺对约瑟夫森动力学的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 面内线性加速度破坏了陷阱的轴向对称性，将单一的约瑟夫森等离子体振荡转变为多模的粒子数不平衡响应；通过弱局域周期扰动可实现模式分辨的约瑟夫森光谱学，从而探测活跃的博戈留波夫（Bogoliubov）集体模式。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：面内线性加速度破坏了陷阱的轴向对称性，将单一的约瑟夫森等离子体振荡转变为多模的粒子数不平衡响应；通过弱局域周期扰动可实现模式分辨的约瑟夫森光谱学，从而探测活跃的博戈留波夫（Bogoliubov）集体模式。；创新点：提出了一个基于加速双环凝聚体的可控平台，用于实现对称性选择的约瑟夫森动力学以及集体模式的谱学探测；摘要未突出说明与已有具体实验或理论工作的直接对比。
papers.method_zh: 采用Gross-Pitaevskii方程数值模拟、Bogoliubov-de Gennes分析、以及耗散含时Bogoliubov理论推导解析响应函数。具体协议包括频率扫描（探测共振振幅峰和相位移动）和驱动位置角度扫描（获取模式密度扰动的角结构）。

papers.title: Counterintuitive inverse superconducting transition beyond 4He-cooling limit
papers.abstract: Thermally driven quantum-orders observed in exceptional instances may redefine the role of thermal-fluctuation from a source of decoherence to a resource for coherent-state engineering. While preliminary signs of counterintuitive temperature-rise-triggered superconductivity manifested in CeCu2Si2, ErRh4B4, Ho1.2Mo6S8 and (La,Ce)Al2, their critical-temperatures (Tc-inv) remain below Kelvin-range, precluding substantial applications. Here, we report field-modulated inverse-superconducting-transitions above 4He-cooling-limit in Eu-based infinite-layer nickelates (EuxNd1-xNiO2 and EuxPr1-xNiO2) grown on a substrate under both overdoped and underdoped regimes. Paradigmatically, superconductivity with zero-resistance is confined between Tc-inv (2.6-5.4 K) and another higher normal-Tc, rising and decreasing with applied magnetic-field, respectively. Starting from the resistive-state below Tc-inv, the inverse-superconducting-transition is driven by not only temperature-rising, but also current-density, while superconductivity further vanishes at higher temperature and current thresholds. The Kelvin-range inverse superconducting transition is plausibly explained by temperature-induced alternating dominance of effective magnetic-fields arising from Eu2+4f7 related compensations relative to the upper-critical-field. Furthermore, an extended-phenomenological-framework is also supported by reemerged superconductivity below 300 mK under magnetic-field, giving rise to an unprecedented temperature-induced reentrant superconductivity. Our findings establish magnetic-interaction-reconfigured high-Tc systems as fertile platforms for exploring quantum phenomena that reverse thermal-decoherence paradigm, also enabling antithetical-designs to unlock untapped application-scenarios for quantum-phase-transition devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提及“grown on a substrate”（衬底生长）、“zero-resistance”（零电阻）、“resistive-state”（电阻态）等实验测量特征，以及具体材料制备和输运测量描述。；研究对象：Eu基无限层镍酸盐薄膜（EuxNd1-xNiO2 和 EuxPr1-xNiO2），具体研究其在场调制下的逆超导转变现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在高于4He冷却极限（约4.2 K）的温度区间（2.6-5.4 K）观测到场调制的逆超导转变：零电阻超导态被限制在逆转变临界温度（Tc-inv）与另一个更高的正常态临界温度之间，且超导态随温度升高而出现、随磁场升高而消失。此外，在磁场下低于300 mK时还观测到前所未有的温度诱导重入超导现象。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在高于4He冷却极限（约4.2 K）的温度区间（2.6-5.4 K）观测到场调制的逆超导转变：零电阻超导态被限制在逆转变临界温度（Tc-inv）与另一个更高的正常态临界温度之间，且超导态随温度升高而出现、随磁场升高而消失。此外，在磁场下低于300 mK时还观测到前所未有的温度诱导重入超导现象。；创新点：首次在高于液氦冷却极限（>4.2 K）的温区实现逆超导转变，且该转变同时受温度和电流密度驱动；提出了基于Eu²⁺ 4f⁷磁矩补偿产生的有效磁场与上临界场之间温度诱导交替主导的物理解释；发现了磁场下300 mK以下的温度诱导重入超导现象，建立了磁相互作用重构的高温超导体系作为反转热退相干范式的新平台。
papers.method_zh: 薄膜生长（衬底上外延生长）、电阻输运测量（零电阻判定）、磁场调制实验（场依赖的临界温度测量）、电流密度依赖测量。摘要未明确说明具体生长技术（如分子束外延）或微观表征手段。

papers.title: Bidirectional motion of antiferromagnetic skyrmions driven by competing spin torques
papers.abstract: Antiferromagnetic skyrmions are swirling topological spin textures with rich dynamics and intriguing transport properties, yet their bidirectional dynamics remain largely unexplored. Here, we investigate the dynamics of antiferromagnetic skyrmions driven by current-induced spin-transfer and spin-orbit torques. We computationally demonstrate that antiferromagnetic skyrmions moving in one direction at low current densities can reverse their motion direction when the driving current is above a threshold. Based on the Thiele approach analysis, we show that this bidirectional motion originates from a change in the relative strengths of two effective forces arising from spin-transfer and spin-orbit torques. Furthermore, exploiting this bidirectional motion on a single racetrack, we design programmable logic gates. Our results not only uncover a hidden mechanism for bidirectional skyrmion motion but also facilitate the development of antiferromagnet-based logic devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：computationally demonstrate、Thiele approach analysis）；研究对象：反铁磁斯格明子（antiferromagnetic skyrmions）在电流驱动下的动力学行为，具体涉及自旋转移矩（spin-transfer torque）和自旋轨道矩（spin-orbit torque）的竞争效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 反铁磁斯格明子在低电流密度下沿单一方向运动，当驱动电流超过阈值时运动方向发生反转；这种双向运动源于自旋转移矩和自旋轨道矩产生的两种有效力相对强度的变化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：反铁磁斯格明子在低电流密度下沿单一方向运动，当驱动电流超过阈值时运动方向发生反转；这种双向运动源于自旋转移矩和自旋轨道矩产生的两种有效力相对强度的变化。；创新点：揭示了反铁磁斯格明子双向运动的新机制（bidirectional motion），并利用该机制在单赛道（single racetrack）上设计了可编程逻辑门（programmable logic gates），为反铁磁基逻辑器件提供了新思路。
papers.method_zh: 微磁学计算（computationally demonstrate）结合Thiele方法分析（Thiele approach analysis），用于解析有效力的竞争机制。

papers.title: Trion Hall effect in electron-hole double layers
papers.abstract: The realization of Coulomb coupled electron-hole double layers in 2D semiconductor heterostructures has enabled the thermodynamic and transport studies of equilibrium exciton fluids without a magnetic field. By doping the exciton fluid with additional electrons/holes, an equilibrium fluid of trions - three particle bound states of electrons and holes - further emerge, providing the platform to explore new transport phenomena associated with such composite particles. Here we report the observation of a Hall effect for trions in MoSe2/WSe2 heterobilayers, which support Coulomb-coupled electron and hole fluids with tunable densities. The Hall effect arises from a Lorentz force on trions under a perpendicular magnetic field. It is manifested in both Hall drag measurements and standard Hall effect measurements on just one of the semiconductor layers. For negatively charged trions, an electron Hall effect is observed even in a hole doped WSe2 monolayer due to the presence of trion drags. The trion Hall effect also disappears when the trions are ionized at elevated temperatures and/or high trion densities. Our work opens the door for realizing quantum oscillations and the quantum Hall effect for trions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“observation”、“Hall drag measurements”、“standard Hall effect measurements”等实验关键词。；研究对象：MoSe₂/WSe₂异质双层中的三子（trion）——即电子-空穴对束缚额外电子或空穴形成的三粒子复合物，以及其在外加垂直磁场下的霍尔效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在MoSe₂/WSe₂异质双层中观测到了三子的霍尔效应，该效应源于垂直磁场对三子的洛伦兹力，并在霍尔拖拽测量和单层标准霍尔测量中均有体现；负电三子甚至能在空穴掺杂的WSe₂单层中诱导出电子霍尔效应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在MoSe₂/WSe₂异质双层中观测到了三子的霍尔效应，该效应源于垂直磁场对三子的洛伦兹力，并在霍尔拖拽测量和单层标准霍尔测量中均有体现；负电三子甚至能在空穴掺杂的WSe₂单层中诱导出电子霍尔效应。；创新点：首次实验观测到三子（而非激子或单粒子）的霍尔效应，并揭示了三子拖拽在单层中诱导反常霍尔响应的机制。
papers.method_zh: 通过构建库仑耦合的电子-空穴双层二维半导体异质结构，调控载流子密度，在垂直磁场下进行霍尔拖拽测量和单层标准霍尔效应测量。

papers.title: Dynamics of monohydroxy alcohols with chain-like structures: Hydrogen bonding lifetime, chain swapping, and Debye process
papers.abstract: By assuming reversible H-bonding association and dissociation, this work provides a description of the supramolecular structure and dynamics of monohydroxy alcohols (MAs) within the framework of a recently proposed living chain model (LCM). Structurally, reversible H-bonding leads to a single exponential distribution of the molar concentration of the supramolecular chain with length N. Dynamically, reversible H-bonding enables supramolecular chain breakage and recombination, which modifies the relaxation time of the supramolecular chains. In addition to the structural relaxation, tau_a, and the Debye relaxation, tau_D, two other relaxation times are revealed: the chain breakage time, tau_B, and the H-bonding lifetime, tau_H. The interplay among these four-time scales defines five distinct dynamics regimes. In Regimes I and V, no supramolecular chains form. In Regimes II and IV, supramolecular chains form and give a Debye relaxation. The characteristic chain length scales as Nc~tau_D/tau_a. In these two regimes, the H-bonding lifetime controls the Debye process. In Regime III, large supramolecular chains form. In all regimes with supramolecular chain formation, the Debye relaxation comes from the overall chain end-to-end dipole reorientation and scales with Nc. Excellent agreements between experiments and LCM have been observed, leading to quantitative descriptions of the dielectric and linear viscoelastic properties of MAs. These results thus establish a theoretical framework linking reversible H-bonding interactions to supramolecular structures, dynamics, and macroscopic properties of MAs.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“provides a description”、“within the framework of a recently proposed living chain model (LCM)”，并基于可逆氢键假设推导出动力学标度关系，未涉及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：单羟基醇（monohydroxy alcohols, MAs）的超分子结构与动力学，特别是氢键寿命、链交换过程以及Debye弛豫行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过活链模型（LCM）揭示了单羟基醇中除结构弛豫（τ_a）和Debye弛豫（τ_D）外，还存在链断裂时间（τ_B）和氢键寿命（τ_H）两个特征时间尺度；这四个时间尺度的相互作用定义了五个不同的动力学区间，其中Debye弛豫来源于超分子链端到端偶极的重新取向，且特征链长Nc~τ_D/τ_a。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过活链模型（LCM）揭示了单羟基醇中除结构弛豫（τ_a）和Debye弛豫（τ_D）外，还存在链断裂时间（τ_B）和氢键寿命（τ_H）两个特征时间尺度；这四个时间尺度的相互作用定义了五个不同的动力学区间，其中Debye弛豫来源于超分子链端到端偶极的重新取向，且特征链长Nc~τ_D/τ_a。；创新点：将可逆氢键相互作用与超分子结构、动力学及宏观性质（介电、线性粘弹）定量联系起来，建立了统一的理论框架，并首次明确区分了氢键寿命与链断裂时间对Debye弛豫的控制作用。
papers.method_zh: 理论建模：基于可逆氢键缔合-解离假设的活链模型（LCM），推导超分子链的摩尔浓度分布（单指数分布）、弛豫时间修正以及介电和线性粘弹性质的定量描述。

papers.title: Hallmark Signatures of Electronic Pairing in Two-Photon Two-Electron Coincidence Angle-Resolved Photoemission Spectroscopy
papers.abstract: Understanding strongly correlated quantum materials remains a central challenge in condensed matter physics and materials science. While angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (ARPES) has become an indispensable probe of single-quasiparticle excitations, it accesses electronic correlations only indirectly. Here we show that unlike one-photon in, two-electrons out coincidence ARPES ($γ\!\rightarrow\!2e$ 2eARPES), the two-photon in, two-electron out $2γ\!\rightarrow\!2e$ 2eARPES provides a direct and unambiguous probe of electronic pairing. We establish this on general theoretical grounds and substantiate it through large-scale numerical simulations of strongly correlated models with both paired and unpaired ground states. The key result is a model-independent separation in the $(ω_1,ω_2)$ plane of the two photoelectrons' energies, between signal from electrons emitted from the \emph{same} pair and signal from electrons emitted from \emph{different} pairs; this follows from energy conservation alone and is independent of any material-specific assumptions. Our findings demonstrate that $2γ\!\rightarrow\!2e$ 2eARPES can identify pairing and extract the pair binding energy as well as the energy of the 'glue' boson without any sophisticated data analysis or complementary measurements.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（含数值模拟）。判断依据：摘要明确提到“on general theoretical grounds”和“large-scale numerical simulations”，未提及实验数据。；研究对象：双光子双电子符合角分辨光电子能谱（2γ→2e 2eARPES）对电子配对（electronic pairing）的直接探测能力，研究对象为强关联量子材料中的配对态与非配对态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 双光子双电子符合ARPES（2γ→2e 2eARPES）能够直接且无歧义地探测电子配对，其关键特征是在两个光电子能量（ω₁, ω₂）平面上，来自同一对电子的信号与来自不同对电子的信号存在模型无关的分离，该分离仅由能量守恒决定。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：双光子双电子符合ARPES（2γ→2e 2eARPES）能够直接且无歧义地探测电子配对，其关键特征是在两个光电子能量（ω₁, ω₂）平面上，来自同一对电子的信号与来自不同对电子的信号存在模型无关的分离，该分离仅由能量守恒决定。；创新点：与传统的单光子双电子符合ARPES（γ→2e 2eARPES）不同，2γ→2e 2eARPES可直接探测电子配对，无需复杂数据分析或补充测量即可识别配对、提取配对结合能及“胶子”玻色子能量。摘要未突出说明与已有理论或实验工作的具体对比细节。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导（一般性理论论证）结合大规模数值模拟，对具有配对基态和非配对基态的强关联模型进行计算验证。

papers.title: Strain induced magnetic phase transition and anomalous transport phenomena in RuO$_2$ and MnF$_2$
papers.abstract: Collinear antiferromagnets with broken time-reversal symmetry have emerged as a fertile platform for spintronics. Using a general tight-binding model and first-principles calculations, we show that strain engineering provides a simple route to control magnetic phase transition and activate transverse responses in representative altermagnets RuO$_2$ and MnF$_2$. For pristine RuO$_2$ and MnF$_2$ with Néel vector $\mathbf{n}\parallel$ [001], symmetry constrains the off-diagonal elements of the Hall conductivity tensor to vanish, thereby forbidding anomalous transport and magneto-optical responses. Shear strain applied along the $ac$ direction preserves the spin symmetry relating the two spin-opposite magnetic sublattices and therefore maintains the altermagnetic phase. By contrast, shear strain applied along the $ab$ direction breaks this spin symmetry and drives a transition from an altermagnetic phase to a partially compensated ferrimagnetic phase in metallic RuO$_2$ and to a fully compensated ferrimagnetic phase in semiconducting MnF$_2$. In addition, the lowered symmetry enables finite anomalous Hall, anomalous Nernst, and anomalous thermal Hall conductivities, as well as magneto-optical rotation angles, which are prohibited in the pristine systems. These responses exhibit a clear strain dependence and become progressively stronger as the strain amplitude increases. Our results establish strain engineering as an effective route to manipulate magnetic phases and functional responses in unconventional antiferromagnets, thereby expanding opportunities for antiferromagnetic spintronics and magneto-optical applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论计算文章。关键词：tight-binding model、first-principles calculations。；研究对象：反铁磁材料 RuO₂ 和 MnF₂ 中的应变诱导磁相变及反常输运现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 沿特定方向（ab方向）施加剪切应变可破坏自旋对称性，驱动 RuO₂ 和 MnF₂ 从交错磁相转变为亚铁磁相，并激活原本被禁止的反常霍尔、反常能斯特和反常热霍尔电导率以及磁光旋转角。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：沿特定方向（ab方向）施加剪切应变可破坏自旋对称性，驱动 RuO₂ 和 MnF₂ 从交错磁相转变为亚铁磁相，并激活原本被禁止的反常霍尔、反常能斯特和反常热霍尔电导率以及磁光旋转角。；创新点：提出应变工程（strain engineering）作为一种简单有效的手段，用于调控交错磁体（altermagnets）的磁相变和功能响应，为反铁磁自旋电子学和磁光应用开辟新途径。
papers.method_zh: 采用紧束缚模型（tight-binding model）和第一性原理计算（first-principles calculations）进行理论分析。

papers.title: Time-resolved synchronization analysis of stacked intrinsic Josephson junctions of a cuprate superconductor with frequency-modulated terahertz radiation spectra
papers.abstract: Terahertz radiation from $\text{Bi}_2\text{Sr}_2\text{CaCu}_2\text{O}_{8+δ}$ intrinsic Josephson junctions (IJJs) provides an ideal platform to study the synchronization of a macroscopic quantum system. Here, we present a spectral analysis of a frequency-modulated Josephson plasma emitter coupled with patch antennas. In the unmodulated intensity distribution as a function of radiation frequency $I_{\mathrm{UM}}(ω)$, we observe a double Gaussian peak structure. Crucially, double-peak spectra obtained at a constant bias voltage imply either a rapid temporal distribution of resonances or their simultaneous excitation, driven by the mutual electromagnetic coupling between the IJJ mesa and the antennas. At low modulation frequencies $f_m$, the spectra are well reproduced by the products of $I_{\mathrm{UM}}(ω)$ and frequency combs, yielding a synchronized relaxation time $τ_s \simeq 0.28\text{ ns}$. Incorporating $τ_s$ quantitatively reproduces a drastic spectral transformation observed around $f_m \sim 1\text{ GHz}$, unveiling the sub-nanosecond non-equilibrium dynamics of coupled Josephson plasma.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“present a spectral analysis”（光谱分析）、“observed a double Gaussian peak structure”（观察到双高斯峰结构）等实验观测描述，并涉及频率调制、时间分辨等实验手段。；研究对象：铜氧化物超导体Bi₂Sr₂CaCu₂O₈₊δ中的本征约瑟夫森结（IJJs）堆叠结构，以及与之耦合的贴片天线构成的约瑟夫森等离子体发射器。研究聚焦于该体系的太赫兹辐射频谱及其同步动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在未调制的辐射频谱中观察到双高斯峰结构，表明恒定偏压下存在共振的快速时间分布或同时激发。通过低频调制实验提取出同步弛豫时间τ_s ≈ 0.28 ns，该时间尺度成功再现了约1 GHz调制频率附近发生的剧烈频谱转变，揭示了亚纳秒尺度的非平衡动力学。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在未调制的辐射频谱中观察到双高斯峰结构，表明恒定偏压下存在共振的快速时间分布或同时激发。通过低频调制实验提取出同步弛豫时间τ_s ≈ 0.28 ns，该时间尺度成功再现了约1 GHz调制频率附近发生的剧烈频谱转变，揭示了亚纳秒尺度的非平衡动力学。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用频率调制（frequency-modulated）的太赫兹辐射光谱分析技术，结合贴片天线耦合的约瑟夫森等离子体发射器。通过测量未调制强度分布I_UM(ω)与频率梳的乘积来拟合调制频谱，并提取同步弛豫时间τ_s。

papers.title: Chemical Vapor Deposition of Ni-doped Iron Germanium Telluride Nanosheets
papers.abstract: Iron germanium telluride (FGT; FemGenTe2) compounds have attracted significant interest due to their layered van der Waals structure, relatively high Curie temperature, and tunable magnetic properties. Chemical vapor deposition (CVD) is a particularly promising synthesis route owing to its simplicity, low cost, potential for scalability, and widespread adoption in the semiconductor industry, yet it has not been used previously to synthesize FGT with dopants. Here, we report CVD synthesis of both undoped and Ni-doped FGT nanosheets on SiO2/Si substrates. By adjusting precursor molar ratios, we synthesized Ni-doped FGT with multiple Fe concentrations and a 4% Ni-to-Fe ratio. X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy depth profiling further demonstrates that Ni is present in the bulk of the crystals. This straightforward, low-cost, and CMOS-compatible approach demonstrates a route to Ni-doped FGT nanosheets, establishing a foundation for future characterization of Ni-doped FGT and its potential integration into spintronic devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：Chemical Vapor Deposition (CVD)、synthesis、X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy。；研究对象：Ni掺杂的铁锗碲（FGT；FeₘGeₙTe₂）纳米片。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过化学气相沉积（CVD）方法，在SiO₂/Si衬底上成功合成了未掺杂和Ni掺杂的FGT纳米片，其中Ni掺杂浓度约为4%（Ni与Fe的比例），且X射线光电子能谱深度剖析证实Ni存在于晶体体相中。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过化学气相沉积（CVD）方法，在SiO₂/Si衬底上成功合成了未掺杂和Ni掺杂的FGT纳米片，其中Ni掺杂浓度约为4%（Ni与Fe的比例），且X射线光电子能谱深度剖析证实Ni存在于晶体体相中。；创新点：首次使用CVD方法合成掺杂的FGT材料（此前CVD未被用于合成含掺杂剂的FGT），提供了一种低成本、与CMOS工艺兼容的Ni掺杂FGT纳米片制备路线。
papers.method_zh: 采用化学气相沉积（CVD）法在SiO₂/Si衬底上生长纳米片；通过调整前驱体摩尔比控制Fe浓度和Ni掺杂比例；使用X射线光电子能谱（XPS）深度剖析表征Ni在晶体中的分布。

papers.title: Tunable Chaos in the Finite Mean SYK Model
papers.abstract: The complex Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev (SYK) model, featuring fermions with all-to-all interactions, serves as a dual paradigm for understanding non-Fermi liquid behavior and the holographic nature of charged black holes. Two defining characteristics of the standard SYK model are its maximal chaos (Lyapunov exponent $λ_{\mathrm{L}}=2πT$ at temperature $T$), and its finite zero-temperature residual entropy. While previous studies have largely focused on couplings drawn from a zero-mean Gaussian distribution, we investigate a generalized model with a finite mean-to-standard-deviation ratio, $g\equiv J_{0}/δJ$ of the coupling distribution in order to get deeper insight into the evolution of chaos. We find that increasing $g$ yields the following effects: (i) The system remains a fast scrambler with $λ_{\mathrm{L}}=A~T$, but with a suppressed coefficient $A<2π$. (ii) In the limit $g\to \infty$, out-of-time-ordered correlators (OTOCs) no longer exhibit exponential growth with $λ_{\mathrm{L}}\simeq 0$. (iii) The spectral correlations indicative of late-time chaos maintain Wigner-Dyson level spacing statistics for all values of $g$. (iv) The system preserves a finite residual entropy, albeit with reduced magnitude, for all $g$ values. We conclude that in this generalized SYK model, there is a chaotic to non-chaotic crossover. Moreover different measures of chaos decouple, demonstrating that the presence of finite residual entropy does not strictly imply maximal chaos.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：SYK模型、混沌、Lyapunov指数、谱统计、残余熵。；研究对象：有限均值SYK模型（Finite Mean SYK Model），即耦合常数分布具有非零均值（有限均值-标准差比g）的Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev模型，研究其混沌性质随g的演化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 增大耦合分布的均值-标准差比g会抑制混沌，使Lyapunov指数从最大混沌值（2πT）降低至零（g→∞时），但系统仍保持Wigner-Dyson能级统计（晚期混沌特征）和有限残余熵。这表明不同混沌度量之间发生解耦，残余熵的存在并不必然意味着最大混沌。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：增大耦合分布的均值-标准差比g会抑制混沌，使Lyapunov指数从最大混沌值（2πT）降低至零（g→∞时），但系统仍保持Wigner-Dyson能级统计（晚期混沌特征）和有限残余熵。这表明不同混沌度量之间发生解耦，残余熵的存在并不必然意味着最大混沌。；创新点：首次系统研究SYK模型中耦合分布有限均值（而非零均值）对混沌的调控作用，揭示了混沌到非混沌的交叉行为，并指出残余熵与最大混沌之间不存在严格对应关系。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：通过计算out-of-time-ordered correlators（OTOCs）提取Lyapunov指数λ_L，并分析能级间距分布（Wigner-Dyson统计）和残余熵，研究有限均值高斯分布耦合的SYK模型。

papers.title: Magnon-dislon hybridization in magnetic insulators
papers.abstract: Spin dynamics in ordered magnets with topological lattice defects is investigated. Using fracton--elasticity duality, we develop an effective field theory of magnons coupled to quantized lattice dislocations (dislons) in magnetic insulators. Within this framework, an elastic gauge field mediates a nonlocal interaction between dislocations and magnetization gradients. The resulting magnetoelastic coupling gives rise to coherent magnon-dislon hybridization whose properties are dictated by dislocation topology. Screw dislocations exhibit helicity-selective hybridization and symmetry-protected dark dislon sectors, while edge dislocations generate anisotropic hybrid excitations with finite spin-precession ellipticity through the glide constraint. Our results establish dislocations as dynamical topological defects with directly observable polarization fingerprints in magnon spectra, and reveal magnon-dislon hybridization as a new route to control spin dynamics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：effective field theory、fracton--elasticity duality、develop。；研究对象：具有拓扑晶格缺陷的有序磁体中的自旋动力学，具体为磁性绝缘体中与量子化晶格位错（dislons）耦合的磁振子（magnons）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 位错与磁振子之间可形成相干杂化（magnon-dislon hybridization），其性质由位错拓扑决定：螺位错产生螺旋度选择性杂化和对称性保护暗位错态，刃位错通过滑移约束产生具有有限自旋进动椭圆率的各向异性杂化激发。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：位错与磁振子之间可形成相干杂化（magnon-dislon hybridization），其性质由位错拓扑决定：螺位错产生螺旋度选择性杂化和对称性保护暗位错态，刃位错通过滑移约束产生具有有限自旋进动椭圆率的各向异性杂化激发。；创新点：将位错视为动力学拓扑缺陷，并揭示其在磁振子谱中具有可直接观测的极化指纹，从而提出磁振子-位错杂化作为控制自旋动力学的新途径。
papers.method_zh: 采用分形子-弹性对偶（fracton--elasticity duality）构建有效场论，引入弹性规范场描述位错与磁化梯度之间的非局域相互作用。

papers.title: Dynamical axion quasiparticles: an open quantum system
papers.abstract: We study the non-equilibrium dynamics of emergent dynamical axion quasiparticles (DAQ) coupled to a photon bath in equilibrium via a Chern-Simons term as a quantum open system. A quantum master equation (QME) is derived up to second order in this coupling implementing only a \emph{partial} Markov approximation, allowing time dependent rates in the Lindblad (QME). These are determined by the equilibrium correlation functions of the Chern-Simons density, and their time dependence allows us to explore transient dynamics in coherences and population: the formation of the quasiparticle on short time scales and its decay, and the build-up of population with an effective time dependent rate. Early time evolution features quantum \emph{anti} Zeno dynamics with enhanced quasiparticle decay and population growth. These phenomena describe transient violations of Fermi's Golden rule and of \emph{detailed balance}, and are distinct \emph{non-Markovian} effects directly related to the spectral density of the Chern-Simons correlators. We obtain the equation of motion of coherent (DAQ) condensates both with the (QME) and with quantum many body linear response establishing a direct bridge between both methods. As a corollary we obtain the expectation value of the Chern-Simons density \emph{induced} by a (DAQ) condensate in linear response, the topological susceptibility is shown to be proportional to the (DAQ) many body self-energy. We provide a Feynman diagram-based interpretation of approximations invoked in the (QME) and corrections from system-bath correlations in higher order.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：open quantum system、quantum master equation、linear response、Feynman diagram。；研究对象：与光子浴耦合的涌现动力学轴子准粒子（dynamical axion quasiparticles, DAQ）的非平衡动力学，具体通过Chern-Simons项耦合。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在部分马尔可夫近似下，准粒子形成与衰变过程中存在量子反芝诺动力学（quantum anti Zeno dynamics），导致费米黄金定则和细致平衡的瞬态破坏，这些非马尔可夫效应直接源于Chern-Simons关联函数的谱密度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在部分马尔可夫近似下，准粒子形成与衰变过程中存在量子反芝诺动力学（quantum anti Zeno dynamics），导致费米黄金定则和细致平衡的瞬态破坏，这些非马尔可夫效应直接源于Chern-Simons关联函数的谱密度。；创新点：首次将动力学轴子准粒子作为开放量子系统处理，揭示了非马尔可夫瞬态动力学（如反芝诺效应）对准粒子形成和衰变的影响，并建立了QME与多体线性响应之间的直接对应关系。
papers.method_zh: 采用开放量子系统框架，推导至二阶耦合的量子主方程（QME），仅实施部分马尔可夫近似（允许含时Lindblad速率）；同时结合量子多体线性响应理论，建立两种方法的桥梁；提供费曼图解释。

papers.title: Magnetic field induced transition from nodeless to nodal superconductivity in $β$-PdBi$_{2}$
papers.abstract: Recent tunneling measurements on $β$-PdBi$_2$ reported a magnetic field induced phase transition from a fully gapped to a nodal superconducting state. We develop a microscopic theory of superconductivity in this multi-band material, taking into account spin-orbit coupling and Zeeman splitting. We show that there are two attractive pairing channels in this system: an s-wave and a p-wave. At zero magnetic field, s-wave superconductivity wins. At a finite field, this channel becomes less favorable because Fermi surfaces split, and the gap symmetry changes to p-wave. We show that at a higher field, the excitation spectrum of a p-wave multi-band superconductor becomes gapless, with nodal points located in between the split Fermi surfaces. We argue that this behavior accounts for the experimentally observed field-induced nodal superconductivity in $β$-PdBi$_2$.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：develop a microscopic theory、show、argue。；研究对象：多带超导体β-PdBi₂在磁场诱导下从无能隙到有能隙超导态的相变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 零磁场下s波超导占优，有限磁场下费米面分裂导致配对通道转变为p波，并在更高磁场下p波多带超导体的激发谱出现节点，解释了实验观测到的磁场诱导节点超导现象。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：零磁场下s波超导占优，有限磁场下费米面分裂导致配对通道转变为p波，并在更高磁场下p波多带超导体的激发谱出现节点，解释了实验观测到的磁场诱导节点超导现象。；创新点：首次从微观理论层面揭示了β-PdBi₂中磁场诱导从全能隙到节点超导的机制，即通过s波与p波配对通道的竞争以及费米面分裂导致能隙对称性转变。
papers.method_zh: 微观理论分析，考虑自旋-轨道耦合和塞曼劈裂，通过分析多带系统中的配对通道（s波和p波）竞争及费米面分裂对能隙对称性的影响。

papers.title: Hydration-controlled twist forms a moiré glass in charge-frustrated layered silicates
papers.abstract: Twisting layered materials produces moiré superlattices, but prescribed twist angles are usually obtained by demanding assembly procedures. Here we show that montmorillonite, an abundant swelling clay, forms tunable moiré superlattices naturally. Focal-series high-resolution transmission electron microscopy, geometric phase analysis, and molecular dynamics simulation reveal that its apparent rotational disorder is biased toward low-angle misorientations inherited from discrete hydration states. Multilayer stacks preferentially adopt twists near 1-2°, 4°, and 10°, producing long-wavelength moirés without long-range rotational order. We define this kinetically trapped state as a moiré glass, distinct from featureless turbostratic stacking. Simulations indicate that lattice-charge disorder stabilizes the angular preferences, whereas charge ordering promotes random stacking. Hydration screens interlayer interactions and lubricates twist, while dehydration arrests the resulting configurations in discrete steps. These results establish dynamic hydration as a macroscopic handle for programming twist in layered matter.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算）。判断依据：使用了“focal-series high-resolution transmission electron microscopy”（实验）和“molecular dynamics simulation”（计算）。；研究对象：蒙脱石（montmorillonite）这种层状硅酸盐矿物中，由水合作用控制的扭转角所形成的莫尔超晶格，以及由此产生的“莫尔玻璃”（moiré glass）态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 蒙脱石中看似随机的旋转无序实际上偏向于由离散水合状态决定的特定低角度取向（约1-2°、4°和10°），形成一种缺乏长程旋转有序的动力学捕获态，作者将其定义为“莫尔玻璃”，区别于无特征的无序堆叠。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：蒙脱石中看似随机的旋转无序实际上偏向于由离散水合状态决定的特定低角度取向（约1-2°、4°和10°），形成一种缺乏长程旋转有序的动力学捕获态，作者将其定义为“莫尔玻璃”，区别于无特征的无序堆叠。；创新点：发现并定义了“莫尔玻璃”这一新的物质态，并揭示了水合作用（hydration）可作为宏观调控手段来编程层状材料中的扭转角，这与通常需要精密组装才能获得特定扭转角的做法不同。
papers.method_zh: 聚焦系列高分辨率透射电子显微镜（focal-series HRTEM）、几何相位分析（geometric phase analysis）、分子动力学模拟（molecular dynamics simulation）。

papers.title: Persistent current and orbital magnetization along a valley-contrasting junction in bilayer graphene in a magnetic field
papers.abstract: In a magnetic field bilayer graphene hosts an octet of pseudo-zero-mode electron levels nearly degenerate in orbitals $n=(0,1)$, valleys and spins. They split in valleys by electrostatic gating. In gated bilayer graphene, in which the interlayer bias is set up to flip sign across a line, one has a line junction that traps a portion of pseudo-zero-mode electrons inside the insulating bulk band gap, giving rise to electron states localized along the junction, known as kink states. A close look is made into the spectra and electromagnetic response of such kink states. There are two species of valley current associated with them, a drift current driven by the bias gradient and a circulating current coming from cyclotron motion. It turns out that they both flow in essentially the same direction, with the circulating current exhibiting a magnetic character distinct from those of other higher levels. In equilibrium they spatially circulate within the kink states, creating a quasi-one-dimensional channel of orbital magnetization. The electric control of the orbital magnetization and valley currents via a network of gated junctions will find useful applications in valley electronics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“A close look is made into the spectra and electromagnetic response”，以及理论分析“drift current”、“circulating current”等概念，未涉及实验或计算模拟细节。；研究对象：双层石墨烯中由门电压调控形成的谷对比结（valley-contrasting junction）中的扭结态（kink states），以及这些态在磁场下的持续电流和轨道磁化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在磁场下，双层石墨烯的扭结态中存在两种谷电流：由偏压梯度驱动的漂移电流和来自回旋运动的循环电流，两者流向基本一致；循环电流表现出不同于其他高能级的磁性特征，并在平衡态下沿扭结态空间循环，形成准一维轨道磁化通道。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在磁场下，双层石墨烯的扭结态中存在两种谷电流：由偏压梯度驱动的漂移电流和来自回旋运动的循环电流，两者流向基本一致；循环电流表现出不同于其他高能级的磁性特征，并在平衡态下沿扭结态空间循环，形成准一维轨道磁化通道。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析，基于磁场下双层石墨烯的赝零模电子能级（八重态）及其在门电压下的谷分裂，构建线结模型并分析其能谱与电磁响应。

papers.title: Magnetotransport Measurements on Isolated Polycrystalline Grains of Type-II Silicon Clathrate
papers.abstract: The first low-temperature electronic transport characterization of individual polycrystalline grains of type-II silicon clathrate (Na$_x$Si$_{136}$, $x \ll 1$), isolated using microfabrication techniques, is reported. Structural characterization via Raman spectroscopy confirms that the isolated grains are largely devoid of amorphous silicon (a-Si). Temperature-dependent resistivity reveals multiple conduction regimes, including thermally activated freeze-out behavior and a transition to low-activation-energy transport at cryogenic temperatures, consistent with hopping conduction mechanisms. Hall measurements from 290 K to 3.5 K yield carrier concentration and mobility trends that correlate with the extracted activation energies, verifying $n$-type conduction. Additionally, gate-dependent conductivity measurements demonstrate electrostatic tunability at room temperature. Collectively, these results establish the magnetotransport parameters of single, isolated grains of type-II silicon clathrate and demonstrate the potential of this material for future quantum and optoelectronic devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：关键词“Magnetotransport Measurements”、“low-temperature electronic transport characterization”、“Hall measurements”、“gate-dependent conductivity measurements”。；研究对象：II型硅包合物（NaₓSi₁₃₆，x ≪ 1）的孤立多晶颗粒，具体研究其低温电子输运性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 首次实现了对孤立II型硅包合物多晶颗粒的低温电输运表征，观察到多种导电机制（包括热激活冻结行为和低温跳跃导电），并验证了n型导电和室温静电可调性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：首次实现了对孤立II型硅包合物多晶颗粒的低温电输运表征，观察到多种导电机制（包括热激活冻结行为和低温跳跃导电），并验证了n型导电和室温静电可调性。；创新点：首次对单个孤立II型硅包合物多晶颗粒进行低温磁输运测量，而非对块体或薄膜样品进行平均测量，从而获得本征输运参数。
papers.method_zh: 微加工技术分离孤立多晶颗粒；拉曼光谱进行结构表征；变温电阻率测量（从高温到低温）；霍尔效应测量（290 K至3.5 K）提取载流子浓度和迁移率；栅压依赖的电导测量。

papers.title: Negative diffusivity of excitons in electron-hole plasmas
papers.abstract: We develop a minimal hydrodynamic framework to describe exciton transport in the presence of an electron hole plasma in 2D semiconductors. Treating excitons, electrons, and holes as coupled fluids, we show that exciton diffusion is strongly renormalized by momentum exchange with the plasma. In the collisional regime, mutual diffusion leads to a nontrivial redistribution of transport coefficients but preserves the positivity of the exciton diffusivity. In contrast, when plasma inertia and collective charge oscillations are accounted for, the exciton diffusive mode hybridizes with acoustic plasma modes, giving rise to a dynamical instability manifested as an effective negative diffusion coefficient. We demonstrate that this instability originates from the nonequilibrium coupling between slow excitons and fast plasma degrees of freedom, rather than from nonlinear diffusion or thermodynamic effects. Our results provide a unified physical mechanism for negative exciton diffusivity reported in recent experiments and establish collective plasma dynamics as a key control parameter of exciton transport in 2D materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“develop a minimal hydrodynamic framework”、“treating excitons, electrons, and holes as coupled fluids”、“show that...”。；研究对象：二维半导体中电子-空穴等离子体环境下的激子输运现象，具体关注激子扩散系数在等离子体耦合下的行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 激子与电子-空穴等离子体耦合时，在考虑等离子体惯性和集体电荷振荡的情况下，激子扩散模式会与声学等离子体模式杂化，导致动力学不稳定性，表现为有效的负扩散系数。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：激子与电子-空穴等离子体耦合时，在考虑等离子体惯性和集体电荷振荡的情况下，激子扩散模式会与声学等离子体模式杂化，导致动力学不稳定性，表现为有效的负扩散系数。；创新点：揭示了负激子扩散系数源于慢激子与快等离子体自由度之间的非平衡耦合，而非非线性扩散或热力学效应，并将集体等离子体动力学确立为二维材料中激子输运的关键控制参数。
papers.method_zh: 建立最小流体动力学框架，将激子、电子和空穴视为耦合流体，分析动量交换对激子扩散的重整化效应，并引入等离子体惯性和集体振荡模式进行线性稳定性分析。

papers.title: akaitools: A Python package for parsing and analyzing AkaiKKR electronic structure calculations
papers.abstract: The Korringa-Kohn-Rostoker (KKR) Green's function method is a first-principles electronic structure approach well suited to substitutionally disordered alloys through the Coherent Potential Approximation (CPA). AkaiKKR is a widely used implementation, known for efficient treatment of metallic systems and their magnetic properties. Its output, however, is unstructured plain text with no programmatic interface, leaving data extraction entirely to the user and making systematic or high-throughput studies impractical. akaitools is a Python package that parses AkaiKKR output files into structured, type-annotated Python objects. The package covers three output types: self-consistent field (SCF) results, which capture convergence history and per-atom electronic and magnetic properties; spin-resolved, orbital projected density of states for each CPA component; and Bloch spectral functions on a user-defined k-point path. Results come back as immutable dataclasses backed by NumPy arrays. Energy quantities are available in both Rydbergs and electronvolts, and results can be exported to Pandas DataFrames. A built-in plotting module produces Matplotlib figures for DOS curves and SCF convergence. A command-line interface provides file summaries and JSON export without any Python scripting. The package also includes a programmatic input file generator, so full calculation pipelines from input preparation to output analysis can be run in Python.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：Python package, parsing, analyzing, electronic structure calculations, first-principles）；研究对象：AkaiKKR电子结构计算软件的输出文件（具体为：自洽场结果、态密度、Bloch谱函数）
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 摘要未明确说明物理发现。该工作开发了一个名为akaitools的Python包，用于将AkaiKKR非结构化的文本输出解析为结构化的Python对象，从而支持系统化、高通量的数据分析。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：摘要未明确说明物理发现。该工作开发了一个名为akaitools的Python包，用于将AkaiKKR非结构化的文本输出解析为结构化的Python对象，从而支持系统化、高通量的数据分析。；创新点：为AkaiKKR这一广泛使用的计算程序提供了首个程序化接口，解决了其输出文件无结构化、难以进行系统化或高通量研究的痛点。该包还包含了输入文件生成器，使得从输入准备到输出分析的完整计算流程可在Python中完成。
papers.method_zh: 开发了Python软件包，用于解析AkaiKKR（基于KKR-Green函数方法和相干势近似CPA的第一性原理计算程序）的输出文件。该包将数据转换为类型注解的Python对象（不可变数据类，基于NumPy数组），并提供了导出为Pandas DataFrame、内置Matplotlib绘图模块以及命令行界面等功能。

papers.title: Quantum Geometry and Topology of Bulk Plasmons in Weyl Metals
papers.abstract: We address the quantum geometric structure of plasmons in Fermi surfaces enclosing a topological charge. We demonstrate that Weyl fermion plasmons have monopole structure, are topological and have a finite vorticity $ζ=2\mathsf{C}_{\text{w}}$, where $\mathsf{C}_{\text{w}}$ is the Chern number of the Fermi surface enclosing the Weyl point. We show that these plasmons selectively couple to light linearly polarized along the plasmon effective dipole moment $\mathbf{d}$, which has quantum geometric origin and points along the direction of the plasmon center of mass momentum $\hat{\mathbf{Q}}$. We suggest that Weyl metal topological plasmons have distinctive optical properties compared to conventional plasmons.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：demonstrate、show、suggest（理论推导与论证）。；研究对象：Weyl金属中体等离激元（bulk plasmons）的量子几何与拓扑性质，具体为费米面包围Weyl点时的等离激元。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Weyl费米子等离激元具有单极子结构，是拓扑的，且具有有限涡量ζ=2C_w（C_w为费米面包围Weyl点的陈数）；这些等离激元选择性地与沿其有效偶极矩d方向线性偏振的光耦合，d具有量子几何起源并指向等离激元质心动量方向。
