papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Weyl费米子等离激元具有单极子结构，是拓扑的，且具有有限涡量ζ=2C_w（C_w为费米面包围Weyl点的陈数）；这些等离激元选择性地与沿其有效偶极矩d方向线性偏振的光耦合，d具有量子几何起源并指向等离激元质心动量方向。；创新点：首次揭示Weyl金属中体等离激元具有单极子拓扑结构，并指出其与常规等离激元相比具有独特的光学性质（如偏振选择性耦合）。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析框架，基于费米面包围拓扑荷（Weyl点）的量子几何结构，推导等离激元的拓扑性质（涡量、陈数）及光耦合选择性。

papers.title: Stochastic Thermodynamics and SDE-based Generative Models
papers.abstract: SDE-based generative models, including diffusion models and the Schrödinger bridge, have found broad applications in signal processing tasks such as speech enhancement, image restoration, and time-series generation. This note presents a modeling framework for such models within the context of stochastic thermodynamics. The main results of this note are trajectory-level definitions of work, heat, and entropy production, along with a generalized Jarzynski identity and a second-law-like inequality. The proposed framework extends the original Jarzynski setup to accommodate time-dependent bath temperature and nonconservative driving forces. This thermodynamic perspective may deepen our understanding of diffusion models and the Schrödinger bridge from a nonequilibrium statistical mechanics viewpoint.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：stochastic thermodynamics（随机热力学）、modeling framework（建模框架）、trajectory-level definitions（轨迹级定义）。；研究对象：基于随机微分方程（SDE）的生成模型，包括扩散模型和薛定谔桥，以及它们在信号处理任务（如语音增强、图像恢复、时间序列生成）中的应用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在随机热力学框架下，为SDE生成模型定义了轨迹层面的功、热和熵产生，并推导了广义Jarzynski恒等式和类似第二定律的不等式。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在随机热力学框架下，为SDE生成模型定义了轨迹层面的功、热和熵产生，并推导了广义Jarzynski恒等式和类似第二定律的不等式。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用随机热力学的理论框架，将原始Jarzynski设置扩展到随时间变化的浴温度和非保守驱动力，从而对扩散模型和薛定谔桥进行非平衡统计力学分析。

papers.title: Quantum solitons and their quantum walks in transmon arrays
papers.abstract: Superconducting qubits are artificial atoms whose spectra and interactions can be engineered through appropriate circuit design, a versatility that can be exploited for quantum simulation. We theoretically investigate a linear array of capacitively coupled transmons, effectively described by a Bose-Hubbard Hamiltonian with attractive interaction. We revisit the discrete-soliton nature of the lowest-energy band of the spectrum, and identify spatially localized quantum solitons. The solitonic character of these states is revealed through their time evolution, which displays a quantum interference pattern, or quantum walk, highlighting their composite nature. We discuss protocols for preparing spatially localized quantum solitons that are compatible with current state-of-the-art tunable-transmon circuits. Our results demonstrate that superconducting circuits provide a promising and experimentally accessible platform for the investigation of quantum soliton physics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：theoretically investigate, revisit, identify, discuss protocols）；研究对象：超导transmon量子比特线性阵列中的量子孤子及其量子行走现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在具有吸引相互作用的Bose-Hubbard模型描述的transmon阵列中，最低能带存在空间局域的量子孤子态，其时间演化呈现量子干涉图案（量子行走），揭示了孤子的复合粒子本质。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在具有吸引相互作用的Bose-Hubbard模型描述的transmon阵列中，最低能带存在空间局域的量子孤子态，其时间演化呈现量子干涉图案（量子行走），揭示了孤子的复合粒子本质。；创新点：将超导电路（transmon阵列）作为研究量子孤子物理的实验可行平台，并提出了与当前可调谐transmon电路兼容的量子孤子制备协议。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：基于电容耦合transmon阵列的Bose-Hubbard哈密顿量（吸引相互作用），通过能带结构分析识别离散孤子态，并数值模拟时间演化以展示量子行走行为。

papers.title: Topology of Bloch Bands from Cauchy Data
papers.abstract: In a previous work, the topology of inversion-symmetric one-dimensional periodic media was characterized through the pole-zero pattern of an impedance-like function associated with Bloch waves. This construction reproduces the Berry--Zak invariant and provides a criterion for topological interface states. In the present work, we give a geometric interpretation of this formalism. We show that poles and zeros arise naturally from the action of inversion symmetry on the projectivized space of Cauchy data. The corresponding Dirichlet and Neumann states are identified with the two fixed points of the induced $\mathbb Z_2$ action on the Riemann sphere. The key observation is that Bloch eigenvectors are naturally constructed on the universal covering of the Brillouin circle. The topology of the associated Real eigenline bundle is encoded in the action of the deck transformation group on lifted eigenvectors. This action is described by a monodromy sign $ρ\in\{\pm1\}$, determined by the inversion representations carried by the band at the fixed points of the Brillouin zone. We show that this monodromy defines a natural rank-one local system over the Brillouin circle. The corresponding Real line bundle is classified by its first Stiefel--Whitney class, which coincides with the associated $\mathbb Z_2$ pole-zero invariant. This establishes a geometric connection between the pole-zero formalism, Berry--Zak phases, Real bundles and local coefficient systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：geometric interpretation、formalism、monodromy、local system、Stiefel–Whitney class。；研究对象：一维具有反演对称性的周期介质（periodic media）中布洛赫能带的拓扑性质，具体涉及布洛赫波函数、阻抗函数、Berry–Zak相位、实线丛（Real line bundle）及局部系数系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过柯西数据（Cauchy data）的投影化空间和反演对称性作用，自然导出布洛赫能带的极-零点结构，并证明该结构对应的Z₂极-零点不变量与第一Stiefel–Whitney类一致，从而建立了极-零点形式、Berry–Zak相位、实线丛与局部系数系统之间的几何联系。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过柯西数据（Cauchy data）的投影化空间和反演对称性作用，自然导出布洛赫能带的极-零点结构，并证明该结构对应的Z₂极-零点不变量与第一Stiefel–Whitney类一致，从而建立了极-零点形式、Berry–Zak相位、实线丛与局部系数系统之间的几何联系。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用几何与拓扑理论框架，包括：反演对称性在黎曼球面上的Z₂作用、布洛赫圆（Brillouin circle）的万有覆盖、覆盖变换群（deck transformation group）对提升本征向量的作用、单值性符号（monodromy sign ρ∈{±1}）、实线丛的第一Stiefel–Whitney类分类。

papers.title: Bulk-boundary correspondence of (1+1)D symmetric gapped phases
papers.abstract: We develop an operator-algebraic framework for boundary conditions and bulk-boundary correspondence in one-dimensional gapped phases with categorical symmetry. Working directly in the thermodynamic limit, we construct half-infinite fusion spin chains and commuting-projector boundary Hamiltonians from a unitary fusion category $\mathcal{C}$, an indecomposable semisimple right $\mathcal{C}$-module category $\mathcal{M}$, a Q-system $Q\in\mathcal{C}$ specifying the bulk phase, and a right $Q$-module $K\in\mathcal{M}_{Q}$, regarded as an object of $\mathcal{M}_{Q}^{\mathrm{op}}$, specifying the boundary. We prove that these Hamiltonians have unique ground states and that the resulting realization functor $\mathcal{M}_{Q}^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathrm{BCond}$ is an equivalence, so simple boundary conditions are classified by simple objects of $\mathcal{M}_{Q}$ and general boundary conditions by their finite direct sums. We also give a microscopic formulation of the boundary symmetry topological field theory using DHR bimodules of the boundary quasi-local algebra. For a half-infinite fusion spin chain, the boundary DHR category is monoidally equivalent to $(\mathcal{C}_{\mathcal{M}}^{\vee})^{\mathrm{rev}}$, and the canonical action of the bulk DHR category on it agrees with the categorical action of $Z_1(\mathcal{C}^{\mathrm{rev}})$. Finally, we identify the action of the boundary DHR category on boundary conditions with the categorical action of $(\mathcal{C}_{\mathcal{M}}^{\vee})^{\mathrm{rev}}$ on $\mathcal{M}_{Q}^{\mathrm{op}}$. This yields a one-dimensional bulk-boundary correspondence: the enriched monoidal category describing the bulk is the enriched center of the enriched category describing the boundary.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：operator-algebraic framework、categorical symmetry、mathematical proof。；研究对象：一维（1+1D）对称能隙相中的边界条件与体-边对应关系，具体为基于幺正融合范畴、模范畴和Q-系统的代数框架。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 证明了边界条件由右Q-模范畴的简单对象分类，并建立了体-边对应关系：描述体的富化幺半范畴是描述边的富化范畴的富化中心。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：证明了边界条件由右Q-模范畴的简单对象分类，并建立了体-边对应关系：描述体的富化幺半范畴是描述边的富化范畴的富化中心。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用算子代数框架，在热力学极限下构造半无限融合自旋链和交换投影子边界哈密顿量，利用幺正融合范畴、半单右模范畴、Q-系统及右Q-模对象进行数学分类，并通过DHR双模和范畴等价性证明体-边对应。

papers.title: Equivariant Graph Neural Networks Improve Optical Spectra Prediction for Materials Screening
papers.abstract: Scalable prediction of optical spectra is a critical component of high-throughput materials screening for optoelectronic applications such as solar cells. Existing surrogate models are trained on spectra computed from lower levels of theory or rely on rotation-invariant scalar features, limiting their geometric expressiveness. We explore the use of equivariant graph neural networks for optical spectra prediction, adapting GotenNet to this task and evaluating it on multiple datasets including a recently published collection of 10,533 structures with spectra computed at the level of the random phase approximation (RPA). The proposed model outperforms the current state of the art, with the largest gains in the 0-8 eV range and on predicting the static real permittivity, both of particular relevance for thin-film optics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：equivariant graph neural networks、optical spectra prediction、surrogate models、RPA。；研究对象：材料的光学性质，具体为光学光谱（optical spectra）的预测，用于高通量筛选光电应用（如太阳能电池）中的材料。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 等变图神经网络（equivariant graph neural networks）在光学光谱预测任务上超越了现有最优模型，尤其在0-8 eV能量范围和静态实介电常数预测上提升最为显著，这两者对薄膜光学尤为重要。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：等变图神经网络（equivariant graph neural networks）在光学光谱预测任务上超越了现有最优模型，尤其在0-8 eV能量范围和静态实介电常数预测上提升最为显著，这两者对薄膜光学尤为重要。；创新点：首次将等变图神经网络应用于光学光谱预测，克服了传统模型仅依赖旋转不变标量特征（rotation-invariant scalar features）的几何表达能力限制，并直接使用RPA级别的高精度计算光谱进行训练。
papers.method_zh: 采用等变图神经网络（具体为GotenNet）作为替代模型（surrogate model），在包含10,533个结构的数据集上进行训练和评估，该数据集的光谱由随机相位近似（RPA）级别理论计算得到。

papers.title: Probing chaos and thermalization through out-of-time-ordered correlators in random field spin chains
papers.abstract: Out-of-time-ordered correlators (OTOCs) have emerged as a diagnostic of information scrambling and quantum chaos in many-body systems. We investigate the imprints of chaos in the dynamics of OTOCs in the Heisenberg spin-$1/2$ chain with random fields. The system is parameterized to exhibit a crossover from integrable to chaotic dynamics. We demonstrate numerically that the approach to saturation of the OTOC can distinguish between integrable and chaotic regimes, with a power-law $(1/t)$ relaxation for integrable systems and a higher-degree power-law decay $(1/t^α; α\ge 1)$ followed by an exponential relaxation for the chaotic regime. We further show that long-range spectral statistics, such as the number variance, are more effective in characterizing quantum chaos in the regime near saturation of OTOC. We also demonstrate that the relaxation and initial scrambling regimes exhibit distinct and universal features, with the former being sensitive and the latter being robust against different realizations of random-fields. The long-time saturation of OTOC also fluctuates with different realizations, and its exact expression is derived through the Eigenstate Thermalization Hypothesis.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：numerically demonstrate（数值演示）、derived through the Eigenstate Thermalization Hypothesis（通过本征态热化假说推导）。；研究对象：随机场海森堡自旋-1/2链中的混沌与热化动力学，具体通过离时有序关联子（OTOC）诊断信息扰乱与量子混沌。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: OTOC的饱和趋近行为可区分可积与混沌体系：可积体系呈幂律（1/t）弛豫，混沌体系先经更高次幂律衰减（1/t^α; α≥1）后转为指数弛豫；长程谱统计量（如数方差）在OTOC接近饱和时能更有效表征量子混沌。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：OTOC的饱和趋近行为可区分可积与混沌体系：可积体系呈幂律（1/t）弛豫，混沌体系先经更高次幂律衰减（1/t^α; α≥1）后转为指数弛豫；长程谱统计量（如数方差）在OTOC接近饱和时能更有效表征量子混沌。；创新点：揭示了OTOC弛豫与初始扰乱阶段对随机场不同实现具有不同敏感性（前者敏感、后者鲁棒），并给出了OTOC长时间饱和值的ETH解析表达式。
papers.method_zh: 数值模拟随机场海森堡自旋-1/2链的动力学，计算OTOC的时间演化；利用本征态热化假说（ETH）推导OTOC长时间饱和值的精确表达式；分析谱统计量（数方差）以表征混沌。

papers.title: Thermodynamic-Kinetic Decoupling Enables Stable Excitonic Emission in Defect-Tolerant Cu-Based Quantum Dots
papers.abstract: Colloidal quantum dots that simultaneously offer room-temperature single-photon purity and high photoluminescence quantum yield are sought for quantum optics, but remain elusive in environmentally benign materials. We introduce a thermodynamic-kinetic decoupling strategy that transforms defect-tolerant CuInS2 quantum dots into bright, narrowband, and photostable single-photon emitters. Zn2+ alloying strains the lattice, thermodynamically suppressing native copper vacancies and narrowing the emission from a broad defect band of approximately 300 meV to an excitonic line of approximately 120 meV. Ga3+ incorporation then kinetically pins the cation sublattice against Cu+ migration, preventing defect regeneration during ZnS shell growth. The resulting Cd-free core/shell dots achieve near-unity quantum yield of approximately 98% while retaining narrow excitonic emission. Critically, room-temperature single-dot spectroscopy reveals homogeneous linewidths as low as approximately 58 meV, strongly suppressed blinking, and high-purity single-photon emission with g2(0) = 0.06. This stabilized excitonic emission directly reduces reabsorption losses in luminescent solar concentrators, yielding an external optical efficiency of 12.68%. Our work establishes a generalizable framework to unlock intrinsic excitonic photophysics in ion-mobile, defect-prone semiconductors, opening a viable path toward high-performance heavy-metal-free emitters for quantum light sources.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了材料合成（Zn2+合金化、Ga3+掺入、ZnS壳层生长）、光学表征（室温单点光谱、量子产率测量）以及器件应用（发光太阳能聚光器效率测试）。；研究对象：缺陷容忍的CuInS2胶体量子点，具体为通过Zn2+和Ga3+共掺杂改性的核/壳结构量子点，旨在实现稳定的激子发射。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过热力学-动力学解耦策略，即Zn2+合金化热力学抑制铜空位缺陷，Ga3+掺入动力学钉扎阳离子亚晶格阻止缺陷再生，成功将缺陷容忍的CuInS2量子点转化为具有近统一量子产率（~98%）、窄带激子发射（~120 meV）和优异单光子发射性能（g²(0)=0.06）的重金属-free量子点光源。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过热力学-动力学解耦策略，即Zn2+合金化热力学抑制铜空位缺陷，Ga3+掺入动力学钉扎阳离子亚晶格阻止缺陷再生，成功将缺陷容忍的CuInS2量子点转化为具有近统一量子产率（~98%）、窄带激子发射（~120 meV）和优异单光子发射性能（g²(0)=0.06）的重金属-free量子点光源。；创新点：提出了一个普适性的“热力学-动力学解耦”策略，分别针对离子迁移率高、易产生缺陷的半导体中两种不同类型的缺陷（本征点缺陷和迁移再生缺陷）进行独立抑制，从而解锁其本征的激子光物理性质。该方法为开发高性能、无重金属的量子光源提供了新路径。
papers.method_zh: 1. 材料合成：胶体化学法合成CuInS2量子点，并进行Zn2+合金化和Ga3+掺杂，随后生长ZnS壳层。2. 光学表征：室温单点光谱学（测量均匀线宽~58 meV、抑制闪烁）、光致发光量子产率测量（~98%）、二阶关联函数g²(0)测量（0.06）。3. 器件应用：将量子点用于发光太阳能聚光器，测试其外部光学效率（12.68%）。

papers.title: Hydrodynamics of perfect fluids with anomalies from the fermionic path integral
papers.abstract: The path integral of the Dirac fermion with vector and axial gauge backgrounds is analyzed near the infrared limit in the presence of residual irrelevant current-current interaction. After integrating out fermions, a semiclassical low-energy effective action is obtained, written in terms of currents. Its expression is found to correspond to the hydrodynamic action previously proposed for perfect barotropic fluids with anomalies at zero temperature. This approach also leads to two further hydrodynamic actions to be associated, respectively, with the Weyl fermion, and the Dirac fermion having independent vector and axial currents. These actions feature four- and five-dimensional bulk-boundary terms, owing to anomaly inflow, which are identified as being the so-called transgression forms. These are generalizations of Chern--Simons forms that involve two gauge fields: the dynamical field and the background field. The path-integral argument provides a ``microscopic'' explanation for several ingredients of the action formulation of hydrodynamics that are necessary to incorporate anomalies. It also clarifies the infrared reduction required to pass from the effective field theory to a local hydrodynamic description. This reduction is implemented by considering restricted variations of the action, familiar from hydrodynamics, which at the same time lead to four-dimensional equations of motion from the five-dimensional transgression terms.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：路径积分、有效作用量、流体动力学、反常。；研究对象：具有反常的完美流体（perfect fluids）在零温下的流体动力学行为，具体涉及狄拉克费米子、外尔费米子以及具有独立矢量流和轴矢流的狄拉克费米子体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 从费米子路径积分出发，在红外极限下并考虑残余的无关流-流相互作用后，推导出的半经典低能有效作用量与先前提出的零温下具有反常的完美正压流体动力学作用量一致，并进一步得到了与外尔费米子及独立矢量/轴矢流狄拉克费米子对应的两种新的流体动力学作用量。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：从费米子路径积分出发，在红外极限下并考虑残余的无关流-流相互作用后，推导出的半经典低能有效作用量与先前提出的零温下具有反常的完美正压流体动力学作用量一致，并进一步得到了与外尔费米子及独立矢量/轴矢流狄拉克费米子对应的两种新的流体动力学作用量。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用费米子路径积分方法，在矢量与轴矢规范背景场下分析狄拉克费米子，通过积分掉费米子得到以流表示的低能有效作用量，并利用反常流入（anomaly inflow）机制识别出四维和五维的体-边界项（即超度形式，transgression forms）。

papers.title: Self-averaging of replica overlaps in the random field Edwards-Anderson model
papers.abstract: The self-averaging of the replica overlap is proven in the Edwards-Anderson (EA) model under random field almost everywhere in the coupling constant space in any dimension. The EA order parameter is represented in terms of the derivative of the free energy density with respect to the random field strength, regardless of boundary conditions. Tasaki's correlation inequality for finite-dimensional spin glass models shows that the expectation of the squared replica overlap is bounded by the squared EA order parameter. These simple evaluations enable us to prove that the variance of the replica overlap vanishes in the infinite-volume limit. The self-averaging of the replica bond overlap is proven also in the EA model with Gaussian exchange interaction without random field. Short-range spin glass models have been shown to behave differently from mean-field spin glass models with RSB phase.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：proven（证明）、representation（表示）、inequality（不等式）、evaluations（评估）。；研究对象：随机场Edwards-Anderson（EA）模型中的副本重叠（replica overlap）自平均性质，以及短程自旋玻璃模型与平均场自旋玻璃模型（具有RSB相）的行为差异。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 证明了在任意维度的随机场EA模型中，副本重叠在耦合常数空间几乎处处具有自平均性；同时，在无随机场的高斯交换相互作用EA模型中，副本键重叠（replica bond overlap）的自平均性也被证明。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：证明了在任意维度的随机场EA模型中，副本重叠在耦合常数空间几乎处处具有自平均性；同时，在无随机场的高斯交换相互作用EA模型中，副本键重叠（replica bond overlap）的自平均性也被证明。；创新点：通过简单的评估方法证明了副本重叠方差在无穷体积极限下消失，从而建立了自平均性；并揭示了短程自旋玻璃模型与具有RSB相的平均场模型在行为上的本质区别。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导与不等式分析。具体包括：将EA序参量表示为自由能密度对随机场强度的导数（不依赖于边界条件）；利用Tasaki关于有限维自旋玻璃模型的关联不等式，证明副本重叠平方的期望值受EA序参量平方的约束。

papers.title: Attention as Frustrated Synchronization
papers.abstract: A network of oscillators that synchronizes perfectly computes nothing further, so an attention architecture built from synchronization must locate its computation in structured departures from agreement. We introduce the Frustrated Synchronization Network (FSN), whose token states are phases on a torus and whose entire value pathway is one learned complex coupling kernel over harmonics and a one-step delay. Each component of the kernel is a frustration in the sense of the synchronization literature. The complex phases are static Kuramoto-Sakaguchi frustration angles, the signed harmonics are repulsive Daido components, and the delay term, which couples each token to the successors of the tokens it attends to, is algebraically identical to Kuramoto-Sakaguchi coupling whose frustration angle is the data's own transition, so next-token prediction is implemented as synchronization frustrated by the data. At matched one-million-parameter and training budgets on character-level text and code, the FSN's validation loss is below a tuned RoPE-SwiGLU transformer's at every epoch measured, and the comparison survives training the baseline to convergence: every thirty-epoch enwik8 seed finishes below the transformer's converged fifty-epoch loss of 1.611, and the FSN's completed fifty-epoch runs converge to 1.5953 +/- 0.0014. A variant with every feed-forward block replaced by mean-field coupling to learned collective modes, leaving no multilayer perceptron in the stack, tracks the transformer. On natural text the unfrustrated base layer falls behind the converged transformer at every copy depth, worst on long-range copy events; the kernel reverses the deficit at every depth of four and beyond. Headline comparisons are at the one-million-parameter scale; a scale ladder is complete through four million parameters with the advantage persisting, and remaining arms are marked as in progress.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：提出新网络架构（FSN）、理论分析（同步、阻挫）、数值实验（验证损失对比）。；研究对象：论文研究了一种基于同步与阻挫概念的新型神经网络架构（Frustrated Synchronization Network, FSN），并将其应用于字符级文本和代码的下一词元预测任务。其物理本质是研究一个由耦合振子（token状态）构成的网络，其计算能力源于对完美同步的偏离（阻挫）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: FSN架构在百万参数级别上，其验证损失低于经过调优的RoPE-SwiGLU Transformer，且该优势在训练至收敛后依然保持（FSN收敛至1.5953，Transformer为1.611）。通过替换所有前馈层为平均场耦合，FSN仍能追踪Transformer的性能。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：FSN架构在百万参数级别上，其验证损失低于经过调优的RoPE-SwiGLU Transformer，且该优势在训练至收敛后依然保持（FSN收敛至1.5953，Transformer为1.611）。通过替换所有前馈层为平均场耦合，FSN仍能追踪Transformer的性能。；创新点：该工作的主要新意在于：

papers.title: Robust and Interpretable Adaptation of Equivariant Materials Foundation Models via Sparsity-promoting Fine-tuning
papers.abstract: Pre-trained materials foundation models, or machine learning interatomic potentials, leverage general physicochemical knowledge to effectively approximate potential energy surfaces. However, they often require domain-specific calibration due to physicochemical diversity as well as mismatches between practical computational settings and those used in constructing the pre-training data. To address this, we propose a sparsity-promoting fine-tuning method that selectively updates model parameters by exploiting the structural properties of E(3)-equivariant materials foundation models. On energy and force prediction tasks across molecular and crystalline benchmarks, our method matches or surpasses full fine-tuning and equivariant low-rank adaptation while updating only $\sim$3~\% of parameters, and in some cases as little as $\sim$0.5~\%. Beyond energy and force calibration, we further demonstrate task generalizability by applying our method to magnetic moment prediction and magnetism-aware total energy modeling. Finally, analysis of sparsity patterns reveals physically interpretable signatures, such as enhanced $d$-orbital contributions in transition metal systems. Overall, our results establish sparsity-promoting fine-tuning as a flexible and interpretable method for domain specialization of equivariant materials foundation models.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词为“pre-trained materials foundation models”、“machine learning interatomic potentials”、“fine-tuning method”、“energy and force prediction tasks”。；研究对象：论文研究的是材料基础模型（即机器学习原子间势）的领域适应问题，具体涉及分子和晶体体系中的能量与力预测，以及磁矩预测和磁性总能量建模。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种基于稀疏性促进的微调方法，仅更新约3%（甚至低至0.5%）的模型参数，即可在能量和力预测任务上达到或超越全参数微调与等变低秩适应的性能，并且微调后的稀疏模式具有物理可解释性（如过渡金属体系中d轨道贡献增强）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种基于稀疏性促进的微调方法，仅更新约3%（甚至低至0.5%）的模型参数，即可在能量和力预测任务上达到或超越全参数微调与等变低秩适应的性能，并且微调后的稀疏模式具有物理可解释性（如过渡金属体系中d轨道贡献增强）。；创新点：提出了一种灵活且可解释的稀疏性促进微调方法，用于等变材料基础模型的领域专业化，该方法在保持高性能的同时大幅减少参数更新量，并揭示了具有物理意义的稀疏模式。
papers.method_zh: 采用稀疏性促进的微调方法，利用E(3)等变材料基础模型的结构特性，选择性地更新模型参数。在分子和晶体基准上进行了能量和力预测任务，并进一步应用于磁矩预测和磁性总能量建模。

papers.title: Holographic Dual of PT Symmetric BCFT
papers.abstract: We present a holographic dual of a two dimensional conformal field theory with non-hermitian but Parity-Time (PT) symmetric boundary conditions, by applying the AdS/BCFT duality and by introducing an imaginary valued scalar field localized on an end-of-the-world brane. We find that as we increase the strength of the non-hermitian PT symmetric interactions, the system experiences a spontaneous PT symmetry breaking. We also consider its Wick rotated setup as a new quantum quenched state and show that its growth of entanglement entropy can be larger than the standard results obtained from standard Cardy states.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：holographic dual（全息对偶）、AdS/BCFT duality（AdS/BCFT对偶）、Wick rotated（威克转动）。；研究对象：具有非厄米但宇称-时间（PT）对称边界条件的二维共形场论（BCFT），以及其全息对偶描述。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 随着非厄米PT对称相互作用强度的增加，系统会发生自发PT对称性破缺；在威克转动后的量子淬火过程中，其纠缠熵的增长可以超过标准Cardy态的结果。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：随着非厄米PT对称相互作用强度的增加，系统会发生自发PT对称性破缺；在威克转动后的量子淬火过程中，其纠缠熵的增长可以超过标准Cardy态的结果。；创新点：首次将PT对称边界条件引入BCFT的全息对偶构造，并揭示了非厄米性对纠缠熵增长的非平凡影响（摘要未突出说明具体与哪些已有模型对比）。
papers.method_zh: 采用AdS/BCFT对偶框架，在端界膜（end-of-the-world brane）上引入一个取虚值的标量场来构建全息对偶。

papers.title: Elastic Surface Instability as a Topological Phase Transition
papers.abstract: The macroscopic instability of soft materials undergoing extreme deformations is traditionally viewed as a pure structural or mechanical failure. Driven by the quest to uncover universal principles across disparate physical systems, we bridge two vibrant yet seemingly disconnected research frontiers: macroscopic finite-strain solid mechanics and quantum-like topological physics. Here, we demonstrate that the classical elastic surface instability of a deformed hyperelastic manifold is not merely a mechanical bifurcation, but fundamentally a topological phase transition. By incorporating Lie group metric evolution into a generalized Stroh formalism, we map the highly nonlinear geometric frustration onto an algebraic surface impedance matrix $\mathbf{H}$. For a semi-infinite hyperelastic half-space under finite compression, we analytically map the system to a one-dimensional Dirac Hamiltonian, where the macroscopic mechanical stretch acts as a tunable knob for the Dirac mass. We reveal that the onset of surface wrinkles marks a topological transition from a trivial to a non-trivial phase characterized by a quantized step in the winding number, naturally giving rise to a robust, macroscopically localized zero-energy edge state. This fundamental linkage unifies macroscopic symmetry breaking with the topological paradigm, opening a new theoretical pathway for programmable smart soft matter.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“demonstrate”“analytically map”“reveal”等理论推导与论证词汇，未提及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：软材料在极端变形下的弹性表面失稳现象，具体为有限压缩下的超弹性半空间（hyperelastic half-space）的褶皱失稳。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 经典弹性表面失稳本质上是一种拓扑相变：从平凡拓扑相到非平凡拓扑相的转变，伴随卷绕数（winding number）的量子化跃变，并自然产生宏观局域的零能边缘态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：经典弹性表面失稳本质上是一种拓扑相变：从平凡拓扑相到非平凡拓扑相的转变，伴随卷绕数（winding number）的量子化跃变，并自然产生宏观局域的零能边缘态。；创新点：首次将宏观有限应变固体力学中的弹性表面失稳与量子拓扑物理中的拓扑相变建立严格对应关系，揭示了褶皱失稳的拓扑本质，为可编程智能软物质提供了新理论路径。
papers.method_zh: 将李群度量演化纳入广义Stroh形式体系，将高度非线性的几何失稳映射为代数表面阻抗矩阵H；对于半无限超弹性半空间，解析映射到一维狄拉克哈密顿量，其中宏观机械拉伸作为狄拉克质量的可调参数。

papers.title: Universal entanglement probes of topological order and locally-achiral manifolds
papers.abstract: We consider the problem of identifying a topological order based on bulk entanglement of the ground-state wavefunction. Previous work showed that some universal information can be extracted from multi-entropy measures, a class of multipartite entanglement measures obtained by applying permutation operators exchanging the degrees of freedom between different replicas of the wavefunction. It remains an open question to what extent such entanglement measures can be used to extract any universal information from the ground state. Here we show that the topological partition function $Z(M)$ of a manifold $M$ can be extracted provided that $M$ satisfies a topological condition which we term ``local achirality". We show that locally-achiral manifolds can be used to extract universal properties of 2+1d topological phases that go beyond the $S$ and $T$ matrices. As a first step towards classifying locally-achiral manifolds, we show that, in four dimensions, such manifolds have vanishing Pontryagin number. We relate this property to the existence of beyond-cohomology time-reversal symmetry protected topological order (T-SPT) in four dimensions. Finally, we present an entanglement measure that detects this nontrivial T-SPT.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：topological order（拓扑序）、entanglement measures（纠缠度量）、topological partition function（拓扑配分函数）。；研究对象：2+1维拓扑有序相的基态波函数，以及满足“局部手性缺失”条件的流形上的拓扑性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 论文证明，对于满足“局部手性缺失”拓扑条件的流形M，可以从基态多体纠缠中提取其拓扑配分函数Z(M)，并利用这类流形提取超越S矩阵和T矩阵的2+1维拓扑相普适性质。此外，论文发现四维中此类流形具有零庞特里亚金数，并将其与四维中超越上同调的时间反演对称保护拓扑序（T-SPT）联系起来。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：论文证明，对于满足“局部手性缺失”拓扑条件的流形M，可以从基态多体纠缠中提取其拓扑配分函数Z(M)，并利用这类流形提取超越S矩阵和T矩阵的2+1维拓扑相普适性质。此外，论文发现四维中此类流形具有零庞特里亚金数，并将其与四维中超越上同调的时间反演对称保护拓扑序（T-SPT）联系起来。；创新点：提出了“局部手性缺失”这一新的拓扑条件，并证明在此条件下可从基态纠缠中提取更丰富的拓扑信息（超越S、T矩阵），同时首次将这一条件与四维T-SPT的探测联系起来。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析，基于多体纠缠度量（multi-entropy measures）和置换算符作用于波函数副本的方法，结合拓扑配分函数与流形拓扑条件的推导。

papers.title: Equilibration of generalized subsystems: a quantum-channel approach
papers.abstract: Quantum systems governed by unitary and reversible microscopic dynamics may nevertheless exhibit equilibration, in the sense that some effective description becomes time-independent. Standard equilibration results usually consider two separate situations: system-environment structures, in which the composite system evolves unitarily while the system of interest equilibrates, and restricted measurements, such as coarse-grained POVMs and observables, in which the measurement statistics equilibrate. Here, we bring these descriptions into a common state-level framework using the concept of generalized subsystems, where the accessible effective state appears as the output of a quantum channel acting on the microscopic state. We derive bounds showing that generalized subsystems equilibrate when their dimension is small compared with the effective dimension of the discarded microscopic information. We further show that this condition is met for typical initial states in large subspaces and that the resulting equilibrium description is largely insensitive to microscopic initial details. The framework recovers the usual equilibration bounds for ordinary subsystems and finite families of POVMs. As an example, we also introduce a finite-resolution energy channel that maps unresolved microscopic energy levels into effective energy levels, thereby making residual effective coherences explicit and showing how spectral multiplicities constrain those coherences while strengthening equilibration. Our results provide a unified state-level formulation of quantum equilibration under general forms of limited accessible information.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：quantum-channel approach、state-level framework、deriving bounds。；研究对象：量子系统在有限可访问信息条件下的平衡化（equilibration）现象，特别是广义子系统（generalized subsystems）的平衡化行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 当广义子系统的维度远小于被丢弃微观信息的有效维度时，该子系统会趋于平衡；该平衡描述对微观初始细节不敏感，且典型初始态在大子空间中满足这一条件。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：当广义子系统的维度远小于被丢弃微观信息的有效维度时，该子系统会趋于平衡；该平衡描述对微观初始细节不敏感，且典型初始态在大子空间中满足这一条件。；创新点：将系统-环境结构和受限测量两种平衡化情形统一到同一状态级框架中，并首次通过广义子系统和量子信道概念给出统一的平衡化界限。摘要未突出说明与具体实验体系的联系。
papers.method_zh: 采用量子信道（quantum channel）框架，将广义子系统的有效状态定义为量子信道对微观状态的输出，并推导出平衡化界限（bounds）。作为示例，引入有限分辨率能量信道（finite-resolution energy channel）分析有效相干性。

papers.title: Probing weak chaos in $\mathcal N=4$ super Yang-Mills and long-range spin chains
papers.abstract: We study signatures of quantum chaos in finite-loop truncations of the planar dilatation operator in the $\mathfrak{su}(2)$ sector of $\mathcal N=4$ super Yang-Mills and its $β$-deformation. These truncations define holographically motivated long-range deformations of the nearest-neighbour XXX spin chain. At one-loop the model is integrable, while the all-loop planar theory is expected to again be integrable. Finite-loop truncations therefore provide a natural setting for investigating how chaotic behaviour emerges between these two integrable limits. We analyse this question using spectral statistics, eigenvector diagnostics and spread complexity. We find that the two- and four-loop truncations develop GOE-like level statistics at sufficiently large coupling but with features characteristic of weak integrability breaking. The integrability breaking at four-loops is weaker than at two-loops and the critical coupling at which chaos occurs is larger, at least for long spin chains. The three-loop truncation does not show the same onset of chaos in the range studied. Eigenvector diagnostics show that the corresponding eigenstates remain less random than GOE vectors, indicating weak ergodicity and multifractality. Finally, we can identify signatures of the eigenvalue and eigenvector chaos in the Krylov-space data. Namely, we demonstrate a correlation of the level spacing statistics with the peak of spread complexity and disorder on the Krylov chain. The delocalisation of the initial state in the Hamiltonian eigenbasis is shown to strongly affect the saturation of complexity. Our results suggest that finite-loop dilatation operators are not generic long-range spin chain Hamiltonians, but already display patterns consistent with the restoration of integrability in the all-loop planar theory.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：spectral statistics, eigenvector diagnostics, spread complexity（谱统计、本征向量诊断、扩展复杂性），属于理论分析。；研究对象：平面极限下 \(\mathcal N=4\) 超杨-米尔斯理论及其 \(\beta\)-形变在 \(\mathfrak{su}(2)\) 扇区中的有限圈截断，以及由此定义的长程自旋链（全圈平面理论预期可积，有限圈截断引入混沌行为）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 两圈和四圈截断在足够大耦合强度下表现出GOE（高斯正交系综）水平的能级统计，但具有弱可积性破缺的特征；三圈截断在研究的参数范围内未出现类似混沌行为。本征态诊断显示对应本征态比GOE向量更不随机，表明弱遍历性和多分形性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：两圈和四圈截断在足够大耦合强度下表现出GOE（高斯正交系综）水平的能级统计，但具有弱可积性破缺的特征；三圈截断在研究的参数范围内未出现类似混沌行为。本征态诊断显示对应本征态比GOE向量更不随机，表明弱遍历性和多分形性。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 使用谱统计（能级间距分布）、本征向量诊断（随机性度量）以及Krylov空间中的扩展复杂性（spread complexity）分析。具体模型为近邻XXX自旋链的长程变形，通过有限圈截断平面 dilatation 算子实现。

papers.title: Steady-state spectral kissing and dissipative phase transitions
papers.abstract: Spectral kissing, recently realized in a Kerr parametric oscillator (KPO), refers to the merging of pairs of energy levels and arises as a manifestation of an excited-state quantum phase transition (ESQPT). Here, we show that this phenomenon has a dissipative counterpart encoded in the spectrum of the steady-state density matrix. Using a dissipative KPO as a representative example, we demonstrate that, in the weak-dissipation regime, the eigenvalues of the steady-state density matrix organize into quasi-degenerate pairs that mirror the spectral kissing of the corresponding closed system. As the dissipation strength increases, this pairing gradually disappears. By analyzing the classical limit of the system, we derive analytical expressions for the critical lines governing both the onset of steady-state spectral kissing and its disappearance at a dissipative phase transition.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：spectral kissing、dissipative phase transitions、analytical expressions、classical limit。；研究对象：耗散型Kerr参量振荡器（dissipative KPO）中的稳态谱亲吻现象（steady-state spectral kissing）以及耗散相变（dissipative phase transition）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在弱耗散条件下，稳态密度矩阵的本征值会形成准简并对，镜像对应封闭系统中的谱亲吻现象；随着耗散增强，这种配对逐渐消失，并在耗散相变处出现临界线。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在弱耗散条件下，稳态密度矩阵的本征值会形成准简并对，镜像对应封闭系统中的谱亲吻现象；随着耗散增强，这种配对逐渐消失，并在耗散相变处出现临界线。；创新点：揭示了封闭系统中激发态量子相变（ESQPT）的谱亲吻现象在开放系统中的耗散对应物，并给出了稳态谱亲吻随耗散强度演化的解析临界条件。
papers.method_zh: 以耗散KPO为模型系统，通过分析稳态密度矩阵的谱结构，结合系统的经典极限分析，推导出控制稳态谱亲吻出现与消失的临界线的解析表达式。

papers.title: Chaos from quantum bath fluctuations
papers.abstract: The effect of a large environment on a finite-size quantum mechanical system is two-fold: It brings dissipation, but also fluctuations of thermal and quantum origin. While dissipation tends to stabilize the dynamics, we question if and how environmental quantum fluctuations can generate chaos in an otherwise classically non-chaotic system. We work out a paradigmatic model of quantum optics: the dissipative Dicke model, where a large spin interacts with a dissipative harmonic mode. We dial in the classical/quantum correspondence by working in the semiclassical regime at large but finite spin. We demonstrate that, starting from a classically regular phase space in the superradiant regime, quantum noise can generate a strange attractor with fractal dimension and a positive Lyapunov exponent. We unveil the deep connection with shear-induced chaos that was recently developed in the mathematical community.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：semiclassical regime、mathematical community、paradigmatic model。；研究对象：耗散Dicke模型（dissipative Dicke model），具体为一个有限尺寸的大自旋与一个耗散谐振子相互作用的量子光学系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在经典非混沌系统中，环境量子涨落可以诱发混沌，产生具有分形维数的奇怪吸引子和正的李雅普诺夫指数。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在经典非混沌系统中，环境量子涨落可以诱发混沌，产生具有分形维数的奇怪吸引子和正的李雅普诺夫指数。；创新点：首次证明量子噪声本身（而非经典耗散）能够在原本经典规则的超辐射相空间中生成混沌动力学，并揭示了其与剪切诱导混沌的深层联系。
papers.method_zh: 采用半经典（semiclassical）理论框架，在自旋大但有限的条件下分析经典/量子对应关系，并借鉴数学界近期发展的剪切诱导混沌（shear-induced chaos）理论。

papers.title: Ground state preparation of random all-to-all Hamiltonians using ADAPT-VQE
papers.abstract: The ground state of random Hamiltonians with all-to-all interactions such as the quantum Sherrington-Kirkpatrick (SK) model and the Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev (SYK) model follow volume-law entanglement and are expected to be hard to model using tensor networks. In recent years, some progress has been made to push the limit of classical methods using neural quantum states. However, it remains an open question whether there exist quantum algorithms that could offer a quantum advantage over the state-of-the-art classical methods in simulating random Hamiltonians. In this work, we show that one such algorithm, TETRIS-ADAPT-VQE, can construct accurate ground states for dense and sparse SYK models containing up to $N=20$ Majorana fermions achieving fidelities $\geq 99.3\%$ and for the quantum SK model with up to $L=18$ sites achieving fidelities $\geq 99.9998\%$. We find that while the preparation of ground states is efficient (in terms of operator pool size and circuit depth) for the SK model, it is not efficient for either dense or moderately sparse SYK models.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：quantum algorithms, ADAPT-VQE, classical methods, tensor networks, neural quantum states。；研究对象：随机全连接哈密顿量的基态，具体包括量子 Sherrington-Kirkpatrick (SK) 模型和 Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev (SYK) 模型（稠密和稀疏两种形式）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: TETRIS-ADAPT-VQE 算法能够以高保真度（≥99.3% 至 ≥99.9998%）制备 SK 模型和 SYK 模型的基态，但该算法对 SK 模型是高效的（算符池大小和电路深度可接受），而对稠密或中等稀疏的 SYK 模型则效率不高。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：TETRIS-ADAPT-VQE 算法能够以高保真度（≥99.3% 至 ≥99.9998%）制备 SK 模型和 SYK 模型的基态，但该算法对 SK 模型是高效的（算符池大小和电路深度可接受），而对稠密或中等稀疏的 SYK 模型则效率不高。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 使用 TETRIS-ADAPT-VQE 量子算法进行数值模拟，通过构造变分量子电路来制备随机全连接哈密顿量的基态，并评估其保真度、算符池大小和电路深度。

papers.title: Diffuse scattering of neutrons in a wave resonator
papers.abstract: In fundamental experiments with neutrons, the neutron flux and the neutron storage time in the measuring setup are of primary importance. These quantities can be increased by using a storage device for neutrons generated by a pulsed source. In a storage device with material walls, both parameters are determined by the probabilities of neutron absorption and diffuse scattering upon reflection from the storage walls, as well as by the neutron decay probability. This work considers a neutron measurement method and presents the results of an experimental determination of the probability of diffuse neutron scattering in a wave resonator.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“实验测定”（experimental determination）中子漫散射概率，并描述了测量方法。；研究对象：中子波谐振器（wave resonator）中中子与材料壁反射时的漫散射（diffuse scattering）现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过实验测定了中子波谐振器中中子反射时的漫散射概率，该概率与中子吸收概率、中子衰变概率共同决定了存储装置中的中子通量和存储时间。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过实验测定了中子波谐振器中中子反射时的漫散射概率，该概率与中子吸收概率、中子衰变概率共同决定了存储装置中的中子通量和存储时间。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 使用脉冲中子源产生中子，并利用具有材料壁的存储装置（波谐振器）进行中子存储实验，通过测量反射过程中的中子损失来定量确定漫散射概率。具体实验装置和测量细节摘要未明确说明。

papers.title: A physical adaptive material motor unit neural network: a hygromorph composite material machine
papers.abstract: Advances in novel materials science enable structures to function as intelligent machines by embedding memory and learning capabilities directly into materials. Our work introduces a physical adaptive material motor unit neural network,leveraging a new generation of controllable actuators composed of wood- and carbon black-based composites, sensitive to temperature and relative humidity. These material actuators are assembled into a motor unit-like structure inspired by muscle contraction trigger, forming an intelligent machine capable of dynamic shading control that can be used, for example, in buildings. The machine is governed by a neural network trained on over 350 experimental data points collected under diverse environmental conditions. By establishing a new data-aware backpropagation training, we show that the machine predicts shading responses and learns to predict appropriate behaviour incrementally as the database expands. We also demonstrate the ability of the machine to optimise configurations to achieve similar shading outputs under two distinct conditions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：introduces、assembled、experimental data points、demonstrate）；研究对象：一种基于木材和炭黑复合材料的可控致动器，构成物理自适应材料电机单元神经网络，用于动态遮阳控制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该材料机器通过数据感知反向传播训练，能够预测遮阳响应，并随着数据库扩展逐步学习预测适当行为；同时能在两种不同环境条件下优化配置以实现相似的遮阳输出。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该材料机器通过数据感知反向传播训练，能够预测遮阳响应，并随着数据库扩展逐步学习预测适当行为；同时能在两种不同环境条件下优化配置以实现相似的遮阳输出。；创新点：将记忆与学习能力直接嵌入材料中，构建物理自适应材料电机单元神经网络，并利用数据感知反向传播训练实现动态遮阳控制。摘要未突出说明与传统智能材料或机器学习方法的对比。
papers.method_zh: 实验构建了由温湿度敏感的木基/炭黑复合材料致动器组成的电机单元结构，并基于超过350个不同环境条件下的实验数据点训练神经网络，采用新提出的数据感知反向传播训练方法。

papers.title: Electromagnetic Characterization of Magnetic Ring: Case of Circular Cross-Section Shape
papers.abstract: This paper introduces a comprehensive two-dimensional analytical model of a toroidal magnetic ring with circular cross-section under sinusoidal excitation. Applying Maxwell's equations in local polar coordinates within a complex permeability, the model derives analytical expressions for the internal magnetic field, magnetic flux, complex impedance, and total losses. It rigorously separates the contributions of eddy current losses, hysteresis losses, and winding losses, while explicitly incorporating the skin effect in the conductive core via Bessel functions. An expression for the apparent permeability is also provided, enabling the nonlinear core behavior to be mapped onto simplified linear material models. The resulting analytical model offers a computationally efficient and accurate foundation for standardized magnetic material characterization, such as Brockhaus and Iwatsu ring measurements, as a powerful alternative to 2D and 3D finite element analysis.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词为“analytical model”（解析模型）、“derives analytical expressions”（推导解析表达式）、“Maxwell's equations”（麦克斯韦方程组）。；研究对象：具有圆形截面的环形磁芯（toroidal magnetic ring with circular cross-section），在正弦激励下的电磁特性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该解析模型能够精确分离环形磁芯中的涡流损耗、磁滞损耗和绕组损耗，并通过贝塞尔函数显式描述导电芯中的趋肤效应，同时提供了表观磁导率表达式，可将非线性磁芯行为映射到简化线性材料模型。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该解析模型能够精确分离环形磁芯中的涡流损耗、磁滞损耗和绕组损耗，并通过贝塞尔函数显式描述导电芯中的趋肤效应，同时提供了表观磁导率表达式，可将非线性磁芯行为映射到简化线性材料模型。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于复磁导率框架，在局部极坐标下应用麦克斯韦方程组，推导出内部磁场、磁通、复阻抗和总损耗的解析表达式。使用贝塞尔函数处理趋肤效应。

papers.title: Post-Selection Probability and Fidelity of Bidirectional Teleportation
papers.abstract: Understanding the scrambling of quantum information is central to many areas of quantum physics, including quantum thermalization, entanglement growth, and quantum information processing. Insights from these studies have, in turn, inspired the development of novel quantum protocols and algorithms. Recently, a bidirectional teleportation protocol was proposed to implement a digital SWAP operation between qubits by leveraging chaotic Hamiltonian evolution combined with measurement and post-selection. In this work, we provide a comprehensive study of two central quantities that characterize the protocol, the post-selection probability and the fidelity, taking into account possible errors in time-reversed dynamics. We show that these quantities can be expressed in terms of standard diagnostics in quantum dynamics, including the Loschmidt echo and its subsystem variant. The results unveil (1) the initial-state dependence of the fidelity and (2) the stability of the post-selection probability in integrable models. Our findings offer practical guidance for the implementation of the protocol on realistic quantum devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“provide a comprehensive study”“expressed in terms of standard diagnostics in quantum dynamics”，属于理论分析，未涉及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：双向量子隐形传态协议中的后选择概率与保真度，具体研究量子信息在混沌哈密顿演化与时间反演动力学中的行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 揭示了保真度对初始态的依赖性，以及可积模型中后选择概率的稳定性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：揭示了保真度对初始态的依赖性，以及可积模型中后选择概率的稳定性。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析框架，利用量子动力学中的标准诊断量（如Loschmidt回声及其子系统变体）来推导后选择概率和保真度的表达式，并考虑时间反演动力学中的可能误差。

papers.title: Adiabatically-induced Kawaguchi geometry and jerk in quantum-classical systems
papers.abstract: Adiabatically eliminating the quantum degrees of freedom in a mixed quantum-classical system produces an effective force in the classical equation of motion. The elimination can be made to any order in the adiabatic parameter, generating a series of higher order forces. By applying a sequence of near-identity unitary transformations to the quantum state, we derive a hierarchy of increasingly accurate effective actions for the classical variables. The third order Euler-Lagrange equation is non-Newtonian as the force depends on the jerk, the third order time derivative of position. We find that the third order terms induce a special kind of Kawaguchi geometry on the space of classical variables. This geometry is characterized by an almost symplectic structure and a differential line element that depends on the acceleration in addition to the velocity. Our results can be used to efficiently capture higher order nonadiabatic effects in molecular dynamics simulations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“推导”、“理论框架”、“几何”等关键词，未涉及实验或计算模拟的具体实施。；研究对象：混合量子-经典系统（mixed quantum-classical system）中的非绝热动力学，具体关注经典变量运动方程中的高阶力（如 jerk 力）及其几何结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在混合量子-经典系统中，通过绝热消除量子自由度至三阶，经典运动方程中出现依赖于位置三阶时间导数（jerk）的非牛顿力。该三阶项在经典变量空间上诱导出一种特殊的 Kawaguchi 几何，其特征是近辛结构和依赖于加速度的微分线元。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在混合量子-经典系统中，通过绝热消除量子自由度至三阶，经典运动方程中出现依赖于位置三阶时间导数（jerk）的非牛顿力。该三阶项在经典变量空间上诱导出一种特殊的 Kawaguchi 几何，其特征是近辛结构和依赖于加速度的微分线元。；创新点：首次将 Kawaguchi 几何（一种依赖于高阶导数的芬斯勒几何）引入到混合量子-经典系统的绝热理论中，揭示了高阶非绝热效应与特定微分几何结构之间的内在联系。
papers.method_zh: 采用一系列近恒等幺正变换（near-identity unitary transformations）对量子态进行逐阶处理，系统地推导出经典变量的有效作用量（effective actions）层级，直至三阶欧拉-拉格朗日方程。

papers.title: Gauging in superconductors and other electronic systems
papers.abstract: Ordinary, s-wave superconductors have been recognized as being topological phases of matter, in which the dynamical gauge field implies less understood global features. Using the tools of topological field theories and generalized symmetries, we provide an updated description of these systems. At very low energies, the Higgs model reduces to the BF theory, which exhibits topological order. Furthermore, the gauge field must be a spin$_c$ connection, to describe the spin of fermions forming Cooper pairs. Gauging implies that superconductors are inherently bosonic systems, yet they are endowed with a gravito-magnetic anomaly that is the remnant of their fermionic origin. We recognize that this anomaly is related to the Gaiotto-Kapustin-Thorngren bosonization, achieved via gauging fermion parity $(-1)^F$, now included in the gauge dynamics. This anomaly characterizes gauged electronic matter in great generality in three and four spacetime dimensions, forbidding trivial massive phases at low energy. It holds beyond the validity of the Higgs model, nd in other kinds of superconductors as well. It also appears in the nontrivial massless phase of three-dimensional electrodynamics, recently understood.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：topological field theories, generalized symmetries, bosonization。；研究对象：超导体（特别是s波超导体）及其他电子系统中的规范场（gauging）效应，以及由此产生的拓扑相和反常。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 超导体在极低能下由BF理论描述，具有拓扑序；其规范场必须是spin_c联络以描述库珀对中电子的自旋。规范场化揭示超导体本质上是玻色子系统，但带有引力-磁反常，这是其费米子起源的残余，该反常与Gaiotto-Kapustin-Thorngren玻色化相关，并普遍存在于三维和四维时空的规范电子物质中，禁止平庸的大质量相。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：超导体在极低能下由BF理论描述，具有拓扑序；其规范场必须是spin_c联络以描述库珀对中电子的自旋。规范场化揭示超导体本质上是玻色子系统，但带有引力-磁反常，这是其费米子起源的残余，该反常与Gaiotto-Kapustin-Thorngren玻色化相关，并普遍存在于三维和四维时空的规范电子物质中，禁止平庸的大质量相。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 使用拓扑场论（BF理论）和广义对称性（generalized symmetries）框架，结合规范场化（gauging）技术，并引入spin_c联络和费米子宇称（-1）^F的规范动力学。

papers.title: Non-Gaussian Phase Transition and Cascade of Instabilities in the Dissipative Quantum Rabi Model
papers.abstract: The open quantum Rabi model describes a two-level system coupled to a harmonic oscillator. A Gaussian phase transition for the nonequilibrium steady states has been predicted when the bosonic mode is soft and subject to damping. We show that oscillator dephasing is a relevant perturbation, which leads to a non-Gaussian phase transition and an intriguing cascade of instabilities for $k$-th order bosonic operators, as well as a jump in the steady-state qubit polarization. For the soft-mode limit, the equations of motion form a closed hierarchy and spectral properties can be efficiently studied. To this purpose, we establish a fruitful connection to non-Hermitian Hamiltonians. The results for the phase diagram, stability boundaries, and relevant observables are based on mean-field analysis, exact diagonalization, perturbation theory, and Keldysh field theory.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：mean-field analysis, exact diagonalization, perturbation theory, Keldysh field theory。；研究对象：耗散量子拉比模型（Dissipative Quantum Rabi Model），即一个二能级系统与一个谐振子耦合的开放量子系统，重点关注其非平衡稳态相变行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现振荡器退相干（dephasing）是一种相关扰动，会导致非高斯相变和k阶玻色子算符的级联不稳定性，以及稳态量子比特极化的跳变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现振荡器退相干（dephasing）是一种相关扰动，会导致非高斯相变和k阶玻色子算符的级联不稳定性，以及稳态量子比特极化的跳变。；创新点：揭示了振荡器退相干这一扰动如何将原本预测的高斯相变转变为非高斯相变，并发现了高阶玻色子算符的级联不稳定性这一新现象。
papers.method_zh: 平均场分析、精确对角化、微扰理论、Keldysh场论。摘要还提到建立了与非厄米哈密顿量的联系以研究谱性质。

papers.title: Superconductivity from interband coupling to ferroelectric quantum critical fluctuations in two dimensions
papers.abstract: Soft critical fluctuations associated with ferroelectric quantum phase transitions are typically transverse owing to their polar nature. This implies that the conventional density--density electron--phonon coupling to these modes is strongly suppressed, which is puzzling as a variety of materials exhibit enhanced superconductivity in the vicinity of ferroelectricity. An alternative coupling mechanism is an interband ``Stark''-like coupling that connects bands of opposite parity. In the limit where one of the bands is far in energy, these processes generate an effective quadratic (two-phonon) coupling. In contrast, when both bands lie close to the Fermi energy, the resulting interaction develops singular behavior due to the additional gapless electronic states, motivating a detailed study into the dynamics of this effective two-phonon coupling. To this end, we construct the quantum critical Eliashberg theory for a two-dimensional system across a wide range of interband gap magnitudes, near the quantum critical point. We find that the critical temperature $T_c$ is strongly enhanced relative to conventional BCS expectations. In the large-gap limit, the pairing kernel acquires higher-order logarithmic contributions, leading to a parametrically enhanced $T_c$ governed by cubic and quadratic logarithmic terms. In the small-gap regime, the pairing scale exhibits a modified BCS-like form with an enhanced dependence on the inverse square root of the dimensionless coupling constant. The enhancement is due to the dynamics of the two-phonon pairing whose infrared cutoff is set by $T_c$, resulting in a significant enhancement of superconductivity compared to three-dimensional systems, where it is set by the Fermi energy. Our results elucidate the unique dynamical properties of effective two-phonon interactions, and may be relevant to layered compounds like Td-MoTe$_2$ and doped SrTiO$_3$ membranes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“construct the quantum critical Eliashberg theory”，属于理论框架构建，未涉及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：二维系统中由铁电量子临界涨落诱导的超导电性，具体关注能带间“斯塔克”型耦合（interband Stark-like coupling）产生的有效双声子配对机制，可能关联层状化合物如Td-MoTe₂和掺杂SrTiO₃薄膜。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在二维铁电量子临界点附近，通过能带间耦合产生的有效双声子相互作用可显著增强超导临界温度Tc，其增强幅度远超传统BCS理论预期，且增强机制依赖于能带间隙大小：大间隙下Tc由三次和二次对数项主导，小间隙下Tc呈现修正的BCS形式，与耦合常数的平方根倒数成反比。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在二维铁电量子临界点附近，通过能带间耦合产生的有效双声子相互作用可显著增强超导临界温度Tc，其增强幅度远超传统BCS理论预期，且增强机制依赖于能带间隙大小：大间隙下Tc由三次和二次对数项主导，小间隙下Tc呈现修正的BCS形式，与耦合常数的平方根倒数成反比。；创新点：揭示了二维系统中有效双声子相互作用的独特动力学特性：其红外截断由Tc本身设定（而非三维系统中的费米能），导致超导增强效应显著强于三维系统。摘要未突出说明与具体实验的定量对比。
papers.method_zh: 构建了二维系统在铁电量子临界点附近的Eliashberg理论，系统分析了不同能带间隙大小（从大间隙到小间隙）下的有效双声子配对动力学，并对比了二维与三维系统中红外截断（由Tc或费米能决定）对超导增强的影响。

papers.title: Coherent effects in quantum transport models and their classical counterparts
papers.abstract: We analyze the transport properties of quasiparticles locally excited at an initial time moment in several exactly solvable quantum models. It is revealed that, in the investigated quantum systems, the time-dependent probability distribution function (PDF) exhibits behavior similar to that of classical continuous-time random walk (CTRW) models, such as Lévy walks or diffusing diffusivity.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“exactly solvable quantum models”（精确可解量子模型）和“classical continuous-time random walk (CTRW) models”（经典连续时间随机游走模型），属于理论分析与模型对比研究。；研究对象：量子输运模型中的准粒子局域激发及其时间依赖的输运性质，具体包括几种精确可解的量子系统，并与经典连续时间随机游走（如Lévy行走、扩散系数涨落模型）进行对比。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在所研究的量子系统中，时间依赖的概率分布函数（PDF）表现出与经典连续时间随机游走模型（如Lévy行走或扩散系数涨落模型）相似的行为，揭示了量子输运中的相干效应与经典随机过程之间的类比关系。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在所研究的量子系统中，时间依赖的概率分布函数（PDF）表现出与经典连续时间随机游走模型（如Lévy行走或扩散系数涨落模型）相似的行为，揭示了量子输运中的相干效应与经典随机过程之间的类比关系。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用精确可解的量子输运模型，分析初始时刻局域激发的准粒子的时间演化，计算其概率分布函数，并与经典连续时间随机游走模型（如Lévy行走、扩散系数涨落模型）进行理论对比。

papers.title: Anisotropic Short-Range Order Modulates Ferroelectric Switching in Wurtzite ScAlN Alloys
papers.abstract: Ferroelectric switching in wurtzite alloys is typically understood in terms of composition, strain, defects, and interfaces, while local chemical order is often neglected or treated as a secondary perturbation. Here we show that short-range order (SRO) is a previously overlooked microscopic variable that substantially influences the intrinsic switching barrier. Using first-principles canonical sampling, we find that wurtzite ScAlN develops a robust, highly anisotropic SRO that challenges the conventional random-alloy picture. This ordering suppresses in-plane Sc--N--Sc motifs while enhancing columnar mixed-cation chains along the polar $c$ axis, reflecting the symmetry-distinct polar and basal directions of the wurtzite lattice and reorganizing its polar connectivity. Relative to random-alloy structures, SRO systematically increases the intrinsic switching barrier across a broad composition range. Motif-resolved analysis further identifies the population of columnar Sc--N--Al--N--Sc motifs as the primary structural descriptor underlying switching-barrier variations among configurations with different local order. These results establish anisotropic SRO as an independent degree of freedom for tuning ferroelectric switching. More broadly, they reveal how local chemical order can couple to the symmetry-distinct directions of a polar semiconductor lattice to modify functional behavior. Our findings lay a foundation for SRO engineering as a route to tailoring switching barriers without changing alloy composition.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词“first-principles canonical sampling”（第一性原理正则采样）。；研究对象：论文研究的具体材料为纤锌矿结构ScAlN合金，物理现象为铁电翻转行为，重点关注短程有序（SRO）对翻转势垒的调控作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 纤锌矿ScAlN中存在一种稳健且高度各向异性的短程有序（SRO），该有序结构显著提高了本征铁电翻转势垒，且其效应在宽组分范围内系统性地存在。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：纤锌矿ScAlN中存在一种稳健且高度各向异性的短程有序（SRO），该有序结构显著提高了本征铁电翻转势垒，且其效应在宽组分范围内系统性地存在。；创新点：首次将短程有序（SRO）确立为影响纤锌矿合金铁电翻转的独立微观变量，揭示了局域化学有序与极性半导体晶格对称性不同方向之间的耦合机制，为在不改变合金组分的前提下调控翻转势垒提供了新途径（SRO工程）。
papers.method_zh: 采用第一性原理正则采样（first-principles canonical sampling）进行模拟计算，并结合“motif-resolved analysis”（基元分辨分析）来识别关键结构描述符。

papers.title: Learning Dynamics of Chain-of-Thought State Tracking in a Solvable Transformer Model
papers.abstract: Chain-of-thought generation can turn a multi-step computation into a sequence of locally checkable state updates, but the training dynamics by which transformers acquire such updates remain poorly understood. We study this question in a solvable setting: a simplified one-block transformer trained by supervised next-token prediction on state sequences generated by composing permutations. The architecture separates fixed-lag action retrieval, learned by RoPE attention, from a specialized MLP logic module that applies the retrieved permutation to the current state. Using a statistical-physics mean-field description, we derive dynamics for three order parameters measuring attention retrieval, teacher-matrix alignment, and off-target logic overlap. These equations quantitatively match simulations for the order parameters and, combined with a logit-distribution approximation, qualitatively predict the sharp transition in final rollout accuracy. The analysis reveals staged learning: the logic module first learns a mixed heuristic; attention then locks onto the relevant action, enabling efficient MLP alignment. Together, these results provide a controlled mechanistic account of how attention-based retrieval and MLP-based logic co-develop during chain-of-thought state tracking.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词包括“solvable setting”、“statistical-physics mean-field description”、“derive dynamics”、“theoretical analysis”。；研究对象：链式思维（Chain-of-Thought）生成过程中，Transformer模型内部状态追踪的学习动力学。具体体系为：一个简化的单模块Transformer，通过监督式下一词元预测，在由置换群复合生成的状态序列上进行训练。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 揭示了Transformer中注意力检索与MLP逻辑模块在链式思维状态追踪中的协同发展阶段：逻辑模块先学习混合启发式策略，随后注意力锁定相关动作，使MLP高效对齐，最终导致滚动生成准确率的尖锐转变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：揭示了Transformer中注意力检索与MLP逻辑模块在链式思维状态追踪中的协同发展阶段：逻辑模块先学习混合启发式策略，随后注意力锁定相关动作，使MLP高效对齐，最终导致滚动生成准确率的尖锐转变。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用统计物理平均场描述，推导了三个序参量（注意力检索、教师矩阵对齐、非目标逻辑重叠）的动力学方程，并结合logit分布近似进行理论分析。数值模拟用于验证序参量方程和预测准确率转变。

papers.title: Dynamical properties of ab initio water from machine-learning potentials
papers.abstract: We assess the dynamical properties of liquid water predicted by several density functionals using machine-learning interatomic potentials. MACE models were trained for SCAN, RPBE-D3/zd, revPBE-D3/zd, revPBE0-D3/BJ, PBE0-D3/zd, and PBE0-D3/BJ using previously reported ab initio datasets. We compare translational, rotational, and viscous dynamics through time-correlation functions, which resolve relaxation processes across different timescales, and through the corresponding long-time kinetic coefficients. The diffusion coefficient, second-rank orientational relaxation time, and shear viscosity reveal systematic differences among functionals. Part of these differences can be rationalized as shifts along the phase diagram, as comparisons relative to each functionals melting temperature reduce the spread in the dynamical observables. Among the functionals considered, RPBE-D3/zd provides the best overall agreement with experiment. We therefore perform a broader validation of RPBE-D3/zd using a Behler--Parrinello neural-network potential over a wide range of temperatures, densities, and pressures. The model reproduces the magnitude and anomalous pressure dependence of the diffusion coefficient, gives generally good viscosities, and captures the temperature dependence of the rotational relaxation time.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：machine-learning potentials、density functionals、ab initio datasets、time-correlation functions。；研究对象：液态水的动力学性质，包括平移、转动和粘性动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在多种密度泛函中，RPBE-D3/zd 泛函预测的液态水动力学性质与实验符合最好；不同泛函之间的动力学差异部分可通过相对于各自熔点的相图位移来理解。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在多种密度泛函中，RPBE-D3/zd 泛函预测的液态水动力学性质与实验符合最好；不同泛函之间的动力学差异部分可通过相对于各自熔点的相图位移来理解。；创新点：系统比较了多种密度泛函对液态水动力学性质的预测能力，并揭示了不同泛函差异与相图位移的关联；对 RPBE-D3/zd 进行了广泛的动力学性质验证，包括扩散系数的异常压力依赖性。
papers.method_zh: 使用机器学习原子间势（MACE 模型）训练多种密度泛函（SCAN、RPBE-D3/zd、revPBE-D3/zd、revPBE0-D3/BJ、PBE0-D3/zd、PBE0-D3/BJ）的从头算数据集；通过时间关联函数计算扩散系数、二阶取向弛豫时间和剪切粘度；对 RPBE-D3/zd 进一步使用 Behler-Parrinello 神经网络势在宽温度、密度和压力范围内进行验证。

papers.title: High-temperature ferromagnetism and antiferromagnetism in monolayer \ce{CrTe2}: Roles of strong spin-lattice coupling and charge doping
papers.abstract: The interplay of structural, electronic, and magnetic degrees of freedom governs phase stability and critical temperatures in two-dimensional magnets. Controlling this coupling is essential for advancing fundamental understanding and spintronic applications. Combining first-principles calculations with Heisenberg Monte Carlo simulations, we reveal a rich magnetic phase diagram governed by the interplay of lattice strain and carrier density. These results provide a unified framework that reconciles diverse experimental reports on epitaxial layers and predicts a novel double-stripe antiferromagnetic phase, further stabilized by electron doping. Moreover, structural and electronic perturbations enable room-temperature ferromagnetism and antiferromagnetism. This magnetic evolution arises from competing, highly tunable direct and ligand-mediated exchange interactions in the presence of Ruderman-Kittel-Kasuya-Yosida coupling. By disentangling their individual contributions, we elucidate the underlying microscopic mechanisms, which transcends the conventional conduction electron picture. Finally, we quantify the colossal magnetoelastic response and identify zone-folded Raman modes that serve as unique experimental fingerprints for phase identification. Together, these results establish \ce{CrTe2} as a versatile platform for two-dimensional spintronics, where magnetic order and transition temperatures are tailorable via structural and electrical engineering.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算与理论混合类型。判断依据：第一性原理计算（first-principles calculations）、海森堡蒙特卡洛模拟（Heisenberg Monte Carlo simulations）。；研究对象：单层二碲化铬（monolayer \ce{CrTe2}）中的高温铁磁性与反铁磁性，以及自旋-晶格耦合与电荷掺杂对其磁性的调控。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 揭示了晶格应变与载流子密度共同调控的丰富磁相图，预言了一种新型双条纹反铁磁相，并实现了室温铁磁性与反铁磁性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：揭示了晶格应变与载流子密度共同调控的丰富磁相图，预言了一种新型双条纹反铁磁相，并实现了室温铁磁性与反铁磁性。；创新点：通过解耦不同交换相互作用的贡献，阐明了超越传统传导电子图像的微观机制；量化了巨磁弹响应并识别了折叠区拉曼模式作为相标识的实验指纹。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理计算（first-principles calculations）结合海森堡蒙特卡洛模拟（Heisenberg Monte Carlo simulations），并分析了直接交换、配体介导交换以及RKKY耦合的竞争机制。

papers.title: Double quantum spin Hall phase in bilayer ZrTe$_5$
papers.abstract: Quantum spin Hall insulators (QSH) are topological materials that host helical edge states protected against backscattering, making them ideal candidates for dissipationless spin transport. Within the conventional $\mathbb{Z}_2$ classification, only phases with an odd number of edge state pairs ($\mathbb{Z}_2 = 1$) are topologically nontrivial, whereas even-channel systems ($\mathbb{Z}_2 = 0$) lie beyond this framework but can host robust edge transport characterized by a spin Chern number. Experimentally accessible realizations of such phases remain rare, particularly in systems with sizeable band gaps. Here, we show that bilayer ZrTe$_5$ realizes a double quantum spin Hall phase in its energetically most stable structure. Using first principles calculations, we demonstrate that uniaxial strain drives a transition from this phase to a conventional single pair QSH phase with $\mathbb{Z}_2 = 1$. The double QSH phase hosts two pairs of helical edge states, resulting in enhanced edge conductance and a quantized spin Hall response that remains robust over an energy window of up to $\sim$100 meV. These results establish bilayer ZrTe$_5$ as a tunable platform connecting conventional and double QSH phases within a single material. More broadly, they demonstrate that untwisted van der Waals bilayers can host topological phases beyond the conventional $\mathbb{Z}_2$ classification.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：first principles calculations（第一性原理计算）。；研究对象：双层ZrTe₅（bilayer ZrTe₅）中的双量子自旋霍尔相（double quantum spin Hall phase）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 双层ZrTe₅在其最稳定结构中实现了双量子自旋霍尔相，拥有两对螺旋边缘态，导致增强的边缘电导和量子化的自旋霍尔响应，且该响应在高达约100 meV的能量窗口内保持鲁棒。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：双层ZrTe₅在其最稳定结构中实现了双量子自旋霍尔相，拥有两对螺旋边缘态，导致增强的边缘电导和量子化的自旋霍尔响应，且该响应在高达约100 meV的能量窗口内保持鲁棒。；创新点：在未扭转的范德华双层体系中实现了超越传统ℤ₂分类的拓扑相（双量子自旋霍尔相），并展示了通过单轴应变在该相与常规单对QSH相之间进行调控的可能性。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理计算（first principles calculations），用于研究单轴应变（uniaxial strain）对该体系拓扑相变的影响。

papers.title: Making complex CFTs real: The two-dimensional Potts model for $Q>4$ and complex $Q$
papers.abstract: The two-dimensional $Q$-state Potts model with real couplings has a first-order transition for $Q>4$. Starting from a triangular-lattice Potts model with two- and three-spin interactions, we study an equivalent loop model in which $Q$ is a continuous parameter. By a combination of analytical and numerical arguments, we show that this loop model allows for the collision of a critical and a tricritical fixed point at $Q=4$. These then emerge as a pair of complex conformally invariant theories at $Q>4$, or even complex $Q$, for suitable complex coupling constants. We conjecture that all conformal data (such as the central charge, critical exponents, and three-point structure constants) can be obtained by analytic continuation of known exact results for the loop model with $Q \le 4$. This conjecture is checked, both for real $Q>4$ and for $Q \in \mathbb{C}$, by extensive transfer-matrix computations and comparison to previous studies for $Q=5$.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有计算）。判断依据：关键词包括“analytical and numerical arguments”、“transfer-matrix computations”、“conformal invariance”。；研究对象：二维Q态Potts模型，特别是Q>4及复数Q情况下的临界行为与共形场论（CFT）性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过引入三角晶格上含二体和三体自旋相互作用的Potts模型，发现其对应的环模型允许临界与三临界不动点在Q=4处碰撞，并在Q>4（甚至复数Q）时以一对复共形不变理论的形式出现。作者推测所有共形数据（中心荷、临界指数、三点结构常数）均可通过解析延拓已知的Q≤4精确结果得到。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过引入三角晶格上含二体和三体自旋相互作用的Potts模型，发现其对应的环模型允许临界与三临界不动点在Q=4处碰撞，并在Q>4（甚至复数Q）时以一对复共形不变理论的形式出现。作者推测所有共形数据（中心荷、临界指数、三点结构常数）均可通过解析延拓已知的Q≤4精确结果得到。；创新点：首次提出并论证了在Q>4及复数Q情况下，通过解析延拓Q≤4的精确结果来获得复共形场论的全部共形数据，并利用转移矩阵计算对Q=5及复数Q情形进行了检验。
papers.method_zh: 结合解析论证与数值计算：构建三角晶格Potts模型的环模型表示，利用转移矩阵计算进行数值验证，并与Q=5的已有研究结果对比。

papers.title: Impact of dynamic electrostatic disorder on hole mobility in rubrene: a nonadiabatic molecular dynamics investigation
papers.abstract: High-mobility organic molecular crystals such as rubrene are important materials for organic electronics, yet a quantitatively predictive description of their charge transport properties remains challenging. Direct mixed quantum-classical nonadiabatic molecular dynamics simulations provide a promising route by explicitly propagating the charge carrier wavefunction, without assuming a specific transport mechanism. However, previous large-scale simulations of apolar molecular crystals have commonly neglected dynamic electrostatic disorder, since evaluation of electrostatic interactions is computationally demanding and the approximation appears plausible for apolar systems. Here, we use the damped shifted-force (DSF) real-space electrostatic summation method, combined with an efficient addition-subtraction scheme, to include dynamic electrostatic disorder in fragment orbital-based surface hopping (FOB-SH) simulations of room-temperature hole transport in rubrene. We find that electrostatic interactions increase the reorganization energy for (hypothetical) nearest neighbour hopping by 29 and 39 meV along the a and b-directions, respectively, relative to a baseline value of 152 meV obtained without electrostatics. In FOB-SH simulations, electrostatic interactions lead to increased site energy disorder, reducing the spatial extent of the hole wavefunction, as measured by a decrease in the inverse participation ratio from 13 to 9, and lowering the predicted mobility along the high-mobility direction from $35$ to $21~\mathrm{cm^2 V^{-1}s^{-1}}$, in close agreement with experiment.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词“nonadiabatic molecular dynamics simulations”、“fragment orbital-based surface hopping (FOB-SH) simulations”、“damped shifted-force (DSF) real-space electrostatic summation method”。；研究对象：红荧烯（rubrene）中的空穴输运现象，具体关注动态静电无序对空穴迁移率的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 动态静电相互作用会增大红荧烯中空穴的位能无序，使空穴波函数空间局域化（逆参与比从13降至9），并将沿高迁移率方向的空穴迁移率从35 cm² V⁻¹s⁻¹降低至21 cm² V⁻¹s⁻¹，与实验值吻合良好。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：动态静电相互作用会增大红荧烯中空穴的位能无序，使空穴波函数空间局域化（逆参与比从13降至9），并将沿高迁移率方向的空穴迁移率从35 cm² V⁻¹s⁻¹降低至21 cm² V⁻¹s⁻¹，与实验值吻合良好。；创新点：首次在非极性分子晶体（红荧烯）的大规模非绝热分子动力学模拟中显式考虑了动态静电无序，而此前此类模拟通常忽略静电相互作用。
papers.method_zh: 采用阻尼移位力（DSF）实空间静电求和法，结合高效的加减方案，在基于片段轨道的表面跳跃（FOB-SH）模拟中纳入动态静电无序，对红荧烯室温下的空穴输运进行混合量子-经典非绝热分子动力学模拟。

papers.title: Cavity-enhanced superconducting response in an underdoped cuprate
papers.abstract: Superconductors carry electrical current without resistance when paired electrons condense into a coherent macroscopic quantum state. In underdoped cuprates, evidence suggests that pairing-related correlations and superconducting fluctuations can survive above the temperature at which global coherence is lost, pointing to phase fluctuations as a key limitation on superconductivity in this regime. Motivated by recent demonstrations of cavity-modified collective states in quantum materials, we investigate whether superconducting coherence can be stabilized by engineering the electromagnetic environment of the superconductor. We study an underdoped YBa$_2$Cu$_3$O$_{7-δ}$ thin film in a tunable terahertz cavity formed with a semi-transparent gold mirror. From temperature-dependent terahertz transmission measurements, we find that the cavity enhances the superconducting response below the critical temperature, with an increase of the inferred superfluid weight. The effect becomes more pronounced at smaller cavity lengths and is accompanied by an upward shift of the superconducting onset temperature. Calculations based on a cavity-coupled model for phase-fluctuating superconductors capture these trends and support an interpretation in terms of cavity-enhanced phase stiffness. These results showcase the potential of cavity engineering for designing emergent functionalities in correlated systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：temperature-dependent terahertz transmission measurements、cavity-coupled model for phase-fluctuating superconductors）；研究对象：欠掺杂铜氧化物超导体YBa₂Cu₃O₇₋δ薄膜在可调谐太赫兹腔中的超导响应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过太赫兹腔工程增强欠掺杂铜氧化物的超导相刚度，提高了超流体重量的推断值，并上移了超导起始温度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过太赫兹腔工程增强欠掺杂铜氧化物的超导相刚度，提高了超流体重量的推断值，并上移了超导起始温度。；创新点：首次实验证明通过设计超导体的电磁环境（太赫兹腔）可以稳定超导相干性，增强欠掺杂铜氧化物的超导响应，为利用腔工程调控关联体系涌现功能提供了新途径。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用半透明金镜构成可调谐太赫兹腔，对欠掺杂YBa₂Cu₃O₇₋δ薄膜进行变温太赫兹透射测量；理论上基于腔耦合的相位涨落超导体模型进行数值计算。

papers.title: Tunable Electronic and Transport Properties of Biphenylene via Fluorination and Disorder
papers.abstract: Biphenylene (BPN) network is a newly synthesized 2D carbon allotrope hosting anisotropic Dirac electronic states. Here, we investigate how fluorination and correlated chemical disorder modify the electronic structure and charge transport of fluorinated biphenylene (F/BPN) using density functional theory, Wannier-based tight-biding Hamiltonian, and quantum transport simulations. We show that fluorination reshapes the transport response of BPN, producing concentration-dependent anisotropic conduction regimes. For pristine and ordered fluorinated systems, we identified the emergence of negative differential resistance (NDR) and a bias-induced inversion of the preferred transport direction, from armchair to zigzag and vice versa. In contrast, disorder suppresses the NDR, driving the system toward an approximately Ohmic transport regime. At high fluorine coverage, we further observed a nonmonotonic dependence of the armchair current on adatom concentration, which we attribute to the formation of correlated quasi-linear fluor conformation that promote armchair-oriented C-$π$ transport channels while simultaneously suppressing transport along the zigzag direction. Our results demonstrate that correlated fluorination can be used as an active mechanism to engineer electronic transport.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据关键词：density functional theory, Wannier-based tight-biding Hamiltonian, quantum transport simulations。；研究对象：氟化联苯烯（fluorinated biphenylene, F/BPN）二维碳同素异形体及其电子结构与电荷输运性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 氟化可以重塑联苯烯的输运响应，产生浓度依赖的各向异性导电行为；有序氟化体系中会出现负微分电阻（NDR）和偏压诱导的优先输运方向反转，而无序则会抑制NDR并驱动体系趋近欧姆输运。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：氟化可以重塑联苯烯的输运响应，产生浓度依赖的各向异性导电行为；有序氟化体系中会出现负微分电阻（NDR）和偏压诱导的优先输运方向反转，而无序则会抑制NDR并驱动体系趋近欧姆输运。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 密度泛函理论（DFT）、基于Wannier函数的紧束缚哈密顿量、量子输运模拟。

papers.title: Highly nonlinear Moiré exciton and trion polaritons
papers.abstract: Moiré multi-layers of transition metal dichalcogenides have been shown to exhibit optical responses that are endowed with a richness that is absent in single monolayers. Much of this can be attributed to the Moiré superlattice that modulates the electronic landscape of these heterostructures. Strongly coupled layer-hybridized excitons in $\text{MoSe}_2 / \text{WS}_2$ heterobilayers have been shown to exhibit enhanced optical nonlinearities. In this work we strongly couple layer hybridized excitons and trions in n-doped $\text{MoSe}_2 / \text{WS}_2$ heterobilayers inside an optical microcavity. We find that the additional Lindhard screening from dopant electrons and the formation of trions result in a strikingly non-monotonic nonlinear response. The absence of electron capture in the Moiré superlattice plays a crucial role, promising very large second-order nonlinearities. In this work, trion polaritons manifest as high velocity hot polaritons, reaching nominal diffusion lengths approaching 100 microns.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：strongly couple、inside an optical microcavity、reach nominal diffusion lengths（涉及微腔耦合与扩散长度测量）。；研究对象：n型掺杂的MoSe₂/WS₂异质双层中的莫尔激子与三子极化激元（Moiré exciton and trion polaritons）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 掺杂电子引起的额外Lindhard屏蔽以及三子的形成导致显著的非单调非线性响应；三子极化激元表现为高速热极化激元，名义扩散长度接近100微米。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：掺杂电子引起的额外Lindhard屏蔽以及三子的形成导致显著的非单调非线性响应；三子极化激元表现为高速热极化激元，名义扩散长度接近100微米。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 将n型掺杂的MoSe₂/WS₂异质双层置于光学微腔中，实现层杂化激子与三子的强耦合，通过光学测量研究其非线性响应与扩散行为。

papers.title: Universal scaling and relaxation in decaying turbulence of Bose gases
papers.abstract: Understanding the relaxation dynamics of isolated quantum systems remains a central challenge in nonequilibrium physics. In this short review, we discuss recent experimental and theoretical advances in universal dynamics of turbulent Bose gases, with particular emphasis on nonthermal fixed points and wave turbulence in our experimental system at the São Carlos Institute of Physics of the University of São Paulo. We highlight the emergence of self-similar scaling behavior and its connection to particle and energy transport across momentum scales. In addition, we discuss an approach in which a differential equation has a universal scaling solution, providing a practical framework for extracting universal exponents from limited regions of the momentum distribution. Furthermore, we recap experimental observations of direct and inverse cascades in a three-dimensional trapped Bose--Einstein condensate, revealing distinct relaxation stages governed by universal scaling laws. These results demonstrate that turbulence plays a key role in far-from-equilibrium dynamics, offering a unified perspective on transport processes and thermalization in quantum many-body systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（理论+实验）。判断依据：摘要中同时提及“理论进展”和“实验系统”（São Carlos物理研究所的实验系统），并讨论了实验观测结果。；研究对象：玻色气体的湍流衰变动力学，具体为三维囚禁玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体中的非平衡量子多体系统，重点关注非热固定点和波湍流现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在远离平衡态的玻色气体湍流衰变中，存在自相似标度行为，并可通过具有普适标度解的微分方程提取普适指数；实验观测到直接和逆级联过程，揭示了由普适标度律支配的不同弛豫阶段。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在远离平衡态的玻色气体湍流衰变中，存在自相似标度行为，并可通过具有普适标度解的微分方程提取普适指数；实验观测到直接和逆级联过程，揭示了由普适标度律支配的不同弛豫阶段。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架包括非热固定点理论和波湍流理论；实验手段为三维囚禁玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体中的湍流衰变观测，通过动量分布分析提取标度行为。

papers.title: Coupled spin dynamics in epitaxial trilayer heterostructures of ferrimagnetic garnet
papers.abstract: The magnetization dynamics of an all-garnet trilayer consisting of Y3Fe5O12/Y3Fe3Al2O12/Y3Fe5O12 (YIG/YIAG/YIG) is analysed. The two magnetic YIG layers, separated by a 4 nm thick paramagnetic YIAG layer, are coupled via dipolar interactions leading to the formation of hybrid magnon modes distinct from the modes found in a single YIG layer. The YIAG exchange-decouples the YIG layers while enabling lattice coherence, maintaining the low damping of the YIG. Both ferromagnetic resonance and micro-Brillouin light scattering measurements were used to characterize the sample and its hybrid dynamics, which showed excellent agreement with an analytical reciprocal space model of spin-wave dynamics and with micromagnetic modeling of a dipolarly coupled magnetic heterostructure.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：ferromagnetic resonance, micro-Brillouin light scattering measurements, micromagnetic modeling）；研究对象：全石榴石三层异质结构 Y₃Fe₅O₁₂/Y₃Fe₃Al₂O₁₂/Y₃Fe₅O₁₂ (YIG/YIAG/YIG) 中的磁化动力学与杂化磁振子模式。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过4 nm厚的顺磁YIAG层将两层磁性YIG层交换退耦合，但保持晶格相干性，从而通过偶极相互作用形成不同于单层YIG的杂化磁振子模式，且YIG的低阻尼特性得以保留。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过4 nm厚的顺磁YIAG层将两层磁性YIG层交换退耦合，但保持晶格相干性，从而通过偶极相互作用形成不同于单层YIG的杂化磁振子模式，且YIG的低阻尼特性得以保留。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 铁磁共振（FMR）测量、微区布里渊光散射（micro-Brillouin light scattering）测量、解析倒空间自旋波动力学模型、微磁学模拟（micromagnetic modeling）。

papers.title: Equilibrium cluster statistics of cooperative and anticooperative binding on finite one-dimensional rings
papers.abstract: We study equilibrium clustering in a finite one-dimensional lattice gas of $L$ sites with periodic boundary conditions, as a minimal model for adsorption and binding on small ring-like substrates. Using a grand-canonical formulation with nearest-neighbor coupling, we derive exact finite-size expressions for the mean occupancy, the mean number of domain walls, and the mean number of clusters. Building on exact $k$-site correlation functions, we further derive expressions for the mean number of clusters of size $k$ and for two complementary size statistics: the cluster-size distribution, and the site-weighted cluster-size distribution. These observables characterize how spatial organization changes across attractive (cooperative) and repulsive (anticooperative) interactions, and highlight finite-size and parity-dependent effects of the underlying lattice, the latter being particularly pronounced near half filling in small systems. To access larger lattices without enumerating all $2^L$ microstates, we also develop a cluster-based combinatorial formulation in which configurations are classified by cluster counts and sizes, reducing the effective state space to a set whose size scales with integer partitions, $\approx e^{\sqrt{L}}$, rather than with $\approx e^{L}$. Taken together, our results provide exact benchmarks for finite periodic systems and suggest experimentally relevant cluster observables that complement occupancy-based measures of cooperativity, with particular relevance for binding on ring-like substrates for biological assemblies.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“derive exact finite-size expressions”“develop a cluster-based combinatorial formulation”等理论推导和建模方法，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：有限一维环状晶格上的吸附与结合系统，具体为具有周期性边界条件的L位点一维晶格气体，作为小环状基底上吸附与结合的简化模型，特别关注生物组装中环状基底上的结合行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 推导了有限一维环上合作（吸引）与反合作（排斥）相互作用下平衡团簇统计的精确有限尺寸表达式，揭示了空间组织随相互作用类型的变化，并突出了有限尺寸和奇偶性依赖效应，尤其在近半填充的小系统中。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：推导了有限一维环上合作（吸引）与反合作（排斥）相互作用下平衡团簇统计的精确有限尺寸表达式，揭示了空间组织随相互作用类型的变化，并突出了有限尺寸和奇偶性依赖效应，尤其在近半填充的小系统中。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用巨正则系综框架，引入最近邻耦合；通过精确的k位点关联函数推导团簇尺寸分布和位点加权团簇尺寸分布；并发展了一种基于团簇的组合学方法，将构型按团簇计数和尺寸分类，将有效状态空间从2^L缩减至约e^{√L}规模。

papers.title: Theory of clusterization in orbitally degenerate transition-metal compounds driven by lattice instabilities
papers.abstract: We derive an effective orbital-lattice model with quantum $S=1$ degrees of freedom for transition-metal compounds, providing a microscopic understanding of cluster formation driven by the cooperative interplay of spin, orbital, and lattice degrees of freedom. Motivated by the trimerized phases observed in LiVS$_2$ and LiVO$_2$, we consider a triangular-lattice three-orbital system with two electrons per site occupying the threefold-degenerate $t_{2g}$ manifold.
