papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：实验证实了Weyl半金属TaAs中Fermi arcs的手性本质，并发现其能产生超大且可表面切换的三阶非互易非线性响应，该响应受拓扑保护且可在室温下工作。；创新点：首次通过非线性输运直接探测并证实了Fermi arcs的手性，揭示了奇异弧端点的关键作用，并展示了可表面切换的室温拓扑保护非线性响应这一新功能。
papers.method_zh: 利用聚焦离子束技术制备微米级器件，在相对的两个拓扑表面上同时进行线性与非线性输运测量。

papers.title: Dispersive mode coupling in $p$-doped semiconductor nanomechanical resonators
papers.abstract: Dispersive coupling between vibrational modes with different frequencies is a major nonlinear dynamical effect. We show that in $p$-doped semiconductors such coupling is strongly enhanced. Moreover, the coupling parameters increase with the order of the nonlinearity. The doping-induced dispersive coupling becomes much stronger than the intrinsic one already for moderately strong doping. Its dependence on the hole density is nonmonotonic, and the temperature dependence becomes nonmonotonic for higher densities. Relevant mesoscopic frequency fluctuations are briefly discussed. The results are applied to Si resonators, where doping is used to compensate the temperature dependence of a clock mode, whereas another low-frequency mode is used as a thermometer to enable temperature stabilization.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：show that, coupling parameters, dependence, applied to）；研究对象：p型掺杂半导体纳米机械谐振器中的振动模式之间的色散耦合现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在p型掺杂半导体中，不同频率振动模式之间的色散耦合被显著增强，且耦合参数随非线性阶数增加而增大。掺杂诱导的色散耦合在中等掺杂强度下即可远强于本征耦合。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在p型掺杂半导体中，不同频率振动模式之间的色散耦合被显著增强，且耦合参数随非线性阶数增加而增大。掺杂诱导的色散耦合在中等掺杂强度下即可远强于本征耦合。；创新点：揭示了p型掺杂半导体中掺杂诱导的色散耦合机制，并指出该耦合强度可通过掺杂浓度进行调控，且其强度随非线性阶数增加而增强。摘要未明确说明与已有研究相比的具体创新点。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析。具体而言，论文通过理论推导展示了掺杂如何增强色散耦合，并分析了耦合参数对空穴密度和温度的依赖关系（呈现非单调性）。最后，将结果应用于硅谐振器，讨论了利用掺杂补偿时钟模式的温度依赖性，并利用另一低频模式作为温度计以实现温度稳定的方案。

papers.title: Operator ordering as an emergent gauge field in twisted bilayer graphene: singular spectral signatures at the magic angle
papers.abstract: Scanning-tunnelling spectroscopy at the AB and BA stacking points of magic-angle twisted bilayer graphene should reveal two asymmetric Van~Hove peaks separated by $Δ_{\mathrm{split}}\approx 171$~meV -- a splitting absent from the standard Bistritzer--MacDonald spectrum. We show this signature arises naturally from the Hermitian ordering correction of the Dirac Hamiltonian with spatially varying mass, which generates an emergent Aharonov--Bohm flux of $h/(2e)$ at each zero of the effective mass $m_{\mathrm{eff}}(\mathbf{r})=w|f(\mathbf{r})|$. In the chiral limit, the interlayer coupling is locally diagonalised by a spatially dependent unitary transformation; the ordering term $H_{\mathrm{ord}}=-\tfrac{i}{2}\boldsymbolσ\cdot \nabla\ln m_{\mathrm{eff}}$ then develops a $1/r$ singularity at the AB/BA stacking points, where $m_{\mathrm{eff}}$ vanishes. The splitting scales as $\sqrtθ$ -- distinguishing it from correlation-driven gaps ($\proptoθ$ or $\propto 1/θ$) -- is gate-voltage independent, and is spatially localised within $r_c\approx 2.1$~nm of each AB/BA point. Within the local asymptotic theory near the zeros of $\mathrm{eff}$, the ordering-corrected zero mode acquires parabolic-cylinder character $D_{-1/2}$. The spatially resolved AB/BA spectrum reported in recent STM studies of magic-angle TBG has not been analysed for two-peak structure and constitutes an immediate experimental test; the predicted cell-averaged broadening of $\approx 14$~meV is consistent with the $16$~meV discrepancy between existing STM data and the BM tight-binding prediction.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中主要进行理论推导（如“Hermitian ordering correction”、“local asymptotic theory”），未提及实验数据采集或计算模拟。；研究对象：魔角扭曲双层石墨烯（magic-angle twisted bilayer graphene, TBG）中AB/BA堆叠点附近的电子态，特别是扫描隧道谱（STS）中出现的非对称范霍夫峰分裂现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: AB/BA堆叠点处约171 meV的范霍夫峰分裂源于狄拉克哈密顿量中算符排序修正产生的涌现规范场，该修正等效于在每个有效质量零点处引入h/(2e)的Aharonov-Bohm通量。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：AB/BA堆叠点处约171 meV的范霍夫峰分裂源于狄拉克哈密顿量中算符排序修正产生的涌现规范场，该修正等效于在每个有效质量零点处引入h/(2e)的Aharonov-Bohm通量。；创新点：首次将算符排序效应识别为魔角TBG中AB/BA堆叠点光谱分裂的物理起源，并预言该分裂随√θ标度（区别于关联驱动的θ或1/θ标度），且具有栅压无关性和空间局域性（局域半径约2.1 nm）。摘要未突出说明与现有实验的定量对比细节。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：采用含空间变化质量项的狄拉克哈密顿量，通过手征极限下的局域幺正变换对角化层间耦合，推导排序修正项H_ord的奇异性；利用局域渐近理论分析零模的抛物线-柱函数特征；对比标准Bistritzer-MacDonald模型与实验数据。

papers.title: Vortex-Beam-Driven Dirac Materials: Impurity and Polarization Effects on Light-Induced Vortex and Edge States
papers.abstract: We study impurity scattering and polarization detuning in finite-size vortex-light-beam-driven massive Dirac systems. In finite geometries, circularly polarized vortex light opens a dynamical gap where topological edge states coexist with photoinduced multiply quantized vortex states. We analyze how finite-size effects, vorticity, and effective particle-hole symmetry manifest in the quasienergy spectrum, real-space states, and local density of states. We show that angular-momentum mixing due to localized impurities and impurity clusters reshape vortex states, while when produced by circular polarization, it leads to a gradual filling of the dynamical gap with bulk-derived states. Our results indicate that both vortex and edge signatures remain observable in the presence of impurities and realistic polarization deviations, providing guidance for experimental realizations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：We study、We analyze、We show（理论分析与数值计算）。；研究对象：有限尺寸涡旋光束驱动的有质量狄拉克材料，具体研究光诱导涡旋态与拓扑边缘态，以及杂质散射和偏振失谐的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在有限几何结构中，圆偏振涡旋光可打开动力学能隙，其中拓扑边缘态与光诱导的多重量子化涡旋态共存；局域杂质和偏振偏差会重塑涡旋态并逐渐填充动力学能隙，但涡旋和边缘态特征在杂质和偏振偏差下仍可观测。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在有限几何结构中，圆偏振涡旋光可打开动力学能隙，其中拓扑边缘态与光诱导的多重量子化涡旋态共存；局域杂质和偏振偏差会重塑涡旋态并逐渐填充动力学能隙，但涡旋和边缘态特征在杂质和偏振偏差下仍可观测。；创新点：系统研究了有限尺寸、杂质散射和偏振失谐对涡旋光驱动狄拉克材料中光诱导涡旋态与拓扑边缘态的联合影响，并指出这些效应在实验可实现的条件下仍可保持可观测性。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析结合数值计算：通过准能量谱、实空间态和局域态密度分析有限尺寸效应、涡旋性、有效粒子-空穴对称性，以及杂质和偏振失谐对系统的影响。

papers.title: Characterization of ultrathin nickel films deposited by thermal laser evaporation
papers.abstract: Thermal laser evaporation is a physical vapor deposition technique of increasing interest because of its ability to evaporate essentially any solid element, even the most refractory such as W. However, many films deposited by this method, especially non-epitaxial films, remain to be characterized; further, key system components such as the laser delivery system have not been described in detail. Here, we present the evaporation and characterization of ultrathin Ni films deposited with a home-built thermal laser evaporation system. The system employs a continuous-wave 1 kW fiber laser (1070 nm) focused to sub-millimeter diameter onto a Ni target rod mounted inside an ultrahigh-vacuum chamber. The laser heats the target to a temperature high enough to produce vapor for film deposition; for Ni, this temperature is around the melting point of 1725 K. We report the characterization of the surface roughness, composition, and room-temperature electrical properties of the films along with the design of the major components of our system. This work advances the growing consensus regarding the potential of thermal laser evaporation for thin film deposition and epitaxy and provides the necessary design information to facilitate broader adoption of the technique.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了“蒸发和表征”、“报告了表征结果”以及“系统设计”，属于实验工作。；研究对象：超薄镍（Ni）薄膜，具体为通过热激光蒸发技术沉积的非外延薄膜。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 成功搭建了自制的热激光蒸发系统，并利用该系统沉积了超薄Ni薄膜，表征了其表面粗糙度、成分和室温电学性质，为热激光蒸发技术在薄膜沉积和外延生长中的潜力提供了进一步证据。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：成功搭建了自制的热激光蒸发系统，并利用该系统沉积了超薄Ni薄膜，表征了其表面粗糙度、成分和室温电学性质，为热激光蒸发技术在薄膜沉积和外延生长中的潜力提供了进一步证据。；创新点：首次详细描述了热激光蒸发系统中关键组件（如激光传输系统）的设计，并对非外延超薄Ni薄膜进行了系统表征，推动了该技术的更广泛应用。
papers.method_zh: 采用自制的热激光蒸发系统，使用连续波1 kW光纤激光器（1070 nm）聚焦至亚毫米直径，在超高真空腔体内加热Ni靶材至熔点附近（约1725 K）产生蒸气进行薄膜沉积。表征手段包括表面粗糙度、成分分析和室温电学性质测量。

papers.title: Robust Spin Splitting and Strain-Controlled Optical Response in Monolayer CrC2N4 for Valleytronic and Optoelectronic Applications
papers.abstract: Monolayer CrC2N4 recently emerged as a promising two-dimensional semiconductor, yet its spin-orbit-coupled (SOC) physics and strain-tunable optical response remained largely unexplored. Here, we investigated the electronic, valley, charge-transfer, and optical properties of pristine and biaxially strained monolayer CrC2N4 using first-principles calculations. The monolayer exhibited a direct band gap at the K/K' valleys. SOC produced valley contrasting out-of-plane spin polarization, yielding a moderate valence band spin splitting of 51.9 meV and a small conduction band spin splitting of 1.7 meV. Orbital-resolved analysis showed that the edge states were mainly governed by Cr-d and N-p hybridization, while Bader analysis indicated polar-covalent bonding through charge transfer toward N atoms. Biaxial strain in the range of -4% to +4% tuned the band gap from 1.987 to 1.421 eV and drove an indirect-to-direct gap transition near -1% strain. Tensile strain enhanced the Berry curvature and red-shifted the optical response toward the visible-near-infrared region. These results suggested monolayer CrC2N4 as a promising platform for strain-engineered valleytronic and optoelectronic device applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词“first-principles calculations”（第一性原理计算）。；研究对象：单层CrC2N4二维半导体材料，具体研究其电子结构、谷物理性质、电荷转移、光学响应以及双轴应变调控效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 单层CrC2N4在K/K′谷处具有直接带隙，自旋-轨道耦合产生谷对比的面外自旋极化，价带自旋劈裂为51.9 meV，导带自旋劈裂为1.7 meV；双轴应变（-4%至+4%）可有效调控带隙（1.987至1.421 eV）并诱导间接-直接带隙转变，拉伸应变增强贝里曲率并使光学响应红移至可见-近红外区。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：单层CrC2N4在K/K′谷处具有直接带隙，自旋-轨道耦合产生谷对比的面外自旋极化，价带自旋劈裂为51.9 meV，导带自旋劈裂为1.7 meV；双轴应变（-4%至+4%）可有效调控带隙（1.987至1.421 eV）并诱导间接-直接带隙转变，拉伸应变增强贝里曲率并使光学响应红移至可见-近红外区。；创新点：首次系统揭示了单层CrC2N4在自旋-轨道耦合下的谷对比自旋极化特性及其应变可调的光学响应，为将其应用于应变工程化的谷电子学和光电子器件提供了理论依据。
papers.method_zh: 采用第一性原理计算（first-principles calculations），具体包括：自旋-轨道耦合（SOC）计算、轨道投影分析（orbital-resolved analysis）、Bader电荷分析（Bader analysis）、贝里曲率计算（Berry curvature）、双轴应变模拟（biaxial strain）。

papers.title: Emergent Antiphase Stacking in a Transient Charge Density Wave
authors: Gilberto A. de la Peña Muñoz
papers.abstract: Photoexcitation can induce novel states in materials that are inaccessible in equilibrium, a recent example being the light-induced charge density wave (CDW) observed in $\text{LaTe}_3$. Here, we investigate this transient CDW using infrared-pump x-ray-probe scattering at a free-electron laser, with high momentum and time resolution. We find that the transient CDW Bragg peak is broad in reciprocal space, indicating a highly disordered state. The ordering wavevector of the transient state is different from the equilibrium orders that develop in this class of materials - the transient peak appears near (2/7, 0, 0) reciprocal lattice units, whereas the equilibrium $a$ order and $c$ order occur at $\approx (5/7, 0, 0)$ and $(0, 0, 2/7)$, respectively. The transient CDW is therefore distinct from the equilibrium $a$ order, differing in the relative phase of the CDW displacement between the two equivalent nearly-square Te-Te nets in the conventional unit cell. Our work highlights how photoexcitation can access states with no equilibrium analog, and how x-ray scattering can provide microscopic insight into such elusive phases.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：infrared-pump x-ray-probe scattering（红外泵浦- X射线探针散射）、free-electron laser（自由电子激光）。；研究对象：光致瞬态电荷密度波（CDW）相，具体材料为 LaTe₃。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 光激发在 LaTe₃ 中诱导出一个与平衡态 a 序和 c 序均不同的瞬态 CDW 态，其序波矢约为 (2/7, 0, 0)，且该态在倒空间中展宽，表明高度无序；该瞬态 CDW 与平衡态 a 序的区别在于两个等效近正方形 Te-Te 网之间 CDW 位移的相对相位不同。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：光激发在 LaTe₃ 中诱导出一个与平衡态 a 序和 c 序均不同的瞬态 CDW 态，其序波矢约为 (2/7, 0, 0)，且该态在倒空间中展宽，表明高度无序；该瞬态 CDW 与平衡态 a 序的区别在于两个等效近正方形 Te-Te 网之间 CDW 位移的相对相位不同。；创新点：发现光激发可产生在平衡态下无法获得的 CDW 态，并通过 X 射线散射揭示了该瞬态相与平衡态在相对相位上的微观差异。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 采用红外泵浦- X射线探针散射技术，在自由电子激光装置上进行，具有高动量分辨和时间分辨能力。

papers.title: II. Exploring the role of the Crystal Electric Field in the vicinity of a Quantum Critical Point
papers.abstract: Very low temperature thermdynamic properties of the Yb$T_4M$ family of compounds are analyzed in a broad range of behavior including a quantum critical point QCP between magnetic and Fermi-liquid ground states GS. Doniach-Lavagna phase diagram limitations are improved by taking into account crystal electric field CEF splittings. The studied alloys: Yb$T_{5-x}M_x$ (with $T$= Ni, Cu, and $M$= Cd, Mg, Pd, Au, Zn, Ag), allow to gain insight into the evolution of the GS behavior undergoing the QCP region as a function of chemical doping as control parameter. Three types of behaviors are recognized in this system: i) a magnetic one, with weak interactions at $T_m\leq 1$\,K and very low Kondo temperature of their respective doublets GS. Between $T_m$ and $T_q\approx 0.3$\,K, quantum fluctuations start to dominate the scenario with the specific heat $C_{4f}/T(T\geq T_q)$ showing $T$ power law dependencies and a very heavy-fermion {\it plateau} below $T_q$. ii) beyond the QCP the typical non-fermi-liquid logarithmic $T$ dependence: $C_{4f}/T \propto \ln(T/T_0)$ and iii) at the non-magnetic limit, the alloys behave as valence-fluctuation systems with $T_K$ overcoming the CEF splitting. With this experimental information, a more realistic phase diagram can be drawn around the QCP where the scenario is dominated by low lying quantum fluctuations, without $C_{4f}/T|_{Lim T\to 0}$ divergences but a clear drop of its value.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“Very low temperature thermodynamic properties... are analyzed”，并基于“experimental information”绘制相图，涉及具体合金样品的测量。；研究对象：YbT₄M 系列化合物（具体为 YbT₅₋ₓMₓ，其中 T = Ni, Cu，M = Cd, Mg, Pd, Au, Zn, Ag），研究其在量子临界点（QCP）附近的晶体电场（CEF）效应及基态行为演化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在量子临界点附近，系统表现出三种基态行为：磁性态（弱相互作用、低近藤温度）、非费米液体态（对数温度依赖的比热）以及价涨落态（近藤温度超过CEF分裂）。研究指出，在QCP附近，低能量子涨落主导，但比热系数在零温极限下不发散，而是出现明显下降。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在量子临界点附近，系统表现出三种基态行为：磁性态（弱相互作用、低近藤温度）、非费米液体态（对数温度依赖的比热）以及价涨落态（近藤温度超过CEF分裂）。研究指出，在QCP附近，低能量子涨落主导，但比热系数在零温极限下不发散，而是出现明显下降。；创新点：将晶体电场（CEF）分裂效应纳入Doniach-Lavagna相图分析，从而更准确地描述YbT₄M体系在量子临界点附近的相图行为，并识别出三种不同的基态类型。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 通过极低温热力学性质测量（具体手段摘要未明确说明，如比热、磁化率等），以化学掺杂作为控制参数，分析YbT₅₋ₓMₓ合金的基态演化。理论框架上改进了Doniach-Lavagna相图，引入了晶体电场（CEF）分裂的修正。

papers.title: Dislocation-templated antiferromagnetic domains in epitaxial NiO
papers.abstract: Controlling antiferromagnetic domains is essential for spintronics, yet deterministic manipulation remains challenging due to their lack of net magnetization. Here, we utilize scanning electron microscopy electron channeling contrast imaging (ECCI) to demonstrate a robust structural memory effect in epitaxial NiO/MgO(001), where antiferromagnetic twin-domain walls (DWs) are deterministically pinned at the nanoscale by interface dislocation networks. Thermal cycling across the Neel temperature reveals that while DW contrast completely vanishes in the paramagnetic phase, the features re-emerge at identical spatial locations upon cooling. Diffraction-vector-dependent ECCI demonstrates that domain contrast stems from localized rhombohedral magnetostrictive strain fields. By tracking a film thickness series from 23 to 60 nm, we resolve an explicit transition in oxide relaxation mechanics. A primary slip system initiates strain relaxation via interface misfit dislocations (MDs) tracking along <100>. At greater thicknesses, rising critical strain prompts threading segments to cross-slip onto secondary or higher-index planes, depositing a wavy network of zig-zag MD lines deviated toward <110>. Quantitative image analysis reveals that DW area fractions directly track the local density and spatial configuration of the evolving MD networks, providing a framework for defect-engineering antiferromagnetic textures using one-dimensional defects.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：scanning electron microscopy electron channeling contrast imaging (ECCI)、thermal cycling、film thickness series、quantitative image analysis。；研究对象：外延生长的NiO薄膜（NiO/MgO(001)）中的反铁磁畴结构及其与位错网络的关联。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 反铁磁孪晶畴壁被界面位错网络在纳米尺度上确定性钉扎，且该钉扎效应在热循环（跨越奈尔温度）后仍可复现，表明存在一种稳健的结构记忆效应。畴壁对比度源于局域菱方磁致伸缩应变场。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：反铁磁孪晶畴壁被界面位错网络在纳米尺度上确定性钉扎，且该钉扎效应在热循环（跨越奈尔温度）后仍可复现，表明存在一种稳健的结构记忆效应。畴壁对比度源于局域菱方磁致伸缩应变场。；创新点：首次利用ECCI直接揭示了外延NiO中反铁磁畴壁被一维位错网络（包括界面失配位错和交叉滑移形成的锯齿状位错线）确定性钉扎的机制，并建立了畴壁面积分数与位错网络局域密度和空间构型之间的定量关联，为利用缺陷工程调控反铁磁织构提供了框架。
papers.method_zh: 扫描电子显微镜电子通道衬度成像（ECCI）；通过衍射矢量依赖的ECCI分析应变场来源；制备并测量23至60 nm不同厚度的薄膜系列，结合定量图像分析。

papers.title: Room-temperature tuning and probing of Fermi polarons in atomically thin semiconductors on a plasmonic metasurface
papers.abstract: The Fermi polaron, arising from interactions between a mobile impurity and a degenerate Fermi sea, is a many-body quasiparticle that provides a sensitive probe of strongly correlated electronic phases in atomically thin semiconductors. In doped transition-metal dichalcogenides, the attractive and repulsive polaron branches are well established in monolayers. However, extending active control and quantitative, branch-resolved probing to stacked geometries has remained elusive because spectral quenching and weak optical contrast restrict access to Fermi polaron signatures. Here, we integrate electron-doped WS$_2$ flakes from monolayer to quadrilayer with a strain-tunable plasmonic metasurface, enabling high-contrast scattering readout at room temperature through coupling between Fermi polaron resonances and surface plasmons. This platform enables quantitative extraction of polaron branch spectral weights and coupling strengths across different layer numbers. We uncover a systematic thickness dependence of the spectral-weight distribution and demonstrate continuous and fully reversible spectral-weight transfer between attractive and repulsive branches in bilayers and quadrilayers, with near-complete transfer achieved in bilayers. By identifying layer number and strain as complementary control parameters for Fermi polarons, our results establish metasurface-enabled scattering spectroscopy as a practical route to resolve and manipulate many-body resonances in stacked van der Waals semiconductors, bridging idealized monolayer polaron physics and device-relevant architectures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：integrate、demonstrate、uncover、demonstrate、establish。；研究对象：电子掺杂的WS₂（从单层到四层）与可应变调控的等离激元超表面集成的体系，具体研究费米极化子（Fermi polaron）这一多体准粒子。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现费米极化子分支的谱权重分布具有系统性的厚度依赖，并在双层和四层WS₂中实现了吸引与排斥分支之间连续、完全可逆的谱权重转移（双层中接近完全转移）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现费米极化子分支的谱权重分布具有系统性的厚度依赖，并在双层和四层WS₂中实现了吸引与排斥分支之间连续、完全可逆的谱权重转移（双层中接近完全转移）。；创新点：首次将费米极化子的主动调控和定量、分支分辨的探测扩展到堆叠几何结构（多层WS₂），并识别出层数和应变作为互补的控制参数，建立了基于超表面的散射光谱学作为解析和操控堆叠范德华半导体中多体共振的实用途径。
papers.method_zh: 将电子掺杂的WS₂薄片（单层至四层）与可应变调控的等离激元超表面集成，利用费米极化子共振与表面等离激元之间的耦合，在室温下实现高对比度的散射光谱读出，从而定量提取不同层数下的极化子分支谱权重和耦合强度。

papers.title: Tunable Superconductivity in 1313-La$_3$Ni$_2$O$_7$: Suppressed under Compression and Possible $s^{\pm}$ Pairing under Tension
papers.abstract: Motivated by recent progress in the 1313-La$_3$Ni$_2$O$_7$ nickelate thin films (Nie et al., Nature {\bf 652}, 628 (2026)), we systematically investigate the effects of both compressive and tensile strain in this system. Self-doping effects between the single-layer (SL) and trilayer (TL) blocks are observed in our studies in both cases, but are most pronounced under tensile strain. We find that superconductivity is unlikely to emerge in the 1313 film on the LSAO substrate even with further hole doping. Remarkably, within the random-phase approximation, under {\it tensile} strain, a robust $s^{\pm}$-wave pairing state emerges in the TL subsystem with sign changes between the small electron-like $σ$ pocket at the $Γ$ point and the small hole-like $γ$ pocket at the M point. These pockets are connected by a wave vector close to $(π,π)$. Our calculations also suggest that superconductivity in 1313-LNO requires an optimally sized $γ$ pocket, because an oversized $γ$ pocket suppresses pairing formation. Overall, our results predict strain-dependent electronic reconstruction in 1313-La$_3$Ni$_2$O$_7$ and provide guiding principles for engineering superconductivity under ambient pressure conditions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。依据：摘要中明确提到“within the random-phase approximation”（随机相位近似）和“our calculations also suggest”（我们的计算还表明），属于理论计算研究。；研究对象：论文研究的具体材料是1313相La₃Ni₂O₇镍酸盐薄膜，重点研究其在外加压缩应变和拉伸应变下的超导电性调控。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在拉伸应变下，三层块（TL）子系统中出现稳健的s±波配对态，其超导配对由Γ点的小电子型σ口袋与M点的小空穴型γ口袋之间的符号反转实现；同时发现超导需要γ口袋尺寸最优，过大则会抑制配对。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在拉伸应变下，三层块（TL）子系统中出现稳健的s±波配对态，其超导配对由Γ点的小电子型σ口袋与M点的小空穴型γ口袋之间的符号反转实现；同时发现超导需要γ口袋尺寸最优，过大则会抑制配对。；创新点：首次系统研究了1313-La₃Ni₂O₇薄膜在压缩和拉伸应变下的电子结构重构与超导电性变化，揭示了应变可诱导s±波配对态，并指出在LSAO衬底上即使进一步空穴掺杂也难以出现超导。摘要未突出说明与已有实验或理论工作的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 采用随机相位近似（RPA）进行配对对称性分析；通过应变调控研究单层块（SL）与三层块（TL）之间的自掺杂效应。

papers.title: General Method for Evaluation of Stop-Bands of Periodic Structures with Symmetric Unit Cells
papers.abstract: The mirror symmetries of a periodic unit cell are exploited to decompose the standing-wave eigenproblem at the high-symmetry vertices of the Brillouin zone into four independent sub-problems on a quarter-cell, each governed by Neumann (sound-hard) or Dirichlet (sound-soft) boundary conditions. Sorting and pairing the resulting eigenfrequencies by index along each segment of the irreducible Brillouin zone boundary yields an explicit formula for the stop-band intervals without computing the full dispersion diagram. The decomposition is exact, following directly from the representation theory of the little group at each high-symmetry point. It applies to any unit cell whose material distribution is invariant under the mirrors normal to the cell faces. The method is validated on two configurations: a phononic crystal of lead cylinders in an epoxy matrix, analyzed using the plane-wave expansion, and a lattice of coupled C-shaped Helmholtz resonators, analyzed using finite-element analysis. For both systems, the reconstructed stop-band boundaries agree with the full Floquet dispersion calculation to within 1% for the lowest bands, requiring eigenvalue solutions at only three discrete wavevectors. Avoided crossings within a Brillouin zone segment can cause bands to exhibit non-monotone behavior, rendering the pairing rule approximate; the spectral conditions for this are identified. Flat bands common to both boundary-condition types are identified as bound states in the continuum.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论兼计算文章。关键词：理论推导（representation theory, decomposition）、数值验证（plane-wave expansion, finite-element analysis）。；研究对象：具有对称单胞的周期性结构（如声子晶体、亥姆霍兹共振器晶格）的带隙（stop-band）计算问题。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 利用单胞的镜面对称性，可将布里渊区高对称点处的驻波本征问题精确分解为四分之一单胞上的四个独立子问题，从而无需计算完整色散图即可直接得到带隙区间的显式公式。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：利用单胞的镜面对称性，可将布里渊区高对称点处的驻波本征问题精确分解为四分之一单胞上的四个独立子问题，从而无需计算完整色散图即可直接得到带隙区间的显式公式。；创新点：提出一种仅需在三个离散波矢处求解本征值即可精确重构带隙边界的通用方法（最低能带误差<1%），并识别了导致配对规则近似失效的能带非单调行为（避免交叉）及其谱条件，同时指出两种边界条件共有的平带对应连续谱中的束缚态。
papers.method_zh: 基于群论中高对称点小群（little group）的表示理论，将本征问题分解为Neumann（声硬）和Dirichlet（声软）边界条件下的子问题；通过沿不可约布里渊区边界按指标排序并配对子问题本征频率，导出带隙公式。数值验证采用两种方法：平面波展开法（分析环氧树脂基体中铅柱构成的声子晶体）和有限元法（分析耦合C形亥姆霍兹共振器晶格）。

papers.title: Stochastic Thermodynamics of Score Matching in Diffusion Models
papers.abstract: Score-based diffusion models are a powerful class of generative AI systems capable of sampling from complex, high-dimensional probability distributions. Their dynamics consist of a forward diffusion process that transforms data into noise and a learned reverse process that reconstructs data by reversing the probability flow. Here, we develop a stochastic thermodynamic framework for diffusion models and their score-matching objective. We introduce a trajectory-dependent quantity, time-asymmetry entropy production (TAEP), defined from the forward and reverse diffusion dynamics, and show that it obeys exact fluctuation theorems. Remarkably, Hyvärinen's implicit score-matching kernel emerges naturally as a fluctuating component of TAEP, while the average TAEP is exactly proportional to the score-matching objective. We further show that fluctuations of TAEP quantify sampling unevenness and provide a thermodynamic measure of data-manifold coverage. These results yield a quantitative explanation for the superior sampling diversity of diffusion models and reveal a thermodynamic mechanism by which stochastic gradient descent favors flatter, more generalizable solutions. By uncovering the entropic nature of score matching, our work establishes fundamental statistical-mechanical principles underlying diffusion-based generative AI.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：stochastic thermodynamic framework、fluctuation theorems、theoretical analysis。；研究对象：扩散模型（score-based diffusion models）中的随机热力学，具体研究其正向扩散与反向生成过程中的熵产生与得分匹配目标之间的物理联系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现Hyvärinen隐式得分匹配核自然作为时间不对称熵产生（TAEP）的涨落分量出现，且平均TAEP与得分匹配目标严格成正比；TAEP的涨落可量化采样不均匀性并提供数据流形覆盖的热力学度量。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现Hyvärinen隐式得分匹配核自然作为时间不对称熵产生（TAEP）的涨落分量出现，且平均TAEP与得分匹配目标严格成正比；TAEP的涨落可量化采样不均匀性并提供数据流形覆盖的热力学度量。；创新点：首次揭示了得分匹配的熵本质，建立了扩散生成式AI背后的统计力学基础原理，并定量解释了扩散模型优越的采样多样性以及随机梯度下降倾向于更平坦、更可泛化解的热力学机制。
papers.method_zh: 构建了扩散模型及其得分匹配目标的随机热力学框架，定义了基于正向与反向扩散动力学的轨迹依赖量——时间不对称熵产生（TAEP），并推导其满足精确涨落定理。

papers.title: Spin effects in the particle current of Bose-Einstein condensates in synthetic gauge fields
papers.abstract: Although spin is not a relativistic quantity, its effects are not always manifestly captured within non-relativistic theoretical frameworks. We report on one of these effects: the spin term in the particle current density, which could be observed in the setup of a synthetic Hall system made with non-relativistic Bose-Einstein condensates of pseudospin-1/2 bosonic particles. By tuning the interaction strength, the system can show how the spin term in the particle current is needed for the local matching of classical drift velocity in the ground state of the non-interacting system, whereas for increasing interactions the spin-to-orbital current ratio decreases. In either case, since the overall particle velocity changes with the spin term contribution, so does its circulation in a loop, which in turn has physical consequences for its relationship with the Aharonov-Bohm phase shift.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中讨论理论框架（非相对论框架、自旋项对粒子流密度的贡献）和物理效应（Aharonov-Bohm相位），未提及实验或计算手段。；研究对象：合成规范场中自旋1/2玻色子的玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体（BEC），具体为合成霍尔系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在非相对论BEC的粒子流密度中存在一个自旋项，该自旋项在无相互作用基态中对于局域匹配经典漂移速度是必要的；随着相互作用增强，自旋-轨道流比率下降，且自旋项贡献会改变整体粒子速度及其环流，进而影响与Aharonov-Bohm相移的关系。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在非相对论BEC的粒子流密度中存在一个自旋项，该自旋项在无相互作用基态中对于局域匹配经典漂移速度是必要的；随着相互作用增强，自旋-轨道流比率下降，且自旋项贡献会改变整体粒子速度及其环流，进而影响与Aharonov-Bohm相移的关系。；创新点：揭示了非相对论框架下自旋效应在粒子流密度中的具体表现（自旋项），并指出该效应可通过合成规范场中的BEC实验观测，同时阐明了自旋项与相互作用强度、漂移速度及Aharonov-Bohm相移之间的关联。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：基于非相对论自旋1/2玻色子的BEC模型，在合成规范场（合成霍尔系统）中通过调节相互作用强度，研究粒子流密度中自旋项的贡献及其对环流和Aharonov-Bohm相位的影响。

papers.title: Antisite-disorder driven tuning of magnetic properties and exchange-bias in Nd$_{2-x}$Sr$_{x}$CoMnO$_{6-δ}$ $(0 \leq x \leq 1)$ ($δ\sim 0.5$) double perovskites
papers.abstract: We demonstrate precise control of exchange bias (EB) in the Nd$_{2-x}$Sr$_x$CoMnO$_{6-δ}$ ($0 \leq x \leq 1$) double-perovskite series through Sr$^{2+}$ induced hole doping, unveiling a remarkable transition between normal and inverse EB states. Employing neutron powder diffraction and X-ray absorption spectroscopy, we reveal a structural evolution from a B-site-ordered monoclinic ($P2_1/n$) phase to a disordered rhombohedral ($R\overline{3}c$) phase with increasing $x$, accompanied by a shift in the effective Co valence from +2 toward +3, while the Mn valence remains essentially unchanged. DC magnetization measurements indicate a gradual suppression of ferromagnetism with hole doping, whereas AC susceptibility measurements at $x = 0.75$ reveal pronounced cluster-glass behavior and the highest EB field of $\sim 4$ kOe at 8 K under a 6 T cooling field. After correcting for minor-loop effects, we identify robust inverse EB at $x = 0.75$, persisting even under a cooling field of 6 T. We attribute this phenomenon to competing ferromagnetic--antiferromagnetic and ferromagnetic--glassy interfaces, governed by strong magnetic frustration and the magnetocrystalline anisotropy associated with rare-earth 4$f$ electrons. These findings elucidate the pivotal role of doping-induced structural and magnetic competition in tailoring EB behavior in rare-earth double perovskites, providing new insights for the design of advanced magnetic materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提及“neutron powder diffraction”、“X-ray absorption spectroscopy”、“DC magnetization measurements”、“AC susceptibility measurements”等实验手段。；研究对象：Nd₂₋ₓSrₓCoMnO₆₋δ（0 ≤ x ≤ 1，δ ~ 0.5）双钙钛矿系列材料中，通过Sr²⁺空穴掺杂调控的交换偏置（exchange bias）效应及其从正常到反向交换偏置的转变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过Sr掺杂诱导空穴掺杂，实现了对交换偏置的精确控制，观察到从正常到反向交换偏置的显著转变；在x=0.75时，样品表现出最强的簇玻璃行为，并在8 K、6 T冷却场下获得约4 kOe的最高交换偏置场，且该反向交换偏置在6 T冷却场下仍保持稳定。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过Sr掺杂诱导空穴掺杂，实现了对交换偏置的精确控制，观察到从正常到反向交换偏置的显著转变；在x=0.75时，样品表现出最强的簇玻璃行为，并在8 K、6 T冷却场下获得约4 kOe的最高交换偏置场，且该反向交换偏置在6 T冷却场下仍保持稳定。；创新点：揭示了掺杂诱导的结构（从有序单斜相到无序菱方相）与磁性竞争（铁磁-反铁磁及铁磁-玻璃态界面竞争）在调控稀土双钙钛矿交换偏置行为中的关键作用，为设计先进磁性材料提供了新思路。
papers.method_zh: 中子粉末衍射、X射线吸收光谱、直流磁化强度测量、交流磁化率测量。

papers.title: Physics-Informed Attention Mechanism and Generalization Capability of Deep Learning-Based Grain Growth Evolution Prediction
papers.abstract: Machine Learning (ML) models for grain growth prediction are typically trained on idealized synthetic data, yet practical applications require generalization to conditions outside the training distribution. This study evaluated the Out-Of-Distribution (OOD) generalization capability of the trained model from our previous study across three test cases, including experimental microstructures, microstructures characterized by a bimodal grain size distribution, and abnormal grain growth. To further probe whether physics-informed architectural design could improve robustness under these different conditions, a boundary-masked attention mechanism was proposed specifically for grain growth, constraining attention to grain boundary pixels. Both the baseline and the proposed physics-informed attention model were evaluated without retraining or fine-tuning on the OOD data. Both models successfully generalized to all three test cases, yet the boundary-masked attention mechanism provided substantial improvements, with the most notable gains for microstructures characterized by a bimodal grain size distribution, where Structural Similarity Index Measure (SSIM) improved from \num{0.6221} to \num{0.7609} and mean grain size ($\overline{R}$) error decreased from \SI{8.75}{\percent} to \SI{3.57}{\percent}. The attention heatmap analysis revealed that the boundary-masked attention model learned to concentrate attention on large grain boundaries in a manner consistent with curvature-driven grain growth physics, emerging from training without being explicitly encoded into the architecture. These results indicate that models trained on synthetic data can generalize to diverse OOD conditions without retraining, and that physics-informed attention may improve accuracy when the boundary morphology matches the training domain.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：Machine Learning (ML) models、deep learning、physics-informed attention mechanism、generalization capability。；研究对象：晶粒生长演化预测，具体涉及多晶微结构在非训练分布条件下的演化，包括实验微结构、双峰晶粒尺寸分布微结构以及异常晶粒生长。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 基于合成数据训练的深度学习模型无需重新训练即可泛化到多种分布外（OOD）条件；提出的边界掩码注意力机制显著提升了预测精度，尤其在双峰晶粒尺寸分布微结构上，SSIM从0.6221提升至0.7609，平均晶粒尺寸误差从8.75%降至3.57%。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：基于合成数据训练的深度学习模型无需重新训练即可泛化到多种分布外（OOD）条件；提出的边界掩码注意力机制显著提升了预测精度，尤其在双峰晶粒尺寸分布微结构上，SSIM从0.6221提升至0.7609，平均晶粒尺寸误差从8.75%降至3.57%。；创新点：提出了一种专门针对晶粒生长的边界掩码注意力机制，该机制将物理约束（晶界像素）直接嵌入深度学习架构，且模型在训练中自发学习到与曲率驱动晶粒生长物理一致的注意力模式，无需显式编码该物理规律。
papers.method_zh: 采用深度学习模型（基线模型与提出的物理信息注意力模型），其中物理信息注意力机制通过边界掩码将注意力约束在晶界像素上。模型在合成数据上训练，并在三种OOD测试案例（实验微结构、双峰分布微结构、异常晶粒生长）上直接评估，未进行重训练或微调。使用结构相似性指数（SSIM）和平均晶粒尺寸误差作为评价指标，并通过注意力热图分析模型行为。

papers.title: Kohn--Luttinger Superconductivity in Flat Chern Bands
papers.abstract: Recent observations of superconductivity near correlated topological phases in flat bands suggest a facile link between flat-band geometry and electron pairing. In this work, we reveal a geometry-driven Kohn--Luttinger mechanism in which Landau-level-like form factors align the attractive lobe of the RPA-screened Coulomb interaction with the form-factor peak, generating an anomalously strong attractive channel near local band extrema. Using the Skyrmion lattice model as a minimal realization, we show that for spin-unpolarized pairing the form-factor magnitude enforces an emergent momentum-space translational symmetry and selects an extended-$s$ instability concentrated at small Fermi pockets, while for spin-polarized pairing the form-factor phase drives chiral $p$- and $f$-wave order without invoking spin fluctuations. The band-extrema enhancement persists in higher Landau-level analogs and survives finite-temperature screening and Berezinskii--Kosterlitz--Thouless phase fluctuations. Our work establishes quantum geometry as a key organizing principle for unconventional pairing in flat Chern bands.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“reveal”“show”“establish”等理论推导和模型分析词汇，未提及实验数据或计算模拟。；研究对象：平带Chern能带中的非常规超导电性，具体以Skyrmion晶格模型作为最小实现体系，研究Kohn–Luttinger机制驱动的电子配对。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 平带几何效应通过Landau能级型形状因子使RPA屏蔽库仑相互作用的吸引瓣与形状因子峰值对齐，在能带极值附近产生异常强的吸引通道；对于自旋非极化配对，形状因子幅度导致动量空间平移对称性并选择扩展s波失稳；对于自旋极化配对，形状因子相位驱动手性p波和f波序。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：平带几何效应通过Landau能级型形状因子使RPA屏蔽库仑相互作用的吸引瓣与形状因子峰值对齐，在能带极值附近产生异常强的吸引通道；对于自旋非极化配对，形状因子幅度导致动量空间平移对称性并选择扩展s波失稳；对于自旋极化配对，形状因子相位驱动手性p波和f波序。；创新点：揭示了量子几何（而非传统自旋涨落）作为平带Chern能带中非常规配对的关键组织原理，并指出能带极值处的增强效应在更高Landau能级类似物中依然存在。
papers.method_zh: 基于RPA屏蔽库仑相互作用的Kohn–Luttinger理论框架，利用Skyrmion晶格模型作为最小模型，分析形状因子幅度和相位对配对对称性的影响，并考虑有限温度屏蔽和BKT相涨落。

papers.title: How twist angle inhomogeneity masks the BKT transition and the order parameter symmetry
papers.abstract: Two-dimensional superconductors, including twisted multilayer graphene, should exhibit a BKT transition, and the $T$-dependence of the superfluid stiffness should distinguish between nodal or gapped order parameter symmetries. However, this picture dramatically changes when spatially correlated disorder is taken into account. Such correlations naturally arise in moiré systems due to twist angle inhomogeneities, which we model using elasticity theory. Using a random impedance network based on realistic disorder in the local $T_c$, we show that the finite-frequency conductance reveals a smeared percolative transition instead of a BKT transition. At low temperatures, the disorder can effectively obscure the distinction between nodal and fully gapped superconducting order parameters. We propose that the real part of the conductivity can be used as a key diagnostic observable to probe the relevance of correlated disorder.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：modeling（建模）、random impedance network（随机阻抗网络）、elasticity theory（弹性理论）。；研究对象：二维超导体（包括扭曲多层石墨烯）中的BKT相变、超流刚度温度依赖性与序参量对称性（节点型或全能隙型），以及由扭转角不均匀性引起的空间关联无序对上述物理的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 空间关联无序（如扭转角不均匀性）会掩盖二维超导体的BKT相变，使其变为模糊的逾渗转变；同时，在低温下无序会模糊节点型与全能隙型超导序参量之间的区别。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：空间关联无序（如扭转角不均匀性）会掩盖二维超导体的BKT相变，使其变为模糊的逾渗转变；同时，在低温下无序会模糊节点型与全能隙型超导序参量之间的区别。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于弹性理论对扭转角不均匀性进行建模，构建基于局域Tc真实无序的随机阻抗网络，计算有限频率电导率。

papers.title: Machine learning insights into band gap properties in halide-based perovskites
papers.abstract: Halide perovskites show great promise for applications in optoelectronic devices. The lead-free perovskites are attracting increasing interest due to their low toxicity and motivate the exploration of alternative compositions and structures, including A$_2$BX$_6$, A$_2$BB$^\prime$X$_6$, A$_3$B$_2$X$_9$, and A$_4$BX$_6$. Accurate predictions of a wide range of band gap energies are important for designing new materials. It is also desired to generate a direct relationship between the structural and elemental descriptors and the band gap energies. In this work, we develop machine learning models to predict band gap energies across various types of halide perovskites based on atomic and structural properties. Algorithms including ensemble tree-based methods, random forest regression (RFR), gradient boosted regression trees (GBRT), and extreme gradient boosting (XGB) showed strong predictive accuracy. We also analyzed feature importance to identify key descriptors, including B-site and X-site elemental properties, as well as the number of A- and B-site atoms, as primary factors influencing band gap energies. These results improve our understanding of the ML models and provide guidance for designing new halide perovskite materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：machine learning models、predictive accuracy、feature importance。；研究对象：卤化物基钙钛矿材料，包括无铅钙钛矿（如A₂BX₆、A₂BB′X₆、A₃B₂X₉、A₄BX₆等结构类型）的带隙能量。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 基于集成树方法的机器学习模型（随机森林回归、梯度提升回归树、极端梯度提升）能够准确预测多种卤化物钙钛矿的带隙能量，并识别出B位和X位元素性质以及A、B位原子数量是影响带隙的关键描述符。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：基于集成树方法的机器学习模型（随机森林回归、梯度提升回归树、极端梯度提升）能够准确预测多种卤化物钙钛矿的带隙能量，并识别出B位和X位元素性质以及A、B位原子数量是影响带隙的关键描述符。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用机器学习方法，具体包括集成树类算法：随机森林回归（RFR）、梯度提升回归树（GBRT）和极端梯度提升（XGB）。模型基于原子和结构性质（描述符）进行训练，并通过特征重要性分析识别关键因素。

papers.title: Why dimensional analysis works: general classification of self-similarity based on scale-invariance
papers.abstract: In this work, we formulate self-similarity from the perspective of scale invariance, where a self-similar form is understood as the transformation of a function into a form invariant under scale transformations. By applying this formulation to physical parameters, which consist of numerical values and units, it is demonstrated that dimensional analysis works for physical problems because scale invariance is partially shared between units and physical parameters. This naturally leads to the distinction between similarity of the first kind and similarity of the second kind according to whether the scale functions induced by units and those associated with physical parameters are equivalent or not. Self-similar solutions of the second kind can be further classified according to whether the power exponents of the similarity parameters include functions of dimensionless numbers. This leads to the conclusion that there are three kinds of self-similar solutions. The present work provides a unified framework for understanding dimensional analysis and a universal classification of self-similarity in physical problems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：formulate（理论构建）、classification（分类）、framework（理论框架）。；研究对象：物理问题中的量纲分析（dimensional analysis）与自相似性（self-similarity）的普适分类。具体涉及物理参数（数值与单位）在尺度变换下的行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 量纲分析之所以有效，是因为单位与物理参数之间部分共享尺度不变性；基于此，自相似解可被统一划分为三种类型（第一类、第二类及第二类中根据无量纲数幂指数是否包含函数的子类）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：量纲分析之所以有效，是因为单位与物理参数之间部分共享尺度不变性；基于此，自相似解可被统一划分为三种类型（第一类、第二类及第二类中根据无量纲数幂指数是否包含函数的子类）。；创新点：从尺度不变性出发，为量纲分析提供了统一的数学基础，并首次将自相似解系统性地划分为三种类型，超越了传统的第一类/第二类二分法。
papers.method_zh: 采用尺度不变性（scale invariance）的数学形式化方法，将自相似形式定义为函数在尺度变换下的不变形式，并通过对物理参数（数值+单位）的变换性质进行分析，推导出量纲分析成立的条件与自相似解的完整分类。

papers.title: Hybrid Ferromagnet-SNSPDs: Single photon induced order-to-disorder transition in ferromagnets coupled to thin film superconductors
papers.abstract: The development of midwave and longwave infrared single photon detectors is crucial for their emerging applications in spectroscopy, remote sensing, exoplanet detection, and free space quantum communications. However, existing sensors need to be operated at extremely low temperatures (0.08-0.9K) to reduce dark noise and hence require the use of advanced cryogenics such as dilution refrigerators or $^3$He cryogens, significantly limiting applications. Here we propose a vortex-engineering approach based on a hybrid phase transition in a ferromagnet/superconductor bilayer to increase the operating temperature of infrared single photon detectors up to 3.75K. We show that the introduction of a ferromagnetic layer produces a local magnetic field which impedes vortex crossing in the superconductor, reducing dark noise. When a single photon is incident, the photon-induced hotspot causes an order-to-disorder transition in the ferromagnet, leading to a vortex-induced phase transition in the superconducting layer. By engineering the ferromagnet's Curie temperature to be close to the device's operating temperature, single photon sensitivity can be achieved at increased operating temperatures. We predict at midwave/longwave infrared wavelengths (3-14$μ$m) the operating temperature can be raised to 3.25-3.75K, enabling significantly simpler cooling systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“propose”“show”“predict”等理论建模与预测性表述，未提及实验数据或计算模拟细节。；研究对象：铁磁体/超导体双层异质结（ferromagnet/superconductor bilayer）中的混合相变现象，具体为单光子诱导的铁磁体有序-无序转变及其对超导层涡旋态的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过在超导薄膜上引入铁磁层，可产生局域磁场抑制超导体中的涡旋穿越，从而降低暗噪声；当单光子入射时，光子诱导的热点触发铁磁体发生有序-无序转变，进而引发超导层的涡旋诱导相变，使中波/长波红外单光子探测器的工作温度提升至3.25–3.75K。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过在超导薄膜上引入铁磁层，可产生局域磁场抑制超导体中的涡旋穿越，从而降低暗噪声；当单光子入射时，光子诱导的热点触发铁磁体发生有序-无序转变，进而引发超导层的涡旋诱导相变，使中波/长波红外单光子探测器的工作温度提升至3.25–3.75K。；创新点：提出利用铁磁/超导双层中的混合相变（而非传统纯超导体系）来提升红外单光子探测器的工作温度，将所需冷却条件从稀释制冷机（0.08–0.9K）简化至3.75K级别，显著降低对复杂低温系统的依赖。
papers.method_zh: 理论建模与数值预测：采用涡旋工程（vortex-engineering）方法，通过调控铁磁层的居里温度使其接近器件工作温度，分析铁磁/超导双层中的混合相变机制，并预测不同红外波长下的工作温度范围。

papers.title: Exotic magnetism and persistent spin dynamics in a frustrated Jeff = 1/2 triangular lattice antiferromagnet
authors: M. D. Le. P. J. Baker
papers.abstract: The delicate interplay between competing degrees of freedom, anisotropy, and frustration-induced strong quantum fluctuations in pseudospin-$J_{\rm eff}=1/2$ rare-earth triangular-lattice antiferromagnets offers a promising platform for the experimental realization of exotic states with nontrivial low-energy excitations. Here, we present thermodynamic, inelastic neutron scattering (INS), and muon spin relaxation ($μ$SR) investigations of the frustrated magnet K$_3$NdTe$_2$O$9$, in which Nd$^{3+}$ ions constitute a structurally perfect triangular lattice with no detectable site disorder. The experiments reveal the realization of a Kramers doublet ground state with $J{\rm eff}=1/2$ moments, well separated from the first excited state, which interact antiferromagnetically with an exchange interaction of $\sim$0.6 K between the Nd$^{3+}$ moments in the triangular plane. The absence of oscillations and the so-called 1/3 plateau in the zero-field $μ$SR asymmetry down to 50 mK rules out long-range magnetic ordering and spin freezing on the $μ$SR time scale, respectively. The temperature dependence of the zero-field $μ$SR relaxation rate is well described by the Orbach relaxation mechanism, indicating the existence of fluctuating moments in the ground state of this frustrated magnet. Our results demonstrate exotic magnetism and persistent spin dynamics down to 50 mK. These observations establish this new family of frustrated rare-earth triangular-lattice antiferromagnets as a promising venue for the experimental realization of nontrivial quantum states with exotic low-energy excitations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：thermodynamic, inelastic neutron scattering (INS), muon spin relaxation (μSR) investigations。；研究对象：具体化合物K₃NdTe₂O₉，其中Nd³⁺离子构成结构完美的三角晶格，是一种阻挫的J_eff=1/2三角晶格反铁磁体。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该材料在低至50 mK的温度下未出现长程磁有序或自旋冻结，而是表现出奇异的磁性和持续的自旋动力学，其零场μSR弛豫率符合Orbach弛豫机制，表明基态存在涨落磁矩。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该材料在低至50 mK的温度下未出现长程磁有序或自旋冻结，而是表现出奇异的磁性和持续的自旋动力学，其零场μSR弛豫率符合Orbach弛豫机制，表明基态存在涨落磁矩。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 热力学测量（比热/磁化率等）、非弹性中子散射（INS）、μ子自旋弛豫（μSR）。

papers.title: Superconductivity from emergent dipolar interactions in a fractionalized Fermi liquid
papers.abstract: Starting from the spin-fermion model or Hertz-Millis theory describing electrons coupled to anti-ferromagnetic spin fluctuations we develop a theory to describe the transition from a fractionalized Fermi liquid into a $d_{x^2-y^2}$ superconductor. We focus on small electron doping on top of the half-filled state. The doped electrons enter the system as spinon-chargon bound states, which form a small, reconstructed Fermi surface. The bound states are neutral under the emergent U(1) gauge symmetry of the fractionalized Fermi liquid, but interact via a dipolar two-body potential. We show that because of the projective action of translation symmetry on the spinons and chargons, the Fourier components of this repulsive dipolar interaction are peaked at the anti-ferromagnetic wave vector, thereby providing a robust microscopic mechanism for $d_{x^2-y^2}$ pairing in a fractionalized metal.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“develop a theory”、“provide a robust microscopic mechanism”，属于理论推导与机制分析。；研究对象：论文研究的是从分数化费米液体（fractionalized Fermi liquid）到 \( d_{x^2-y^2} \) 超导体的相变过程，具体体系为半满态上少量电子掺杂的电子-反铁磁自旋涨落耦合系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在分数化费米液体中，掺杂电子以自旋子-荷子束缚态形式进入系统，这些束缚态虽在涌现的U(1)规范对称性下呈电中性，但通过偶极相互作用产生排斥势，其傅里叶分量在反铁磁波矢处达到峰值，从而为 \( d_{x^2-y^2} \) 配对提供了稳健的微观机制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在分数化费米液体中，掺杂电子以自旋子-荷子束缚态形式进入系统，这些束缚态虽在涌现的U(1)规范对称性下呈电中性，但通过偶极相互作用产生排斥势，其傅里叶分量在反铁磁波矢处达到峰值，从而为 \( d_{x^2-y^2} \) 配对提供了稳健的微观机制。；创新点：摘要未突出说明与已有研究的具体差异，但核心创新在于：提出分数化费米液体中掺杂电子形成的束缚态通过偶极相互作用（而非传统磁涨落交换）实现 \( d_{x^2-y^2} \) 超导配对，并利用平移对称性的投影效应解释了配对波矢与反铁磁波矢的关联。
papers.method_zh: 基于自旋-费米子模型（spin-fermion model）或Hertz-Millis理论，结合分数化费米液体的涌现U(1)规范对称性，分析平移对称性在自旋子和荷子上的投影作用，推导偶极相互作用及其傅里叶分量对配对对称性的影响。

papers.title: Derivation of height field theory for the two-dimensional classical dimer model from a Grassmann-integral representation
papers.abstract: The classical dimer model on bipartite lattices hosts a Coulomb phase, characterized by algebraic correlations and topological order. Its long-wavelength properties can be described by the fluctuations of a vector field with zero divergence, which, in two dimensions, is equivalent to a continuum height model. We show how this field theory can be derived constructively for both square and honeycomb lattices, starting from an exact representation of the dimer model in terms of Grassmann integrals. Taking the continuum limit gives a massless Dirac fermion in two-dimensional Euclidean space, which, using bosonization in the path integral representation, maps exactly to the well-known height field theory, incorporating the relationship between its boundary discontinuity (or "tilt") and the flux. By including source terms coupling to the flux density and the local valence-bond-solid order parameter, which we show are the only ones required to describe the asymptotic long-distance correlations, we derive expressions for the dimer observables in terms of the height.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“derivation”、“Grassmann-integral representation”、“bosonization”、“path integral representation”等理论推导和场论方法。；研究对象：二维经典二聚体模型（classical dimer model）在正方晶格和蜂窝状晶格上的长波性质，特别是其库仑相（Coulomb phase）和高度场理论（height field theory）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 从Grassmann积分表示出发，通过连续极限得到无质量狄拉克费米子，再借助路径积分玻色化，严格推导出二维经典二聚体模型的高度场理论，并建立了边界不连续性（“倾斜”）与通量之间的关系。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：从Grassmann积分表示出发，通过连续极限得到无质量狄拉克费米子，再借助路径积分玻色化，严格推导出二维经典二聚体模型的高度场理论，并建立了边界不连续性（“倾斜”）与通量之间的关系。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导方法：Grassmann积分表示、连续极限近似、二维欧几里得空间中的无质量狄拉克费米子、路径积分玻色化（bosonization）、源项（source terms）耦合通量密度和局域价键固体序参量。

papers.title: Chiral Phonons Enable Ultrafast Magnetization Switching via Magnetoelastic Coupling
papers.abstract: Phonons are desirable for current-free energy-efficient spin manipulation and harnessing their chirality to achieve ultrafast magnetization switching remains actively pursued. Here we demonstrate that terahertz-driven chiral phonons enable faster magnetization switching than linear phonons through the purely magnetoelastic coupling that transfers both energy and angular momentum. Only one phonon handedness efficiently transfers angular momentum to the spin system, which we explain by a large fictitious kinematic Barnett-like field at THz frequencies that destabilizes spin precession for the opposite chirality. Considering different regions of the spinwave spectrum, we find that switching conditions can be realized near the Γ-point where strong energy transfer and spinwave excitation dominate, and near the P-point which offers minimal energy loss. Our results establish phonon chirality as a decisive and previously overlooked parameter in spin-lattice dynamics within the magnetoelastic coupling mechanism, offering a promising avenue for ultrafast low-energy spintronic devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：demonstrate、explain、considering different regions、we find）；研究对象：手性声子通过磁弹性耦合实现超快磁化翻转的物理机制，具体涉及太赫兹驱动下的自旋-晶格动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 太赫兹驱动的手性声子通过纯磁弹性耦合同时传递能量和角动量，能够比线性声子更快地实现磁化翻转；仅有一种手性声子能有效向自旋系统传递角动量，其物理根源在于太赫兹频率下产生的大虚拟运动学Barnett-like场，该场会破坏相反手性声子的自旋进动稳定性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：太赫兹驱动的手性声子通过纯磁弹性耦合同时传递能量和角动量，能够比线性声子更快地实现磁化翻转；仅有一种手性声子能有效向自旋系统传递角动量，其物理根源在于太赫兹频率下产生的大虚拟运动学Barnett-like场，该场会破坏相反手性声子的自旋进动稳定性。；创新点：首次将声子手性确立为自旋-晶格动力学中一个决定性但此前被忽视的参数，揭示了手性声子在磁弹性耦合中实现超快、低能耗磁化翻转的关键作用。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：基于磁弹性耦合机制，考虑自旋波谱的不同区域（Γ点和P点），通过虚构Barnett-like场解释手性依赖的角动量传递，并比较不同手性声子对自旋进动稳定性的影响。

papers.title: Excitonic Condensation in an Asymmetric Electron-Hole Biwire
papers.abstract: We study a mass-asymmetric one-dimensional electron-hole biwire system at zero temperature using the diffusion quantum Monte Carlo method. Pair correlation functions and condensate fraction are obtained over a wide range of carrier densities $r_{\rm s}$ and interwire separations $d$, allowing us to construct the phase diagram. We identify regimes corresponding to a two-component electron-hole plasma, an excitonic fluid with quasicondensation, and a Wigner-correlated phase at various densities. Owing to reduced dimensionality, strong electron-hole correlations favor excitonic quasicondensation even in the high-density limit, persisting down to $r_{\rm s} = 0.3$ a.u. These results provide a microscopic characterization of correlation-driven phases in electron-hole systems in one dimension.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：diffusion quantum Monte Carlo method（扩散量子蒙特卡洛方法）。；研究对象：一维非对称电子-空穴双线系统（mass-asymmetric one-dimensional electron-hole biwire system）中的激子凝聚现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在零温下，即使在高密度极限（r_s = 0.3 a.u.）下，由于维度降低导致的强电子-空穴关联，系统仍能维持激子准凝聚态（excitonic quasicondensation）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在零温下，即使在高密度极限（r_s = 0.3 a.u.）下，由于维度降低导致的强电子-空穴关联，系统仍能维持激子准凝聚态（excitonic quasicondensation）。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用扩散量子蒙特卡洛（diffusion quantum Monte Carlo, DQMC）方法进行零温计算，通过分析对关联函数（pair correlation functions）和凝聚分数（condensate fraction）来构建相图。

papers.title: Quantum statistical enhancement of collective behaviour in a bosonic active Ising model
papers.abstract: Collective behaviour such as flocking (the collective motion of a spontaneously formed group along a common direction) or aster formation (the binding of opposing flocks, inhibiting each others motion) are intriguing emergent phenomena in active systems with local alignment rules. Until recently, their occurrence was mainly studied for classical systems, a prime example being the active Ising model (AIM), which translates the main ingredients of flocking and aster formation (i.e., alignment and self-propulsion) to a lattice framework. Here we introduce and study a one-dimensional (1D) quantum lattice variant of the AIM, based on ideal bosons with a spin degree of freedom. We find that both the collective behaviours of the 1D classical model, flocking and aster formation, are markedly enhanced by the bosonic quantum statistics. This contrasts with a recent quantum generalization of the AIM based onto hard-core bosons [Khasseh et al., Phys. Rev. Lett. 135, 248302 (2025)], where flocking, but neither its quantum-statistical stabilization nor aster states were observed as a consequence of interactions. Moreover, we investigate the competition of this quantum statistical stabilization of collective phases with their suppression by the quantum fluctuations induced by a transverse external magnetic field.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：introduce and study、quantum lattice variant、基于理想玻色子模型。；研究对象：一维玻色子活性伊辛模型（bosonic active Ising model），具体研究该量子晶格变体中集体行为（如 flocking 和 aster formation）的量子统计增强效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 玻色子量子统计显著增强了经典一维活性伊辛模型中的 flocking 和 aster formation 两种集体行为，这与基于硬核玻色子的量子推广模型（未观察到量子统计稳定化及 aster 态）形成对比。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：玻色子量子统计显著增强了经典一维活性伊辛模型中的 flocking 和 aster formation 两种集体行为，这与基于硬核玻色子的量子推广模型（未观察到量子统计稳定化及 aster 态）形成对比。；创新点：首次在玻色子活性伊辛模型中揭示量子统计对集体行为的增强作用，并发现该效应与硬核玻色子模型（Khasseh et al., PRL 2025）的关键差异——后者因相互作用而未能实现量子统计稳定化及 aster 态。
papers.method_zh: 理论建模与分析：将经典活性伊辛模型（AIM）推广到一维量子晶格版本，基于具有自旋自由度的理想玻色子构建模型，并引入横向外磁场以研究量子涨落对集体相稳定性的竞争效应。

papers.title: Emergent de Sitter Space and Non-Unitary Tensor Networks from Non-Hermitian Quantum Criticality
papers.abstract: Extending the holographic principle to de Sitter (dS) spacetimes remains one of the most vital open frontiers in quantum gravity, where a microscopic, bottom-up tensor-network framework that relates boundary quantum data to emergent de Sitter spacetime is still lacking. In this work, we first show the emergence of de Sitter spacetime from boundary entanglement by formulating a non-unitary continuous multi-scale entanglement renormalization ansatz (cMERA) for a concrete non-Hermitian critical fermion chain. Within this emergent spacetime, we analyze the associated geodesics and show that they act as extremal Ryu-Takayanagi (RT) surfaces undergoing a smooth timelike-to-null transition. Remarkably, we demonstrate that this continuum trajectory dictates a distinct tensor-network architecture in which the bond-counting contribution naturally truncates at the discrete timelike-to-null transition toward the deep infrared. In the resulting architecture, the null ray along the horizon is represented by zero-cost links, since the associated cut severs no tensor legs. This network structure successfully reproduces the logarithmic scaling of non-unitary critical entanglement entropy, offering a bond-counting picture for the de Sitter RT formula. Our results provide the long-sought dS/(c)MERA correspondence at the level of both emergent spacetime and discrete holographic entanglement.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“formulating”“demonstrate”“reproduce”等理论推导与模型构建词汇，未提及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：非厄米临界费米子链中涌现的德西特（de Sitter）时空，以及与之对应的非幺正张量网络结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过构建非厄米临界费米子链的非幺正连续多尺度纠缠重整化假设（cMERA），首次实现了从边界纠缠信息涌现出德西特时空，并揭示了该时空中的测地线作为极值Ryu-Takayanagi（RT）面经历类时到类光平滑转变，从而在张量网络架构中自然截断并重现德西特RT公式的对数标度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过构建非厄米临界费米子链的非幺正连续多尺度纠缠重整化假设（cMERA），首次实现了从边界纠缠信息涌现出德西特时空，并揭示了该时空中的测地线作为极值Ryu-Takayanagi（RT）面经历类时到类光平滑转变，从而在张量网络架构中自然截断并重现德西特RT公式的对数标度。；创新点：首次建立了德西特时空与（连续）MERA之间的对应关系（dS/(c)MERA对应），在涌现时空和离散全息纠缠两个层面提供了自下而上的张量网络框架，并揭示了类时到类光转变在张量网络架构中的自然截断机制。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：非幺正连续多尺度纠缠重整化假设（cMERA），结合非厄米临界费米子链模型；通过分析涌现时空中的测地线行为及张量网络中的键计数（bond-counting）贡献。

papers.title: Manipulation of Topological Corner States via Subchiral Symmetry
papers.abstract: Higher-order topological phases provide robust corner modes, but their use requires controllable creation, isolation, and transfer of individual modes and their superpositions. Here we demonstrate, using the two-dimensional Benalcazar-Bernevig-Hughes model as an example, that subchiral symmetry provides a general control principle for manipulating topological corner modes. The conventional chiral symmetry decomposes into four subchiral symmetries, each associated with one zero-energy corner mode. By selectively breaking these subsymmetries with controlled intercell hoppings, we reduce the fourfold corner-state manifold step by step to single isolated modes. We further design adiabatic protocols that transfer either a single corner state or a superposition of two corner states between selected corners, while preserving the relative phase in the latter case. Both numerical simulations and IBM quantum-processor implementations show that the proposed protocols can be executed with high fidelity, establishing subchiral symmetry as a route to programmable higher-order topological state manipulation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（含数值模拟与量子处理器实验验证）。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“numerical simulations and IBM quantum-processor implementations”，但核心是理论框架（subchiral symmetry）的提出与验证。；研究对象：二维Benalcazar-Bernevig-Hughes（BBH）模型中的高阶拓扑角态及其操控。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 子手征对称性（subchiral symmetry）可作为通用控制原理，通过选择性破缺该对称性，实现拓扑角态的可控创建、隔离、转移以及叠加态的保相转移。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：子手征对称性（subchiral symmetry）可作为通用控制原理，通过选择性破缺该对称性，实现拓扑角态的可控创建、隔离、转移以及叠加态的保相转移。；创新点：首次提出子手征对称性作为高阶拓扑态可编程操控的通用原理，并展示了从四重简并角态逐步降维至单模、以及单模与叠加态在角点间转移的完整协议。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析（子手征对称性分解与破缺机制）、数值模拟（绝热协议设计）、IBM量子处理器实验实现（验证高保真度操控）。

papers.title: A Lindbladian for holographic Brownian motion
papers.abstract: We derive a Lindbladian description of holographic Brownian motion in the high-temperature regime. Starting from the influence functional for a trailing string endpoint, we identify the corresponding quantum master equation and prove that it is completely positive and trace-preserving. We determine the coefficients of the Lindbladian explicitly for two holographic backgrounds: the BTZ black hole and the AdS$_5$ black brane, restricting in the latter case to the endpoint fluctuation along the $x^1$-direction. We then analyze the time evolution of phase-space moments, energy relaxation, and steady states.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：derive（推导）、Lindbladian description（林德布拉德描述）、quantum master equation（量子主方程）。；研究对象：全息布朗运动（holographic Brownian motion），具体为高能物理中拖尾弦端点（trailing string endpoint）在高温下的量子布朗运动，涉及两种全息背景：BTZ黑洞和AdS₅黑膜。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 推导出了描述全息布朗运动的林德布拉德方程，并证明其满足完全正定性和迹保持性；明确给出了两种全息背景下的林德布拉德系数，并分析了相空间矩、能量弛豫和稳态的时间演化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：推导出了描述全息布朗运动的林德布拉德方程，并证明其满足完全正定性和迹保持性；明确给出了两种全息背景下的林德布拉德系数，并分析了相空间矩、能量弛豫和稳态的时间演化。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 从影响泛函（influence functional）出发，推导对应的量子主方程，并利用林德布拉德形式（Lindbladian formalism）进行理论分析。具体背景为BTZ黑洞和AdS₅黑膜（后者仅考虑端点沿x¹方向的涨落）。

papers.title: Creating squeezed and non-classical collective motional many-body states through stroboscopic Rydberg dressing
papers.abstract: Realizing conditional quantum operations, e.g., quantum gates, for quantum computing and simulation requires controlled interactions between particles. Often, these interactions depend on the interparticle distance, and accordingly, an uncertainty of the relative particle position may translate into gate infidelities. We consider here a quantum computing platform based on an array of neutral atoms and present a method that allows to reduce the uncertainty of all interatomic distances. Our approach exploits the coupling between atomic motion and stroboscopically excited atomic Rydberg states. It allows to collectively squeeze the modes corresponding to interatomic displacements, thereby reducing distance fluctuations down to a fraction of the motional vacuum state. Furthermore, the method permits the creation of non-classical states with substantial Wigner negativity. These correlated states may allow reducing motional decoherence, increasing gate fidelity, and potentially yield a resource for quantum-enhanced metrology.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中描述了一种“方法”（method），并基于理论分析（如“collectively squeeze the modes”、“Wigner negativity”），未提及实验实现或数值计算细节。；研究对象：基于中性原子阵列的量子计算平台，具体研究原子间相对运动（interatomic displacements）的量子态操控，以及通过Rydberg态缀饰（Rydberg dressing）实现集体运动模式的压缩与非经典态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一种通过频闪激发（stroboscopic）Rydberg态来耦合原子运动的方法，能够集体压缩原子间距离的量子涨落至低于运动真空态的水平，并产生具有显著Wigner负性的非经典多体运动态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一种通过频闪激发（stroboscopic）Rydberg态来耦合原子运动的方法，能够集体压缩原子间距离的量子涨落至低于运动真空态的水平，并产生具有显著Wigner负性的非经典多体运动态。；创新点：提出利用频闪Rydberg缀饰实现集体运动模的压缩，从而将原子间距离涨落降低至真空态以下，并生成具有Wigner负性的非经典态，这为提升量子门保真度和量子增强计量提供了新途径。摘要未突出说明与已有压缩方案的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 理论方法：基于原子运动与频闪激发的Rydberg态之间的耦合，利用集体模压缩技术（collective squeezing）来降低原子间距离的不确定性。摘要未明确说明具体理论框架（如是否使用量子主方程、绝热消除等），但核心是量子控制与量子光学中的压缩态生成方法。

papers.title: When Volumetric Growth Selects Surface Growth
papers.abstract: We investigate the relationship between volumetric and surface growth within a recently proposed optimization-driven framework for linearly elastic solids. In this approach, growth is not prescribed through an evolution law; instead, the growth distribution is determined as the solution of a constrained optimization problem. Focusing on processes driven by the minimization of the work performed by external loads in one-dimensional and axisymmetric settings, we derive explicit analytical solutions for the resulting growth distributions. Although growth is initially formulated as a volumetric process through a distributed growth strain tensor, we show that the optimal growth distributions are singular and concentrate on boundaries or internal interfaces. These results provide a variational mechanism through which, under certain conditions, surface growth is selected as the optimal realization of volumetric growth.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：optimization-driven framework、constrained optimization problem、analytical solutions。；研究对象：线性弹性固体中的体积生长与表面生长之间的关系，具体在一维和轴对称几何构型下，通过最小化外载荷做功来驱动生长过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 尽管生长最初被建模为通过分布式的生长应变张量实现的体积过程，但最优的生长分布是奇异的，并集中在边界或内部界面上，从而在变分机制下表面生长被选择为体积生长的最优实现。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：尽管生长最初被建模为通过分布式的生长应变张量实现的体积过程，但最优的生长分布是奇异的，并集中在边界或内部界面上，从而在变分机制下表面生长被选择为体积生长的最优实现。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用优化驱动的理论框架，将生长分布视为约束优化问题的解，通过解析求解一维和轴对称系统中外载荷做功最小化问题，推导出生长分布的显式解析解。

papers.title: Cavity method for permutation models on Cayley trees
papers.abstract: Motivated by permutation statistical models arising in random tensor networks, we study permutation models on a Cayley tree whose variables take values in the symmetric group $\Sn$. The pair interaction is assumed to depend only on the cycle type of the relative permutation. Then the Boltzmann weight is written as a class function on $\Sn$. This property diagonalizes the edge convolution operator in irreducible representation sectors. As a result, the linear stability of the uniform paramagnetic cavity solution is controlled by the character eigenvalue ratios. For cycle-factorized weights, these eigenvalues can be expressed as specializations of Schur functions. We derive the instability criteria and also verify their validity by comparison with direct numerical iterations of the cavity equation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：cavity method（空腔方法）、permutation models（置换模型）、Cayley trees（凯莱树）、character eigenvalue ratios（特征值比值）。；研究对象：以对称群 $\Sn$ 为变量、定义在凯莱树上的置换统计模型，其物理背景来自随机张量网络中的置换统计模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 当相互作用权重仅依赖于相对置换的循环类型（即作为类函数）时，均匀顺磁空腔解的线性稳定性由特征值比值控制；对于循环因子化权重，这些特征值可表示为舒尔函数的特化，并推导出失稳判据。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：当相互作用权重仅依赖于相对置换的循环类型（即作为类函数）时，均匀顺磁空腔解的线性稳定性由特征值比值控制；对于循环因子化权重，这些特征值可表示为舒尔函数的特化，并推导出失稳判据。；创新点：将空腔方法推广到以对称群为变量、权重为类函数的置换模型，并利用群表示论（特征值比值、舒尔函数特化）解析推导失稳条件。
papers.method_zh: 采用空腔方法（cavity method）分析凯莱树上的置换模型，利用类函数性质将边卷积算子在不可约表示子空间中对角化，并通过与空腔方程的直接数值迭代结果对比验证失稳判据的有效性。

papers.title: Monopoles, Center Vortices, Confinement in (3+1)d, and the Lens-Space Twisted Partition Function
papers.abstract: We propose the gauge-invariant criteria of center-vortex condensation and monopole condensation using the $\mathbb{Z}_N^{[1]}$-symmetry twisted partition functions: The torus twisted partition function characterizes the center-vortex condensation, and the lens-space twisted partition function characterizes the monopole condensation. To justify our proposal, we study how these twisted partition functions behave in the adjoint Higgs phase and show that their leading nontrivial contributions come from the center vortex and monopole, respectively. Using the techniques of topological field theories, we uncover the relation between the center-vortex and monopole condensations, and in particular, we prove that the gapped phase with the center-vortex condensation necessarily shows the monopole condensation, too. We then study a center-vortex model with monopoles as an illustrative example, and the higher-charge monopole condensation gives an example of the symmetry fractionalization, which goes beyond the conventional Wilson-'t Hooft classification.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：propose（提出）、study（研究）、prove（证明）、topological field theories（拓扑场论）。；研究对象：规范理论中的夸克禁闭机制，具体研究中心涡旋凝聚（center-vortex condensation）和磁单极子凝聚（monopole condensation）的规范不变判据，以及两者在(3+1)维时空中的关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了用环面扭结配分函数表征中心涡旋凝聚、用透镜空间扭结配分函数表征磁单极子凝聚的规范不变判据；证明了中心涡旋凝聚的能隙相必然伴随磁单极子凝聚，并发现高电荷磁单极子凝聚可导致超越传统Wilson-’t Hooft分类的对称性分数量子化现象。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了用环面扭结配分函数表征中心涡旋凝聚、用透镜空间扭结配分函数表征磁单极子凝聚的规范不变判据；证明了中心涡旋凝聚的能隙相必然伴随磁单极子凝聚，并发现高电荷磁单极子凝聚可导致超越传统Wilson-’t Hooft分类的对称性分数量子化现象。；创新点：首次提出用透镜空间扭结配分函数作为磁单极子凝聚的规范不变判据，并严格证明了中心涡旋凝聚必然导致磁单极子凝聚这一此前未被明确证明的关系。
papers.method_zh: 利用$\mathbb{Z}_N^{[1]}$对称性扭结配分函数（环面与透镜空间）作为诊断工具；通过分析伴随希格斯相中这些配分函数的领头阶贡献来验证判据；运用拓扑场论技术推导中心涡旋与磁单极子凝聚之间的内在联系；构建包含磁单极子的中心涡旋模型作为示例。

papers.title: Multipolar optical binding in focus
papers.abstract: The optical binding of gold nanoparticles has conventionally been explored within the Rayleigh limit using dipole approximations. But the field is increasingly focusing on the Mie regime for particles in the 100-500 nm range, where the dipole approximation is insufficient, and a complex landscape of multipolar resonances must be considered. This can be leveraged to engineer more complex forms of optical matter. To this end, we computationally study the optical binding force landscapes experienced by a pair of AuNPs using generalized multiparticle Mie theory. We calculate the total optical binding forces and mechanical trap stiffness values ($dF_i/di$) at the specific resonance wavelengths where the electric dipole, quadrupole, or octupole modes reach their respective scattering peaks and dominate the mechanical response. We demonstrate that the plasmonic mode symmetry greatly influences the spatial distribution of zero-force nodes and the rigidity of the optically bound dimer. By aligning these multipolar phenomena with standard experimental configurations, this work provides a mechanical framework for programmable metafluids and reconfigurable micromachines, bridging the gap between fundamental electrodynamics and reconfigurable nanomanipulation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用了“computationally study”（计算研究）和“generalized multiparticle Mie theory”（广义多粒子米氏理论）等关键词。；研究对象：一对金纳米颗粒（AuNPs）在聚焦光场中的光学结合力，特别是当颗粒尺寸处于米氏（Mie）散射区（100-500 nm）时，由多极共振模式主导的光学结合力景观。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 金纳米颗粒的等离激元模式对称性（如电偶极、四极、八极模式）会显著影响光学结合力中零力节点的空间分布以及光学束缚二聚体的机械刚度（陷阱刚度值 dF_i/di）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：金纳米颗粒的等离激元模式对称性（如电偶极、四极、八极模式）会显著影响光学结合力中零力节点的空间分布以及光学束缚二聚体的机械刚度（陷阱刚度值 dF_i/di）。；创新点：将光学结合力的研究从传统的瑞利（Rayleigh）偶极近似拓展到米氏（Mie）散射区，系统地揭示了高阶多极共振模式（四极、八极）对光学束缚二聚体机械性能（如刚度和力节点分布）的调控作用，为设计可编程超流体和可重构微机械提供了力学框架。
papers.method_zh: 采用广义多粒子米氏理论（generalized multiparticle Mie theory）进行数值计算。具体计算了在电偶极、四极或八极模式各自散射峰值的共振波长下，金纳米颗粒对的总光学结合力及其机械陷阱刚度。

papers.title: Semiclassical Analysis of Tunneling in Graphene under Nonuniform Electrostatic and Magnetic Fields
papers.abstract: We develop a semiclassical theory of tunnelling of Dirac fermions through an n-p-n junction in monolayer graphene subjected to a perpendicular magnetic field. Electrostatic and magnetic fields are assumed to be smooth functions of a single spatial coordinate, supported on a finite interval, vanishing outside it, and thus ensuring asymptotically free states. In contrast to earlier studies restricted to constant magnetic fields and exactly solvable electrostatic potential profiles, we consider a general electrostatic potential forming an n-p-n junction and an arbitrary magnetic field, and formulate the corresponding scattering problem. Within the semiclassical approximation, and under an additional assumption on the incidence angle, the problem reduces to a connection problem for a pair of degeneracy points, treated using results from our earlier work. We obtain explicit expressions for the reflection and transmission coefficients, including their phases, as functions of energy and incidence angle. Furthermore, we derive semiclassical conditions for Fabry-Pérot resonances and "magic" angles, and analyse the resulting interference pattern. Numerical results demonstrate the angular dependence of transmission induced by the magnetic field.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“develop a semiclassical theory”“formulate the corresponding scattering problem”“derive semiclassical conditions”，属于理论推导与分析。；研究对象：单层石墨烯中n-p-n结在垂直磁场下的隧穿现象，具体研究非均匀静电场和磁场共同作用下的狄拉克费米子隧穿。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在非均匀电场和磁场下，通过半经典近似和简并点连接问题，得到了反射系数和透射系数（含相位）的显式表达式，并推导了法布里-珀罗共振和“魔角”的半经典条件，揭示了磁场诱导的透射角依赖性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在非均匀电场和磁场下，通过半经典近似和简并点连接问题，得到了反射系数和透射系数（含相位）的显式表达式，并推导了法布里-珀罗共振和“魔角”的半经典条件，揭示了磁场诱导的透射角依赖性。；创新点：相较于以往仅限于恒定磁场和精确可解静电势的研究，本文考虑了任意形式的静电势（形成n-p-n结）和任意磁场分布，并给出了更一般的半经典散射公式。
papers.method_zh: 半经典理论分析。具体包括：将静电势和磁场视为单一空间坐标的光滑函数，在有限区间内非零、外部为零；利用半经典近似和简并点连接问题（基于作者前期工作）处理散射问题；推导反射/透射系数、共振条件，并进行数值计算展示角度依赖关系。

papers.title: Imprints of dynamical phases in semiclassical entanglement entropy in 2D CFT
papers.abstract: We study the time evolution of semiclassical entanglement entropy in a class of $sl(2,\mathbb{R})$ driven states in a large $c$ conformal field theory (CFT) in $1+1$ spacetime dimensions. Upon varying the parameters of the drive, we find that the entanglement entropy exhibits the signature of the dynamical phases of the driven CFT. We further study the holographic dual of this CFT where the excited states of a minimally coupled scalar in $AdS_3$ induce a backreaction that modifies the background geometry. We compute the back reacted geometry by solving Einstein's equation with the expectation value of the stress tensor in the coherent state as the source term. Subsequently, we calculate the time evolution of the perturbed minimal area and the bulk entanglement entropy at $O(G_N^0)$, up to the sub-leading order in short distance approximation. These results match the CFT entanglement entropy in the boundary at $O(c^0)$, and serve as a nontrivial check of the Faulkner-Lewkowycz-Maldacena (FLM) conjecture for the first quantum correction of holographic entanglement entropy. The details of the check has been provided in the accompanying ancillary notebook.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：研究、计算、CFT、holographic dual、FLM conjecture。；研究对象：1+1维大c共形场论（CFT）中由sl(2,R)驱动态的半经典纠缠熵的时间演化，及其在AdS₃引力对偶中的全息描述。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 纠缠熵的时间演化会显示驱动CFT动力学相的特征；通过计算微扰最小面积和体纠缠熵，在次领头阶与边界CFT纠缠熵匹配，验证了Faulkner-Lewkowycz-Maldacena（FLM）猜想在全息纠缠熵第一量子修正中的正确性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：纠缠熵的时间演化会显示驱动CFT动力学相的特征；通过计算微扰最小面积和体纠缠熵，在次领头阶与边界CFT纠缠熵匹配，验证了Faulkner-Lewkowycz-Maldacena（FLM）猜想在全息纠缠熵第一量子修正中的正确性。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：利用sl(2,R)驱动态研究CFT纠缠熵；全息对偶：通过求解爱因斯坦方程（以相干态中应力张量期望值为源项）计算反作用修正的AdS₃几何，并计算O(G_N^0)阶的微扰最小面积和体纠缠熵，在短距离近似下进行次领头阶计算。

papers.title: Helical Dirac Current with Local Coupling to a Chiral Potential
papers.abstract: We show that exact Dirac eigenstates in cylindrical confinement carry a definite helical conserved-current texture even in the zero orbital angular momentum channel l = 0. For the lowest confined mode, the Dirac current contains a nonvanishing azimuthal component together with longitudinal transport and exhibits opposite handedness in the two spin-resolved sectors. The structure also persists into the evanescent region. We further derive the channel-resolved matrix-element kernel generated by a static chiral scalar potential acting on the confined l = 0 Dirac modes. The resulting spin-selective coupling arises from the Dirac current texture and the scalar chiral potential, and yields a geometric selection rule in which diagonal channels vanish while off-diagonal conversion channels survive. The coupling strength is governed by an internal sampled-current overlap Jchi(k), defined as the integral from 0 to R of f(rho) times jphi_up(rho, k) times rho d rho. This quantity measures the spatial overlap between the chiral radial profile and the spin-up azimuthal Dirac-current density. The mechanism is fully local and texture-based, without external magnetic fields or spin-orbit coupling. Within standard Dirac theory, this work identifies the minimal static Dirac-geometric kernel underlying spin-selective response, establishing a baseline structure from which dynamical-medium, scattering, and transport formalisms can be systematically developed toward a complete description of spin-polarization phenomena such as CISS.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“show that”、“derive”、“identifies”，以及全文为数学推导和机制分析，无实验或计算数据。；研究对象：圆柱形约束下的狄拉克电子体系，具体研究其螺旋电流纹理以及手性标量势对自旋选择耦合的调控机制，涉及CISS（手性诱导自旋选择性）现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在零轨道角动量（l=0）的圆柱约束狄拉克本征态中，存在非零的螺旋守恒电流纹理（包含方位角分量），该电流纹理与静态手性标量势耦合产生自旋选择性耦合，且对角通道耦合为零、非对角转换通道耦合存在，形成几何选择定则。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在零轨道角动量（l=0）的圆柱约束狄拉克本征态中，存在非零的螺旋守恒电流纹理（包含方位角分量），该电流纹理与静态手性标量势耦合产生自旋选择性耦合，且对角通道耦合为零、非对角转换通道耦合存在，形成几何选择定则。；创新点：在无外磁场和自旋-轨道耦合的纯狄拉克理论框架内，识别出实现自旋选择性响应的最小静态狄拉克几何核，为CISS等自旋极化现象提供了基础结构。
papers.method_zh: 基于标准狄拉克理论，在圆柱约束下解析求解狄拉克本征态，推导电流密度表达式；进一步计算手性标量势作用下的通道分辨矩阵元核，并定义内部采样电流重叠积分Jchi(k)来量化耦合强度。

papers.title: Toward Controllable Catalyst Inverse Design via Large-Scale Autoregressive Pretraining
papers.abstract: Inverse design of heterogeneous catalysts remains challenging because catalyst surfaces exhibit substantial structural complexity with coupled surface-adsorbate interactions across a vast chemical space that is difficult to explore efficiently through conventional screening alone. Although machine learning-based high-throughput screening has accelerated catalyst discovery, its efficiency inevitably declines as the search space grows, motivating the development of generative models that can directly construct catalysts with target properties. Here, we present a conditional catalyst generative model based on the Generative Pretrained Transformer architecture with a numerical embedding layer that enables the generation of catalyst structures conditioned on both categorical and continuous properties within a single autoregressive framework. The model was pretrained on 133 million catalyst structures and subsequently fine-tuned on approximately 460,000 optimized structures with associated categorical properties and binding energies for conditional generation. The resulting model achieved 98% structural validity, 95% optimization validity, and high categorical condition fidelity, with a 93 % joint match rate for adsorbate type and composition. For binding energy conditioning, the match rate of approximately 20% represents a four-fold improvement over the baseline training distribution, and the generated distributions shift systematically toward the target values, enabling a 1.5 to 4-fold improvement in screening efficiency for reaction-targeted catalyst discovery without additional fine-tuning. These results show that large-scale autoregressive pre-training, combined with explicit property conditioning, provides a practical route toward controllable catalyst generation and accelerated catalysts discovery.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：机器学习、生成模型、预训练、条件生成。；研究对象：多相催化剂（heterogeneous catalysts）的逆向设计。具体涉及催化剂表面结构及其与吸附物（adsorbate）的相互作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过大规模自回归预训练（在1.33亿个催化剂结构上）并结合显式的性质条件控制，可以构建一个高结构有效性（98%）和优化有效性（95%）的催化剂生成模型。该模型能根据目标吸附能等性质定向生成催化剂，将筛选效率提升1.5至4倍，为可控催化剂逆向设计提供了可行路径。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过大规模自回归预训练（在1.33亿个催化剂结构上）并结合显式的性质条件控制，可以构建一个高结构有效性（98%）和优化有效性（95%）的催化剂生成模型。该模型能根据目标吸附能等性质定向生成催化剂，将筛选效率提升1.5至4倍，为可控催化剂逆向设计提供了可行路径。；创新点：将大规模自回归预训练（类似自然语言处理中的GPT范式）应用于催化剂的逆向设计，并成功实现了对多种性质（类别和连续）的显式条件控制，显著提升了在广阔化学空间中定向生成目标催化剂的能力和后续筛选效率。
papers.method_zh: 基于生成式预训练Transformer（GPT）架构的条件生成模型。模型包含一个数值嵌入层（numerical embedding layer），使其能在单一自回归框架内同时处理类别型（如吸附物类型）和连续型（如结合能）条件。模型首先在1.33亿个结构上进行预训练，然后在约46万个优化后的结构上微调，以进行条件生成。

papers.title: Effects of Josephson Junction Non-idealities on Adiabatic Quantum Flux Parametron Circuits
papers.abstract: Adiabatic quantum flux parametron (AQFP) gate is a promising approach to scale up the cryogenic microwave electronics for superconducting qubit multiplexed control. However, the performance of these circuits depends on the quality of the Josephson junctions which are ideally superconductor-insulator-superconductor (SIS) type following the ideal sinusoidal relation between current and quantum phase. We demonstrate how the non-sinusoidal current-phase relation in Superconductor-Normal metal-Superconductor (SNS) and weak link (WL) junctions affects the speed, delay, and margin of the AQFP gates. The JJ models are defined in the Keysight ADS simulator using symbolically defined device (SDD) method.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。依据：摘要中提及“demonstrate how... affects...”，并使用“Keysight ADS simulator”进行仿真建模。；研究对象：非理想约瑟夫森结（包括超导-正常金属-超导（SNS）结和弱连接（WL）结）对绝热量子通量参变管（AQFP）电路性能的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 非理想约瑟夫森结的非正弦电流-相位关系会显著影响AQFP门的运行速度、延迟和容限，从而影响其在超导量子比特复用控制中的性能。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：非理想约瑟夫森结的非正弦电流-相位关系会显著影响AQFP门的运行速度、延迟和容限，从而影响其在超导量子比特复用控制中的性能。；创新点：系统揭示了SNS和弱连接结的非理想电流-相位关系对AQFP门关键性能参数（速度、延迟、容限）的具体影响机制。
papers.method_zh: 采用Keysight ADS仿真器中的符号定义器件（SDD）方法建立约瑟夫森结模型，通过仿真分析非正弦电流-相位关系对AQFP电路性能的影响。

papers.title: Coupled-Mode Equations with Arbitrary Mode Combinations for Kinetic-Inductance Superconducting Traveling-Wave Parametric Devices: Theory and Experimental Validation
papers.abstract: The coupled-mode equations (CMEs) have proven very successful in describing parametric processes in nonlinear optics. More recently, the same formulation has been used to model microwave superconducting parametric amplifiers and frequency multipliers. However, when applied to the microwave regime, not all assumptions remain valid and losses play a more dramatic role. Here, we revisit the CMEs applied to traveling-wave superconducting amplifiers to include losses and provide a formulation that enables their systematic derivation for any combination of traveling waves. As examples, we discuss the impact of unwanted harmonics and intermodulation products on parametric amplification, as well as harmonic generation. We verify that, if not properly accounted for, device performance can deviate considerably from the ideal case. Furthermore, using a superconducting CPW-based artificial transmission line and combining an independent experimental determination of its nonlinear parameter $I'_*$ with simulations of its linear properties, we obtain a parameter-free validation of this formulation. The nonlinear parameter was determined to be $I'_* \approx 27$ mA which, surprisingly, scales with the theoretical depairing current and not with the much smaller critical current of the device. For the validation, we measured multiple-harmonic generation and found excellent agreement between theory and experiment. The fact that $I'_* \gg I_C$ has direct implications for device design.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（理论推导 + 实验验证）。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“revisit the CMEs... provide a formulation... systematic derivation”（理论推导），以及“using a superconducting CPW-based artificial transmission line... experimental determination... validation”（实验验证）。；研究对象：基于动感电感超导行波参量器件中的耦合模方程，具体涉及超导共面波导人工传输线中的参量放大、谐波产生及互调产物等非线性过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 非线性参数 \( I'_* \approx 27 \) mA 远大于器件的临界电流 \( I_C \)，且与理论退配对电流标度，而非与临界电流标度；若未正确考虑不需要的谐波和互调产物，器件性能会显著偏离理想情况。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：非线性参数 \( I'_* \approx 27 \) mA 远大于器件的临界电流 \( I_C \)，且与理论退配对电流标度，而非与临界电流标度；若未正确考虑不需要的谐波和互调产物，器件性能会显著偏离理想情况。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：重新推导包含损耗的耦合模方程，并给出适用于任意行波组合的系统化推导方法。实验手段：基于超导共面波导人工传输线，独立实验测定非线性参数 \( I'_* \)，并结合线性特性仿真，实现无参数拟合的理论验证；通过测量多谐波产生来验证理论。

papers.title: Thermal One-point Functions and Asymptotic CFT Data: QFT in AdS
papers.abstract: We investigate the thermal partition and one-point functions of the three-dimensional conformal field theory dual to a massive interacting scalar field in AdS$_4$. Using thermal inversion formulas, we determine the asymptotic behaviour of the spectral density and OPE coefficients involving heavy operators at fixed spin.
